jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Head of Innovation leads the organization's innovation strategy, emerging-technology agenda, experimentation, and development of new products, services, business models, and operating approaches.

Within Insurance & Investments, the role identifies opportunities to use AI, automation, InsurTech, FinTech, data, digital platforms, and emerging technologies to improve customer experience, underwriting, claims, investment management, distribution, operational efficiency, and revenue growth.

The role acts as a bridge between business strategy, technology, digital transformation, product development, and external innovation ecosystems.

Key Responsibilities

Innovation Strategy

Develop and execute the enterprise innovation strategy and roadmap.

Establish innovation priorities aligned with corporate and business-unit objectives.

Identify emerging market, technology, customer, and business-model trends.

Build an innovation pipeline covering short-, medium-, and long-term opportunities.

Establish innovation governance, frameworks, KPIs, and investment criteria.

Develop business cases and ROI models for innovation initiatives.

Product & Business Model Innovation

Identify opportunities for new insurance and investment products.

Develop and test new digital products, services, and customer propositions.

Explore alternative distribution and revenue models.

Lead proof-of-concepts, pilots, MVPs, and commercialization programs.

Conduct market and competitor analysis.

Use customer insights to identify unmet needs and new opportunities.

Insurance Innovation

Focus areas may include:

AI-enabled underwriting

Automated claims processing

Digital claims journeys

Predictive risk assessment

Telematics and usage-based insurance

Embedded insurance

Digital distribution

InsurTech partnerships

Fraud detection

Automated customer service

Personalized insurance products

IoT-enabled risk monitoring

Investment & Wealth Innovation

Explore AI/analytics-enabled investment solutions.

Identify opportunities in digital wealth management.

Develop new investor engagement and self-service models.

Explore robo-advisory and personalized investment experiences.

Improve portfolio analytics and investor reporting.

Evaluate emerging investment technologies and fintech platforms.

Identify opportunities for alternative investment products and distribution models.

Emerging Technology

Evaluate and develop use cases involving:

Artificial Intelligence

Generative AI

Machine Learning

Automation / RPA

Blockchain / Distributed Ledger Technology

Cloud Computing

APIs

IoT

Advanced Analytics

Low-code / No-code

Digital Identity

Open Banking / Open Finance

FinTech / InsurTech platforms

Innovation Labs & Experimentation

Establish innovation labs, accelerators, or internal innovation programs.

Lead ideation workshops and design-thinking initiatives.

Develop prototypes and MVPs.

Test new technologies in controlled environments.

Establish criteria for scaling successful pilots.

Stop or redesign initiatives that do not demonstrate sufficient business value.

External Ecosystem & Partnerships

Build relationships with FinTechs, InsurTechs, startups, universities, technology providers, venture ecosystems, and research organizations.

Identify strategic partnerships and investment opportunities.

Evaluate startup technologies and potential strategic fit.

Manage innovation challenges, hackathons, accelerators, and partnerships.

Represent the organization at innovation and industry forums.

Data, AI & Digital Transformation

Partner with Data & Analytics teams on AI and advanced analytics opportunities.

Work with Digital and Technology leadership to scale successful innovations.

Identify automation opportunities across operations.

Promote data-driven experimentation and decision-making.

Ensure innovation initiatives complement the broader digital and technology roadmap.

Governance, Risk & Regulation

Ensure innovation initiatives comply with financial-services regulations.

Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Information Security, and Data Privacy teams.

Establish responsible AI and technology governance.

Assess cybersecurity, privacy, operational, financial, and regulatory risks.

Establish appropriate controls for experimentation and production deployment.

Leadership & Commercialization

Build and lead innovation teams and cross-functional squads.

Manage innovation budgets and investment portfolios.

Establish innovation KPIs and executive reporting.

Track revenue, cost savings, customer impact, adoption, and ROI.

Develop commercialization plans for successful innovations.

Present innovation opportunities and results to executive leadership and the Board.

Ideal Candidate Profile

12–18+ years of experience across innovation, strategy, digital transformation, product, technology, consulting, or financial services.

5+ years in senior leadership roles.

Proven experience building and executing innovation strategies.

Strong understanding of emerging technologies and their commercial applications.

Experience with FinTech, InsurTech, AI, automation, digital products, analytics, or platform businesses.

Strong product-development and business-model innovation experience.

Experience taking concepts from ideation PoC MVP pilot commercialization.

Strong understanding of financial-services business models.

Experience working with startups, technology vendors, accelerators, or innovation ecosystems.

Excellent strategic thinking, commercial judgment, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, Finance, or related field; MBA/master's preferred.

jobs.excerpt: Company: Vursor Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time About Vursor Vursor is a leading NetSuite consulting firm specializing in delivering high-quality implementation services to help businesses optimize their ERP operations.
jobs.description:
Company: Vursor
Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time

About Vursor

Vursor is a leading NetSuite consulting firm specializing in delivering high-quality implementation services to help businesses optimize their ERP operations. We partner with clients across diverse industries to transform their business processes through expertly executed NetSuite solutions.

Position Overview

The Principal Consultant is responsible for delivering NetSuite implementation projects while leading the client relationship and managing internal delegation of tasks alongside the Project Manager. This includes ensuring tasks are completed on time and on budget, maintaining the quality and efficiency of Vursor's delivery processes, and ensuring client satisfaction. The Principal Consultant is also accountable for fostering a culture of high performance and continuous improvement across the project teams.

Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery (85% of time)

Billable Work (85%)

  • Provide NetSuite consulting expertise utilizing industry-leading best practices, business analysis, and a pragmatic mindset to solve clients’ most complex requirements.

  • Lead Analysis, Design or Drive sessions with minimal knowledge ramp-up.

  • Conduct business process mapping, requirements gathering, and design workshops with clients to define configuration requirements.

  • Implement and deploy NetSuite solutions to accommodate industry, business, and regulatory requirements across process areas.

  • Configure NetSuite features, processes, roles, and permissions based on client requirements and migrate legacy transactional and entity data from client systems into NetSuite.

  • Troubleshoot issues that arise during configuration and resolve them efficiently.

  • Actively lead 3-5 implementation projects concurrently. This will include active participation in multiple engagements, interacting directly with client stakeholders during the implementation.

  • Document meeting minutes, requirements, and solution design decisions in line with Vursor delivery standards. These standards also apply to communications and interactions with our clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Support and lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and End-User Training sessions as required.

  • Ensure the delivery of complex implementation projects with minimal PM oversight. Including the ability to identify project risks and provide mitigation strategies.

  • Lead a team of consultants through an engagement by dispatching and managing project tasks and/or delegating portions of the project while retaining accountability for the activities.

  • Provide high level project estimates in terms of scope, timeline and budget

  • Understand scope requirements in order to establish timelines and resource requirements to ensure a successful delivery. May be responsible for timeline/resource requirements as well.

  • Provide ongoing post-implementation support to drive user adoption and continuous improvement.

Internal Process Improvements (5% of time)

  • Participate in and lead the development and improvement of Vursor’s internal processes, templates, and delivery documentation through Practices and personal contributions.

  • Contribute to, participate in the delivery of knowledge sharing activities such as Lunch & Learns and internal working groups.

Professional Development (5% of time)

  • Learn Oracle NetSuite Leading Practices through self-training, the Oracle MyLearn portal and SuiteSuccess assets.

  • Actively pursue NetSuite certifications as part of the defined certification path.

  • Participate in coaching/mentoring peers

Corporate (5% of time)

  • Engage in pre-sales solution consulting

  • Participate in quarterly/yearly performance evaluations

  • Attend mandated company meetings and daily standups, as well as team activities.

Key Metrics of Success

  • Utilization: Maintain individual, team and department billable utilization targets and other KPIs as defined by the organization.

  • Project Delivery: Projects delivered on time, on budget, and with approved scope changes.

  • Quality of Deliverables: Positive internal QA reviews and limited credits issued to clients.

  • CSAT: Positive client satisfaction scores from post-mortems and CSAT surveys.

  • Complete quarterly department and corporate goals.

  • Contributions to Practices and pre-sales

  • Certifications: Completion of NetSuite certifications within defined timelines.

  • Team Contribution: Active participation in knowledge sharing and internal initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • 5-7 years of experience in NetSuite consulting or ERP implementation services

  • 4+ years leading medium to complex implementation projects.

  • Business Process Knowledge:

  • Reference for all core business process areas, including Record to Report, Design to Build, Order to Cash, and Procure to Pay.

  • Proficient in at least three of the following: Fixed Assets Management (FAM), Advanced Revenue Management (ARM), multi-book accounting, SuiteBilling, Field Service Management (FSM), and advanced manufacturing.

  • Accounting: Reference for all native NetSuite transactions and their GL impact, as well as financial segmentation (incl. Chart of accounts and account types). Advanced knowledge of concepts such as foreign currencies, currency revaluations, eliminations, revenue deferral, expense amortization, inventory costing, as well as financial reporting.

  • Industry Exposure: Advanced understanding of at least one of the following verticals and proficiency in at least 3: Recruitment & Staffing, Private equity, Hospitality, FSM/Construction, Financial Services/Insurance and SaaS/Business Services

  • Technical Familiarity: Act as a reference regarding NetSuite configuration options (custom fields, workflows, reporting, dashboards). Extensive experience with SuiteScripts as well as custom records, transactions and segments. In depth knowledge of SuiteFlow or SuiteAnalytics is an asset.

  • Reporting: Act as a reference for NetSuite reporting options such as Saved Searches, Reports and Workbooks as well as when to leverage the appropriate type.

  • Soft Skills: Strong communication, problem-solving, and time management skills, with the ability to interact professionally with clients and team members. Ability to adapt approach to client specific requirements and manage scope creep. Capacity to de-escalation certain topics with the client as well as act as a back for a PM.

  • Certifications required as follows: SuiteFoundation, NetSuite Administrator, Financial User,SuiteAnalytics User, ERP Consultant, and at least two enablements (ARM, SuiteBilling, MultiBook, FSM). The candidate should also be certified with at least one 3rd party partner

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in business, Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.

AI Skillsets

  • Proficient in using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini

  • Familiar with AI agents and MCP connectors

  • Certifications are an asset

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a NetSuite Solution Provider or high-growth consulting firm

  • Familiarity with enterprise implementation strategies

  • Experience expanding service offerings or building new practices

  • Background in change management and organizational transformation

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package including base salary and performance-based incentives

  • Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k)/RRSP retirement plan with company match

  • Professional development opportunities and certification support

  • Flexible work arrangements

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment

  • Opportunity to shape the growth and direction of a leading NetSuite consulting firm

Founded in Austin in 1989, EZCORP has grown into a leading provider of pawn loans in the United States, Mexico and Latin America. We are dedicated to satisfying the short-term cash needs of consumers who are both cash and credit constrained and providing an industry-leading customer experience.

Ontario

The Delivery Lead — Digital Products is a senior delivery role within the Enterprise PMO, responsible for the end-to-end planning, execution, and successful delivery of digital product initiatives. This role works directly with product teams, development teams, data and analytics team, marketing, and business stakeholders to drive delivery of pricing and lending capabilities, digital customer experiences, and e-commerce initiatives. This is not a traditional project management role. The product teams this person partners with own their own backlogs, define their requirements, and ship in iterative cycles. The value this role adds is managing the organizational complexity around those teams: cross-team dependencies, release coordination, stakeholder alignment, vendor management, and executive reporting. The person in this role must be technically credible with product and development teams while translating progress into business language for executive stakeholders.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Digital product delivery

  • Serve as the EPMO’s delivery partner for digital product teams, managing cross-team dependencies, release coordination, and stakeholder alignment so product teams can focus on building
  • Coordinate delivery across pricing and lending, data analytics, digital, and e-commerce workstreams — maintaining visibility into how these initiatives interact and depend on each other
  • Direct full-cycle digital product delivery from initiation through post-launch, ensuring outcomes align with scope, schedule, budget, and strategic business priorities
  • Participate in sprint reviews, backlog refinement, and planning sessions with product teams; understand what is being built well enough to identify integration risks, data dependencies, and downstream impacts
  • Manage release coordination between product team delivery cadence and business launch timelines, ensuring that pricing updates, marketing campaigns, and customer-facing features ship when stakeholders expect them
  • Proactively manage changes in scope; identify potential risks and develop contingency plans before they become delivery problems

Technical coordination

  • Partner with business and product leads and development teams to ensure technical decisions account for cross-product dependencies, data pipeline reliability, and platform scalability
  • Coordinate data and analytics delivery: track the flow of work from data ingestion and pipeline development through model building, validation, and production deployment
  • Manage technical vendor and partner relationships for digital initiatives: API integrations, third-party platform implementations, SaaS tool deployments, and data provider onboarding
  • Facilitate technical trade-off conversations when digital initiatives span multiple systems, teams, or data domains

Team coordination and stakeholder engagement

  • Create and lead cross-functional project teams spanning the product development and launch lifecycle
  • Translate between product and development language (epics, stories, velocity, technical debt) and business stakeholder language (launch dates, revenue impact, campaign milestones)
  • Coach, mentor, and motivate project team members and contractors, fostering accountability and ownership of assigned work
  • Influence and align cross-functional teams without direct authority — building consensus across product, development, marketing, operations, and business stakeholders
  • Build and maintain key business and vendor relationships critical to digital product delivery

Reporting and governance

  • Provide executive-quality delivery reporting to the EPMO Director and senior leadership: initiative status, risk posture, delivery forecasts, and KPI dashboards
  • Ensure enterprise project management standards, frameworks, and governance processes are consistently applied to digital product delivery
  • Conduct post-launch retrospectives and produce lessons-learned documentation to drive continuous improvement across the PMO

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

· 6+ years of direct work experience in a project or program management capacity, with demonstrated experience delivering complex digital product initiatives across multiple concurrent workstreams

· Strong technical foundation: comfortable reviewing architecture and design discussions, understanding API integrations, discussing data pipeline and analytics workflows, and engaging in trade-off conversations with development teams

· Direct experience coordinating digital product delivery: e-commerce platforms, customer-facing applications, pricing or lending products, or data analytics solutions

· Deep understanding of the software and digital product development lifecycle (SDLC/PDLC)

· Agile fluency: has worked inside Scrum or Kanban teams as a delivery partner, comfortable with iterative planning, sprint ceremonies, and flow-based metrics

· Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience presenting to executive audiences and translating technical complexity into business language

· Proficiency with project and product management tools such as Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or equivalent platforms

· Strong background working within a formal PMO structure or enterprise project governance framework

· Experience in retail, financial services, specialty lending, or e-commerce industries preferred

· Bachelor’s degree in information technology, business, or a related field required

· PMP or PgMP certification

· CSM, PSM, or equivalent Scrum certification

· SAFe POPM, Product Owner, or Agile Product Management certification

· Familiarity with AI-powered project management tools, predictive analytics, or delivery intelligence platforms

jobs.excerpt: Accompany Health is on a mission to give patients with complex needs the dignified, high-quality care they deserve but rarely receive.
jobs.description:
Accompany Health is on a mission to give patients with complex needs the dignified, high-quality care they deserve but rarely receive. A primary, behavioral, and social care provider, Accompany Health walks alongside patients for their entire care journey, offering at-home and virtual care, as well as 24/7 support. Partnering with innovative payors, Accompany Health is powered by remarkable care teams, elegant technology, and a commitment to evidence-based practice.

We build long-term relationships with our patients so they know, without question, that our team is here for them day or night, year after year. We focus on the health outcomes most important to our patients to make it clear that they lead the way.

To achieve our mission, we collaborate with community-based organizations, local providers, and health plans. Led by our empathetic care teams, guided by proven care models, and powered by our own technology, we deliver a level of service that our communities rightfully deserve but rarely receive.

While our headquarters is in Bethesda, MD, our teams are distributed across the country. If you’re eager to make a tangible difference in people’s lives, to help correct long-standing disparities in health care, join us.

About the role:

As an Executive Clinical Director of Market Operations, you will serve as a senior clinical leader at Accompany Health, reporting directly to the Chief Medical Officer. Working in close partnership with the Head of Market Operations, VBC leadership team, and Product teams, you will hold dyad operational accountability for building, leading, and refining market-based clinical care systems. You will directly drive high-quality clinical care, total cost of care performance, quality metrics, and exceptional employee engagement across clinical pods.

Responsibilities will include:

Care Model Execution & Scalable Systems Integration:

  • Drive the operational execution of Accompany Health’s clinical care model across all markets, translating clinical workflows into scalable operational and product-based systems in close partnership with Product, Technology, and Operations teams.
  • Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) and clinical delivery playbooks that allow care pods to operate efficiently and consistently at scale.

Operational & Clinical Performance Management:

  • In dyad partnership with the Head of Market Operations, manage cross-functional systems to deliver high-touch, compassionate, patient-centered care.
  • Drive market-level performance across core value-based KPIs:
    • Patient engagement and retention.
    • Accurate, comprehensive, and timely clinical diagnosis accompanied by evidence-based treatment plans.
    • Quality measure performance, maintaining 4+ STARs across all key HEDIS metrics.
    • Total medical expense (TME) reduction through proactive chronic disease management and avoidance of unnecessary hospitalizations.

Clinical People Leadership & Talent Development:

  • Directly manage the Core Care Model Provider Service Line, including Clinical Directors and Clinical APC Managers across markets, providing strong leadership, mentorship, and support to frontline care delivery teams
  • Partner collaboratively with Market Medical Directors and the CMO to align clinical quality, provider engagement, and team execution
  • Support and coach clinical leadership on managing care pod panels, evaluating ongoing clinical competencies, executing coaching and remediation plans, and partnering with the People Team to establish structured career pathways for APCs and care team staff

Strategic Leader for Clinical Innovation:

  • Act as a key clinical leader for strategic clinical innovation, including technology and AI enablement, in order to design and implement care model innovations and programming targeted at reducing avoidable medical expense, improving quality and preventative care, ensuring appropriate diagnosis, and driving strong patient engagement and experience
  • Serve as a key clinical lead for product build, workflow automation, and AI enablement, to ensure that care model innovations are built into scalable tooling that enhances clinical care as well as clinician workflow and efficiency
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to continuously test, iterate, and roll out technology-driven enhancements across clinical workflows

Quality, Safety, and Culture:

  • Ensure adherence to evidence-based clinical guidelines, Accompany Health standards, clinical policies, safety protocols, and company procedures while actively upholding company cultural values and norms

Market Implementation & Expansion:

  • Partner with Market Operations to lead timely and successful new payor/market implementations
  • Oversee clinician hiring, recruiting, and adaptation of operational systems tailored to specific market and contract requirements

Direct Clinical Care & On-Call Coverage:

  • Dedicate up to ~10% of time to direct clinical care (virtual urgent care, in-person urgent care, or overflow care)
  • Participate in rotating on-call schedules and clinician supervision coverage as needed

Travel:

  • Travel will be variable around monthly to existing markets and/or offsite although may increase as needed to support market / payor launches

What makes you a fit for the team:

  • Mission Driven: Passionate about caring for complex, historically underserved patients with co-occurring chronic and behavioral health conditions in an integrated, multi-disciplinary model anchored in home-based and tech-enabled virtual care
  • People Leader: Excellent communicator; able to clearly articulate, motivate, and lead multidisciplinary teams towards common goals
    • Loves coaching and mentoring clinicians and non-clinicians in their skill development and career growth
    • Exceptional at change management and organizational transformation
  • Team Player and Collaborator: Willing to roll up sleeves and effectively work across multiple functions and team members
  • Creative and Efficient Problem-Solver: Thrives in fast-paced environments requiring out-of-the-box problem-solving and flexibility in approach, as well as ability to multitask and prioritize across competing goals
  • Enthusiastic Innovator: Excited about being a part of the leading edge of fast-paced innovation in care delivery models for vulnerable populations in AI, virtual and tech-enabled models

Desired skills and experience:

Required:

  • Master’s or Doctoral degree in Nursing (Nurse Practitioner) or Physician Assistant Studies (PA-C) from an accredited program
  • Current, active, and unencumbered NP or PA national certification and state licensure, with the willingness and eligibility to obtain multi-state licensure.
  • 8+ years of clinical practice experience as an NP or PA, with 5+ years in progressive clinical leadership roles overseeing APCs, clinical managers, and multidisciplinary care teams within a value-based care (VBC) organization
  • Demonstrated track record of operationalizing clinical care models and translating clinical workflows into scalable systems
  • Proven accountability for key value-based performance metrics: driving patient engagement, accurate and comprehensive clinical diagnosis with appropriate treatment planning, HEDIS/STARs performance, and total medical expense (TME) / total cost of care reduction
  • Demonstrated experience with dyad operational leadership models, market launches, clinician performance coaching/remediation, and panel management.
  • Willingness to provide direct patient care (~10%), participate in rotating on-call coverage, and travel as needed

Preferred:

  • Experience partnering directly with Product, Tech, and Strategic Operations teams to build, iterate, and scale tech-enabled clinical care delivery platforms and workflows
  • Experience and fluency in using AI tools in clinical workflows and supporting workforce AI enablement
  • Background working in high-growth, venture-backed healthcare startups or advanced home-based/hybrid primary care delivery models
  • Deep clinical and operational familiarity with Medicare Advantage, Medicaid managed care, and Dual-Eligible Special Needs Plans (D-SNP)

Salary ranges are based on role, level, and location, and reflect the minimum to maximum target for new hire pay in each position. Depending on the role, you may also be eligible for bonus, equity, and benefits. Where you fall within the range depends on factors such as your location, skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our talent team is happy to share more details on the specific range for your location during the hiring process.

Description

Exodigo is the leading underground mapping solution for non-intrusive discovery. Our platforms combine multi-sensor fusion, 3D imaging, and AI technologies to create complete, accurate underground maps that enable confident decision-making for customers across the built world. We transform the project lifecycle for our customers, who include key community stakeholders in the utilities, transportation and government sectors.

We are experiencing sky-rocketing growth and closed a historically large $96M Series B round in July of 2025.

Job description

The Program Manager, Engineering Services is the primary point of contact for Exodigo's largest engineering-services clients and owns their success end to end: delivery quality, client satisfaction and commercial growth. You will lead multidisciplinary teams delivering utility design and subsurface engineering scopes, keep contracts on schedule and on margin, and turn strong delivery into follow-on work.

This is a true seller-doer role that sits between delivery and growth. You run the work, you own the relationship, and you help win what comes next.

What You'll Do

Own the client relationship

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Exodigo's largest engineering-services clients, from contract award through closeout and renewal.
  • Own client satisfaction: set expectations, report status, resolve issues quickly and escalate early on scope, schedule or budget risk.
  • Build multi-threaded relationships across owner and prime-consultant organizations, from project engineers to program directors.
  • Lead regular project and business reviews covering performance, outcomes and value delivered.
  • Act as a trusted advisor on engineering design processes, adoption of AI technologies, and management of project risk.

Deliver engineering-services contracts

  • Take overall accountability for the quality of engineering-services deliverables, including utility design, conflict analysis and subsurface utility engineering scopes.
  • Establish the work plan, fee estimate, schedule and staffing for each phase, and lead the kickoff with client stakeholders.
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams of engineers, designers, and data specialists to produce on-time, on-budget deliverables.
  • Confirm deliverables meet client, agency and industry standards at conceptual and final design levels.
  • Drive the QA/QC plan, assign qualified technical reviewers and ensure sealed or certified deliverables meet professional standards.
  • Manage subconsultants and teaming partners against scope, schedule, quality and contract requirements.

Control scope, schedule and margin

  • Own project budgets, forecasts, margins and KPIs; track hours, expenses and earned value.
  • Maintain the project management plan, risk register, decision log and change documentation.
  • Identify scope changes early and manage change requests and contract amendments with the client.
  • Lead recovery planning on troubled projects and run lessons-learned at closeout.

Win future work with key clients

  • Join pursuit teams for future work with key clients, contributing to go/no-go decisions, win strategy, pricing and risk reviews.
  • Lead or support technical approach, staffing and scope sections of proposals, and present in interviews.
  • Track upcoming client programs, solicitations and contract vehicles (IDIQ, on-call, task-order and design-build teaming).

Grow key accounts

  • Own commercial growth of assigned key accounts, with targets for retention, expansion and follow-on contract value.
  • Build and execute account plans aligned to each client's capital program, project pipeline and digital-delivery goals.
  • Identify expansion opportunities: new task orders, additional programs and divisions, and cross-sell of Exodigo mapping and digital-twin services.
  • Partner with Sales on handoffs into long-term account ownership and on new opportunities you surface.
  • Keep CRM records current for account health, pipeline and forecast.

Lead and collaborate

  • Mentor and develop project staff; provide performance input to their managers.
  • Work with Engineering, Operations, Product and Sales to deliver a seamless client experience.
  • Feed client insight back into Exodigo's service offerings, AI-assisted design tools and product roadmap.
  • Represent Exodigo at client meetings, industry events and professional organizations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil, Electrical or a related engineering discipline.
  • Registered Professional Engineer (PE) in at least one US state, with the ability to obtain comity licenses as needed.
  • 10+ years of engineering experience, including 5+ years managing design or engineering-services contracts for clients.
  • Public-sector client experience (state DOTs, transit agencies, airports, public utilities or municipalities) is required.
  • Proven record of growing and retaining large, complex client accounts, with follow-on work you helped win.
  • Working knowledge of utility design and coordination, and of subsurface utility engineering.
  • Strong command of project controls: work plans, fee estimates, budgets, schedules, earned value, change management and risk registers.
  • Experience preparing proposals and presenting in client interviews.
  • Understanding of public-sector procurement and contract types, including QBS, IDIQ / on-call, task-order and design-build delivery.
  • Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication with technical and executive audiences.
  • Ability to travel up to 40% and work effectively in a remote, high-growth environment.

Preferred

  • Master's degree in Engineering.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP), DBIA or CCM certification.
  • Experience in transportation, rail, aviation, power or water infrastructure programs.
  • Experience with Design-Build, Progressive Design-Build or alliance delivery, including bridging documents.
  • Experience working for or teaming with large AEC/EPC firms as prime or subconsultant.
  • Familiarity with geophysical methods (GPR, EM, magnetics) and ASCE 75 utility as-built data standards.
  • Proficiency with design and BIM tools (MicroStation/OpenRoads, Civil 3D, Revit) and digital-delivery workflows.
  • Interest in applying AI-assisted design to engineering production.
  • Active involvement in professional organizations (ASCE, ACEC, ARTBA, APTA, ACI-NA or similar).

Key strengths

  • Ownership: you take full accountability for delivery quality and account outcomes.
  • Trusted advisor: clients call you first when a project gets hard.
  • Commercial instinct: you see the next contract inside the current one.
  • Builder: you thrive where processes are still being written.

Compensation - We offer a highly competitive, above-market total compensation package

  • Base: $156,000 - $192,000

Location: Miami, FL or Seattle, WA (or easily accessible to)

﻿Ability to travel up to 30%

Learn more

Why Join Us

  • Opportunity to directly impact customer success and long-term growth
  • Work with cutting-edge solutions transforming infrastructure and capital programs

Our mission is to power the next era of underground exploration – saving time, money, lives, and the planet. We are focused, intentional, confident, and hard working. We solve big problems, but we are approachable, open-minded, and love hard questions.

jobs.excerpt: Serverfarm is a leading developer and operator of data centers with over 750+ locations and key customer relationships in 45 countries.
jobs.description:
Serverfarm is a leading developer and operator of data centers with over 750+ locations and key customer relationships in 45 countries. We're revolutionizing how data centers operate across North America, Western Europe, and Israel, serving the world's leading technology and hyperscale companies. With Manulife Investment Management's acquisition in 2023 and our award-winning InCommand platform we're positioned for explosive growth as AI adoption and cloud migration drive unprecedented demand for data center capacity.
A career at Serverfarm means being at the forefront of digital infrastructure innovation, where your work directly impacts how the world's data is managed and secured. As we target 4x growth over the next four years, you'll have unprecedented opportunities to take on new challenges, develop cutting-edge skills, and grow your career across our expanding global operations.
Join our team of innovators and help shape the future of sustainable data centers while building a career without boundaries.

The next InCommand is a new solution, built on a new technology stack, designed from the ground up for the way modern data centers, including high-density and AI infrastructure, are operated. It will be delivered as a cloud service and be deployable in customers' own environments, built API-first, and developed with an agent-assisted engineering practice in which coding agents work from specifications under human review. Our own facilities are the first customer, so everything we build is proven in real, live operations before anyone else sees it.

Everything the product shows an operator starts at the site: the power chain, the cooling plant, the IT equipment, the building systems, each speaking its own protocol. Getting that data in reliably, from the first facility to the hundredth, is a discipline of its own, and as Integration Lead you own it. It is a clean-sheet design with a rare advantage: a real estate of live data centers to learn from and the people who have kept their data flowing for a decade sitting beside you. You partner closely with Architecture, Product Management and Developer Platform, and you lead and manage a small integrations team that grows as the sites multiply.

Key Accountabilities

    • Design and own the edge collector: store-and-forward, buffering, configuration and upgrades across a fleet of sites, secure outbound-only connectivity across OT and IT network boundaries.

    • Define, in partnership with Architecture, the contract by which site data enters the platform, and own the collector side of it.

    • Build or select the protocol adapters for building automation, power and cooling systems, IT equipment and monitoring gateways, each with a conformance test.

    • Own point mapping and normalisation into the unified asset, power and cooling model: templates, discovery, bulk mapping and validation of a site's data before it goes live.

    • Automate site onboarding so that bringing a new site live takes days rather than weeks, and measure it by the time it takes to onboard the next one.

    • Make telemetry health visible and owned: data flow, gaps and staleness, with the alerts to match.

    • Assess the telemetry stack in use today and recommend its future.

Required Skills

    • 8+ years in software or controls engineering, including 3+ leading integrations for industrial IoT, building automation, DCIM or similar operational-technology products.

    • You have integrated equipment over the protocols a data center speaks (BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP and RTU, SNMP, OPC UA, Redfish or IPMI, MQTT), reading vendors' register maps and making them work.

    • You have designed and shipped collector or agent software running at the edge across a fleet of sites, with store-and-forward, remote configuration and upgrades, and secure outbound-only connectivity (TLS, mutual TLS, certificate management).

    • You have built point mapping and normalisation at scale, with discovery, templates and validation, and made each site faster to onboard than the last.

    • You have delivered site data into a platform through MQTT brokers (EMQX, HiveMQ or equivalent) and Kafka-compatible streaming (Kafka, Redpanda or equivalent), landing in time-series storage (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB or equivalent).

    • You have packaged and operated edge software in containers (Docker, k3s or equivalent) with fleet or device management across many sites.

    • You have written adapters, mapping tooling and automation in Python.

    • You have built monitoring of telemetry health (data flow, gaps, staleness) with OpenTelemetry, Grafana or equivalent.

Preferred Skills

    • Built on industrial edge or SCADA platforms (Ignition, Node-RED, Telegraf or equivalent) and decided when to build and when to buy at the edge.

    • Modelled building and equipment data with Project Haystack or Brick Schema, or used MQTT Sparkplug B.

    • Applied operational-technology security standards (IEC 62443 or equivalent) and OT/IT network segmentation.

    • Worked with data-center electrical and mechanical systems (switchgear, UPS, PDUs and busways, chillers and CRAHs, liquid cooling) and the data they produce.

    • Led the evaluation and migration of a telemetry or monitoring platform.

    • Led or managed a small team of engineers.

Hi, my name is Justin Howie, Head of Brand Studio at Customer.io, and I'm looking for a Senior Brand Designer to join our small, close-knit creative team.

Brand Studio is the creative engine behind how Customer.io shows up in the world, from product launches and campaigns to the website and live events. We move fast, care deeply about craft, and operate at the intersection of strategy and production.

Our team is moving from a production function to a systems and platform team, powered by AI and self-serve tooling. AI sits at the center of how we work, and you'll shape how Brand Studio and the wider company use it for ideation, production, and self-serve creation. You'll own brand design execution across our biggest moments, and you'll build the templates, components, and AI-assisted workflows that let the rest of the company create on brand without waiting on us. You'll work closely with our Brand Designers, Motion Designer, Web Engineer, Product Designers, and Marketers.

This is a senior role with a runway. We're looking for a highly seasoned designer with strong business acumen, who manages up well and mentors others, and who we expect to grow into a Staff or Art Director role once you've proven yourself here.

If you lead with Design Craft, live at the frontier of AI for brand and creative, and want to build systems that help a whole company look and sound like one brand, this role is for you.

What we value

  • Design Craft with speed — You hold high standards and know how to hit deadlines.
  • Curiosity about what's next — You stay on the leading edge of brand and creative, from new AI tools to new techniques, and you share what you learn.
  • AI-native by default — You reach for AI first, test what works on real projects, and teach others how.
  • Collaboration over silos — You work closely with designers, developers, and marketers, and the output gets better because of it.
  • Bias for action — You'd rather ship something great and iterate than wait for perfect, and you're energized by building.
  • Clear communication — You ask the right questions, set clear expectations, and keep stakeholders in the loop without being asked.
  • Leadership beyond the work — You mentor the people around you, manage up with confidence, and think like an owner of the business.

What you’ll do

  • Own brand design execution for product launches, using AI-native workflows to take concepts to launch-ready assets in days
  • Design website pages, templates, and components in close collaboration with our Senior Web Engineer
  • Develop campaign assets for digital and out-of-home advertising, produced with AI-native workflows so we can test more concepts and ship more variants

  • Build and maintain brand templates and libraries, including Figma libraries, prompt libraries, and custom tooling that turn our guidelines into on-brand output anyone can use
  • Own our AI creative stack: choose the tools, set the standards, and share what you learn with Brand Studio and the wider company
  • Enable teams across the org through workshops, playbooks, and guardrails that keep AI-assisted work on brand
  • Translate briefs from Product Marketing and Demand Generation into creative concepts, executed end to end
  • Partner with Product Design to keep brand and product expression aligned
  • Mentor designers on the team, give clear critique, and raise the Design Craft bar across Brand Studio
  • Work with Brand Studio leadership and senior stakeholders on priorities, tradeoffs, and the business case for creative investment

What we're looking for

  • 7+ years of hands-on brand or visual design experience, ideally in-house at a B2B SaaS or tech company, with a record of senior-level ownership
  • A portfolio that shows range: brand systems, campaign work, product launch design, web and landing pages, event and out-of-home, and AI-assisted work with a clear account of your process
  • Expert proficiency in Figma, including building and maintaining components and libraries within a brand system, and fluency in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong typography and layout instincts, and a track record of turning complex technical concepts into clear, compelling visuals
  • Business acumen: you connect design decisions to company goals, make the case for creative investment, and communicate fluently with executives
  • The ability to manage up and lead without authority: setting expectations, surfacing risks early, and driving alignment across Marketing, Product, and Exec
  • Mentorship experience: you've coached other designers and raised the craft bar around you

jobs.excerpt: FunctiebeschrijvingVoor een lopend backendproject zoeken we een testanalist die hiaten in de testingaanpak in kaart brengt en wegwerkt.
jobs.description:
Functiebeschrijving

Voor een lopend backendproject zoeken we een testanalist die hiaten in de testingaanpak in kaart brengt en wegwerkt. In deze rol bouw je mee aan een QA-proces met focus op testen, review en monitoring.

Je verantwoordelijkheden

In een eerste fase ligt de nadruk op het beheren en afbouwen van testing debt.

  • Je analyseert de huidige testcoverage van het systeem grondig, inclusief de review van geautomatiseerde tests.
  • Je identificeert en documenteert testing debt en testgaps.
  • Je werkt een plan uit om de bestaande achterstand weg te werken en de testcoverage en efficiëntie te verhogen.
  • Je voert statische tests uit op functionele requirementsdocumenten.
  • Je beoordeelt de testbaarheid van het systeem, waaronder services en batches, en start indien nodig een verbetertraject op. Daarbij beschrijf je ook de nood aan mocks, stubs en drivers.
  • Je brengt de relevante stakeholders en three amigo's in kaart, neemt contact op en verzamelt de nodige input voor de verschillende testitems.
  • Je werkt samen met test automation engineers aan een geautomatiseerde regressieset.
  • Je legt discrepanties bloot tussen requirements, het systeem en de testcases, en analyseert en interpreteert die verschillen.
  • Je formuleert verbetervoorstellen voor functionele analyses en voor het systeem.
  • Je rapporteert over de voortgang rond testing debt en vastgesteld ongewenst systeemgedrag.

In een tweede fase neem je testactiviteiten op binnen een Agile Scrum-werking.

  • Je reviewt analysedocumenten en user stories vanuit functioneel perspectief.
  • Je definieert testcases en werkt ze gestructureerd uit.
  • Je voert testcases uit en interpreteert de resultaten van testuitvoeringen.
  • Je reviewt geautomatiseerde testcases.

Daarnaast neem je doorlopend een coördinerende rol op binnen de testwerking.

  • Je coördineert de testomgeving zodat de nodige materiële resources beschikbaar zijn voor het testproject.
  • Je werkt actief samen met de projectverantwoordelijke, de testcoördinator en het management om een vlotte communicatie te verzekeren over de inpassing van het testproject in het globale project en in lijn met de kwaliteitsstrategie.
  • Je stelt de gekozen teststrategie voor en verdedigt die.
  • Je stelt testrapporten op en beheert ze.
  • Je vertegenwoordigt de kwaliteitswaarden van het testcompetentiecentrum binnen de projectteams.
  • Je coacht ontwikkelaars rond testautomatisatie en ondersteunt analisten bij het bewaken van de testbaarheid.
  • Je stemt af met het testcompetentiecentrum.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Je hebt een grondige kennis van testmethodologieën, testtaken en testprocessen.
  • Een ISTQB Foundation- of Advanced-certificaat is een pluspunt.
  • Je bent vertrouwd met testmanagementtools zoals Testlink.
  • Je hebt ervaring met issue- en projectmanagementtools zoals Jira en met collaboratietools zoals Confluence.
  • Je bent vertrouwd met testautomation en API-testingtools zoals SOAP UI, REST Assured, Selenium, JUnit, Spring Boot Test en Postman.
  • Je hebt kennis van REST- en SOAP-services en kunt deze meenemen in de uitwerking van testscenario's.
  • Je beschikt over basiskennis van development practices en testparadigma's zoals continuous integration en TDD.
  • Je hebt basiskennis van UML en BPMN.
  • Je beschikt over basiskennis van Java, JavaScript, SQL, HTML, Git en SVN.
  • Je bent vertrouwd met courante ontwikkelomgevingen en tooling zoals Eclipse, IntelliJ, Jenkins en containeromgevingen.
  • Je hebt sterke relationele vaardigheden en werkt vlot samen met verschillende stakeholders.
  • Je drukt je vlot uit in het Nederlands en het Frans.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

Abnormal AI is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer - I (MLE) to join the Misdirected Email Detection (MED) team. This is a highly applied role for MLEs who thrive on building, iterating, and experimenting. Rather than focusing solely on model training, you will also be responsible for developing practical, end-to-end ML solutions. This includes but is not limited to generating and refining features, testing hypotheses, averaging signals, and translating research ideas into production-grade systems, all while collaborating cross-functionally to turn customer needs into measurable product improvements. The ideal candidate combines a tinkerer's mindset with technical rigor, balancing innovation with production excellence to drive experimentation, scale solutions, and deliver reliable detection capabilities that create meaningful customer impact in real-world environments.

What you will do

  • Partner with Product Manager, Tech Lead and engineering stakeholders to align technical deliverables to roadmap milestones and ensure successful GA launches across supported environments.
  • Own the full ML lifecycle for Misdirected Email, including data wrangling, feature engineering, model training and evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. Deliver iterative improvements with measurable reliability and customer impact.
  • Run rigorous experiments and evaluations (offline metrics, online A/B testing, post-launch monitoring), set thresholds, and conduct targeted error analysis to prevent regressions.
  • Communicate effectively across time zones, maintain high-quality technical documentation, and contribute to shared team knowledge.
  • Participate in shared on-call rotation for owned components, with responsibilities focused on detection efficacy and realtime scoring systems. Priorities include resolving efficacy-related alerts, investigating high-visibility false positives, and addressing reported false positives/false negatives from customers or internal teams.

Must Haves

  • BS degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Information Systems, or a related engineering or quantitative field.
  • 1+ years building and operating applied ML features in production systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to implement and reason about algorithms, develop features, average and combine signals, and apply numerical computing effectively.
  • Demonstrated ability to interrogate production data, identify behavioral or trend shifts, and launch targeted experiments to improve model efficacy.
  • Understanding of online vs offline pipelines, data tables and labeling workflows to effectively leverage tooling to support safe, scalable model deployments.
  • Experience running offline metrics, online A/B tests, setting thresholds, and monitoring drift and performance, with guardrails and rollback strategies to ensure reliable iteration.
  • Strong written and asynchronous communication skills. Effective working independently and across distributed, cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with our stack: Python, Go, AWS, Spark, Databricks
  • Experience in email security/DLP or misdirected email prevention domains and customer-focused ML deployments.

  • Experience with operationalising research into reliable, customer-facing systems, with emphasis on scalability, performance, and detection accuracy in real-world environments.
  • Prior experience contributing to a small team or project to deliver a feature or component from scratch.

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Success & Operations
jobs.excerpt: The ideal candidate will be located in the Eastern or Central time zones.
jobs.description:
The ideal candidate will be located in the Eastern or Central time zones.

The Manager, Customer Success & Operations leads the team responsible for delivering an exceptional customer experience throughout the operational customer lifecycle, from quotation and account setup through order fulfillment, pricing, standing orders, accounts receivable support, supply management, and ongoing customer engagement. This role owns the strategy and execution of Stago's operational customer success model, ensuring customers experience proactive communication, reliable execution, rapid issue resolution, and a consistent sense of partnership throughout their relationship with Stago. The Manager is responsible for evolving the team beyond transactional customer support into a proactive customer success organization that understands its customers, anticipates their needs, identifies risks before they become escalations, and uses data and customer insights to continuously improve the experience. Serving as a critical connector between customers and Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, Applications Support, Marketing, and other functions, the Manager identifies and removes friction across the customer journey while ensuring clear accountability for customer outcomes.
Success requires a leader who combines customer advocacy, operational discipline, analytical thinking, people leadership, and commercial awareness while building a team that takes ownership not simply for completing transactions, but for helping customers succeed.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Customer Success Strategy & Account Health
• Develop and implement Stago's operational Customer Success strategy, establishing proactive engagement standards, customer segmentation, and differentiated service approaches based on customer needs and complexity.
• Establish customer health indicators using operational, financial, supply, satisfaction, and engagement data to identify emerging risks and opportunities.
• Develop processes for proactively engaging at-risk customers and coordinating corrective action with Sales and other stakeholders to protect customer satisfaction and retention.
• Ensure the team understands assigned customers, including account structures, ordering patterns, operational requirements, contracts, and potential service risks.
Customer Lifecycle & Relationship Management
• Oversee the operational customer experience from onboarding through ongoing account management, ensuring clear ownership, responsiveness, and consistent execution.
• Establish expectations for proactive communication, issue resolution, escalation management, and follow-through on customer commitments.
• Ensure complex customer concerns are resolved with urgency, transparency, and accountability while maintaining customer confidence and trust.
• Identify opportunities to simplify the customer journey, reduce operational friction, and improve the ease of doing business with Stago.
Commercial Operations & Revenue Enablement
• Partner with Sales to support effective commercial execution, customer onboarding, strategic account initiatives, and operational requirements for complex customer organizations.
• Oversee processes supporting quotation preparation, account setup, pricing implementation, contract administration, standing orders, and customer account maintenance.
• Ensure customer insights, purchasing trends, potential sales opportunities, and retention risks are identified and communicated to the appropriate Sales stakeholders.
• Maintain clear accountability between Sales ownership of commercial strategy and customer relationships and Customer
Success & Operations ownership of operational execution and customer experience.
Pricing, Order Management & ERP Governance
• Oversee accurate and timely customer order processing, standing orders, releases, returns, credits, and related ERP transactions.
• Ensure approved customer pricing, contract terms, customer master data, and delivery requirements are accurately maintained within applicable systems.
• Establish appropriate controls and audits to identify and reduce pricing discrepancies, order errors, preventable credits, rebills, and other operational issues.
• Partner with Finance, Sales, IT, and other stakeholders to resolve system or process issues and improve data integrity, automation, and operational efficiency.
Accounts Receivable & Financial Stewardship
• Partner with Finance and Sales to support accounts receivable performance, proactively address aging balances, and improve resolution of customer payment issues.
• Ensure the team identifies and helps resolve billing discrepancies, missing purchase orders, pricing errors, deductions, credits, and other issues contributing to delayed payments.
• Monitor customer payment trends and escalate material financial or customer risks appropriately.
• Identify recurring operational root causes of payment delays and implement process improvements to reduce preventable issues.

Supply, Inventory & Demand Coordination

• Partner with Supply Chain, Marketing, and Sales to align customer ordering patterns, standing orders, demand forecasts, and product availability.
• Establish consistent processes for communicating shortages, backorders, allocations, product transitions, and recovery plans to affected customers.
• Oversee customer-facing implementation of sequestering and allocation policies, ensuring fair, accurate, and transparent execution.
• Identify significant changes in customer demand and coordinate with appropriate stakeholders to minimize supply disruptions and protect customer continuity.
Data Analytics & Continuous Improvement
• Establish and monitor KPIs related to customer satisfaction, responsiveness, order accuracy, pricing accuracy, issue resolution, customer health, and operational efficiency.
• Analyze customer ordering trends, account activity, payment patterns, service issues, and operational data to identify risks, opportunities, and recurring process gaps.
• Translate customer and operational insights into actionable recommendations for Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, Marketing, and management.
• Lead initiatives to simplify workflows, strengthen controls, improve systems, and reduce friction through process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement.
People Leadership & Talent Development
• Promote a culture of continuous improvement in which employees are expected to identify problems, recommend solutions, and take appropriate initiative.
• Recruit, onboard, coach, develop, and retain a high-performing Customer Success & Operations team.
• Establish clear individual performance expectations aligned with customer outcomes and business performance.
• Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, coaching conversations, performance reviews, and development planning.
• Develop team capabilities in customer communication, relationship management, ERP proficiency, project management, analytics, financial acumen, problem solving, and commercial awareness.
• Coach employees to confidently navigate complex customer conversations involving shortages, pricing, accounts receivable, sequestering, standing orders, and other operational challenges.
• Create an environment in which employees are empowered to solve problems while understanding appropriate decision rights and escalation requirements.
• Hold employees accountable for accuracy, responsiveness, communication, ownership, and follow-through.
• Build cross-training, development, and succession plans to reduce key-person dependencies and create career progression within the function.
• Recognize strong performance while addressing performance gaps promptly and constructively.
• Reinforce the expectation that the team's responsibility does not end when a transaction is processed or an internal task is completed; success requires confirmation that the customer's need has been addressed and the loop has been closed.

Education and/or Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Finance, Healthcare Administration, Operations Management, or related discipline required.
  • Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in Customer Success, Commercial Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Service, Supply Chain,
    Account Management, or a related function required.
  • Minimum 3 years of people leadership experience or demonstrated leadership of complex teams and projects required.
  • Healthcare, medical device, diagnostics, life sciences, or another regulated industry experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting hospitals, IDNs, distributors, or complex B2B customer organizations preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex customer-facing operational processes and cross functional projects.
  • Experience with ERP and CRM systems strongly preferred.
  • Experience with pricing, order management, accounts receivable, contracts, customer master data, forecasting, or demand planning strongly preferred
  • Travel up to 25% of the time including international travel

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

We offer an extensive benefit and compensation package that includes medical, dental, vision, FSA, 401k, PTO, life and disability insurance, as well as a comprehensive leave program. Pay anticipated for this position in New Jersey is from $100,000 to $130,000 per year, depending on a number of factors. This role is also anticipated to be eligible to participate in a bonus plan which is associated with this position. In the ordinary course of business, compensation and benefits programs may change based upon the Company’s needs.

jobs.description:
What you will do:

As an independent contractor, you will be working from home as a freelance transcriptionist, making an accurate text document of the contents of audio, video, typed or handwritten material.

We transcribe oral history interviews (with WWII veterans, women in academia, farmers, midwives…), focus groups, financial forecasts or quarterly reports, tech webinars, commencement addresses, interviews about NGO work, educational reform or health care access, or anything else you could think of, and even occasionally TV shows. We don't do medical transcription.

This project is specific to the textile industry and we are seeking individuals with this experience or background.

Who we’re looking for:

  • Fast and accurate typists (minimum of 80 wpm), who can deliver files within 24 hours or less for an hour-long file.
  • People with a wide range of interests or educational experiences. As the subject matter varies broadly, it’s easier to understand the flow of conversation when you have some context for what is being discussed.
  • Transcriptionists who are fluently bilingual or multilingual are always welcome.

Requirements

  • Strong language, style, and punctuation skills, and the capability and willingness to follow our in-house style manual as well as project-specific instructions.
  • Ability to verify names and terms via brief internet research. Much of the work we do is for archives, so these transcripts will become part of a historical record and need to be of high quality to reflect that permanence.

What you will need

  • A reliable internet connection is a must. ATC sends project files via Dropbox links, so no special FTP setup is necessary.
  • For confidentiality reasons, we require that you use an email address that no one else has access to.
  • Transcripts should be returned to ATC as .doc files. You are not strictly required to use Microsoft Word; you can also use Open Office or some other program that has the capability to save as a .doc file as long as the formatting requirements are met and the functionality of the end product is indistinguishable from a document completed in Word.
  • ATC highly recommends the use of transcription software controlled via hotkeys or a foot pedal, and the use of good-quality headphones to cut down on ambient noise while you are transcribing.

How do I get hired as a freelance transcriptionist?

No calls, please. File your online application here and include:

  • Current resume (PDF)
  • Cover letter (PDF)
  • A screenshot of the results from a three-minute typing test on www.typingtest.com (our minimum requirement is 80 wpm with 98% accuracy)

This role requires strong written communication skills and cultural awareness that allow you to capture the heart of Avaaz’ campaigns and powerfully translate them into Dutch language.

The successful candidate for this part-time position (20 hours/week) will work closely with the Dutch language lead and with the Member Engagement and Community Petitions teams, and they will report to an Avaaz staffer. Please note that this position is on a freelance/independent contractor basis.

  • Monitor and enhance the Dutch Avaaz website and other tools for functionality and language errors, supporting clear and effective communication with members.
  • Support the Dutch campaign team to write and edit excellent campaign materials such as briefings, advocacy letters, and press releases. Translate and/or edit other materials as necessary: Media material, content for social media etc.
  • Reviewing, managing, and supporting the petitions published by Dutch members on the Avaaz Community Petitions website.

Qualifications

  • Excellent written and oral communication, and translation skills in Dutch, combined with creative thinking to craft engaging texts.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, the Avaaz team’s working language.
  • Professionalism, efficiency, and results-oriented delivery on short timelines.
  • Flexibility and ability to adapt to (somewhat) varying weekly workloads.
  • Passion and commitment to global justice, citizen empowerment, and social change.
  • Strong teamwork skills, comfortable in a highly collaborative culture, and a hierarchical team structure.

This is an independent contractor role, paid at an hourly rate of €25,- depending on experience and location. Contractors are responsible for their own taxes and statutory contributions in their country of residence.

Avaaz is a virtual organization, with most of our work done online. Our staff and contractors are based in locations all over the world. For this position, the candidate would ideally be based in the European/Middle East/African time zones.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer, Finance and Modeling
jobs.excerpt: At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions.
jobs.description:
At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.
We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.
If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.

As an Analytics Engineer (Finance & Modeling), you'll own the metrics, reporting and reconciliation our financial decisions rest on, turning subscription and transaction data across OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall and Custody Navigator into numbers the business can defend. As that foundation becomes automatic, the work shifts toward forecasting and modeling.

You won't start from scratch. Our dbt project is live on Databricks with a star-schema finance mart in production and documented in Unity Catalog. What's missing is the layer on top, and that layer is yours. We also run an internal AI agent that answers business questions in Slack off the semantic layer, so every metric you define and test becomes a question Finance can ask directly rather than queue.

What you'll accomplish:

  • Governed metrics. Add the definitions the finance mart doesn't have yet (ARR, renewal rate, churn, CAC), versioned in dbt and documented in Unity Catalog, with the tests that make each one defensible, and wired into the agent so Finance can ask them directly.
  • Reporting Finance can run without you. Move the recurring finance pack into marimo, retire the Tableau views behind it, and turn a monthly hand-build into something that runs on a schedule.
  • Numbers that reconcile. Reconcile transactions across the app stores, payment processors, subscription systems and the ledger, with automated checks that alert rather than surface at close. Route discrepancies upstream with the evidence attached and turn each one into a test. You build the checks and escalate. Accounting owns the treatment.
  • Forecasting for Finance. Cohort subscriber and revenue projection, and aggregate renewal and retention forecasting, feeding the CFO's forecast and board reporting. LTV by acquisition source, feeding paid spend allocation with Growth. Pricing and promo impact, modeled before we ship rather than measured after. Individual churn propensity and uplift follow once there's a retention motion ready to act on the scores.
  • Models ship as scored tables in dbt and Unity Catalog, with tests, lineage and a definition the agent can answer from. Not as notebooks.

Who you are:

  • Statistically rigorous. You know why a cohort curve is the wrong shape, what a model is leaking, and when a result is noise.
  • Fluent in finance, and unwilling to let a number you can't explain go out the door. When two systems disagree, you find out why and tell the people upstream.
  • An engineer who owns the number end to end, from a CFO's question through the model, the test, the report and the conversation that follows. A spreadsheet nobody can reproduce reads to you as a liability.
  • AI-proficient in practice, not in theory. Claude Code, coding agents and agent SDKs are part of our daily loop, and we expect you to already work this way. A lot of what used to be a week of modeling work is now an afternoon, and we're hiring for people who have internalized that.
  • Willing to wear several hats. This is a small team supporting four brands. Some weeks you're deep in a retention model, some weeks you're chasing an app store discrepancy or unblocking someone else's dashboard. The scope above is the center of the role, not a fence around it.
  • Motivated by work that matters. Families rely on these products during real moments in their lives.

What you bring:

  • 3+ years in analytics engineering, data science, BI engineering or advanced analytics.
  • Statistical modeling shipped into a business process: forecasting, survival or cohort analysis, or propensity.
  • Measuring the lift from a price change or a growth experiment. You don't need to have designed the test, but you need to be able to read the result honestly and say what it's worth.
  • Subscription metrics you've built and defended to a finance stakeholder: ARR/MRR, renewal, churn, LTV/CAC, or cohort revenue.
  • Strong SQL and real dimensional modeling. You've designed marts, not just queried them.
  • Python and Git as daily habits.
Nice to have, not a dealbreaker:
  • dbt, Databricks and Unity Catalog, or a comparable lakehouse.
  • Reconciling transactional data to a financial system of record.
  • Code-first notebook reporting (marimo, Hex, Streamlit, Quarto).

Atticus is a Melbourne-based scale-up founded in 2017 that offers the leading technology in document fact-checking. We are on a mission to bring more truth to the world of business. That said, here are some real things you might’ve done if you had been here this month:

Job Type Full-time : Location: Fort Worth | Department: Technology | Work Location Type: #remote #hybrid

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

At the scale IREN operates, storage is a critical performance system. Every GPU in our clusters depends on data moving reliably, at speed and at volume. When storage falls short, AI training stalls, inference degrades and our customers feel it immediately.

The role of Senior Storage Engineers owns storage infrastructure end to end. This is a hands-on, deeply technical role. You will design and deploy storage systems, keep them performing under demanding AI workloads, and troubleshoot complex faults quickly and decisively when things go wrong.

The right person has spent years with their hands in large-scale storage environments. They know what good looks like, they know what failure looks like, and they know how to get from one to the other. They are comfortable working with significant autonomy, and they take personal ownership of production uptime.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build and commission high-performance storage systems that serve large GPU compute clusters, ensuring storage architecture meets the throughput and latency demands of AI training and inference workloads.
  • Own the full operational lifecycle of storage infrastructure from initial deployment through day-to-day performance management, capacity growth and end-of-life planning.
  • Manage and maintain storage networking fabrics connecting storage systems to GPU compute, ensuring the interconnect is never the bottleneck.
  • Evaluate new storage hardware, software and approaches as the technology landscape evolves and IREN's footprint grows.
  • Monitor storage system health, performance and capacity continuously; define meaningful thresholds and act on them before they become incidents.
  • Tune storage systems for the specific I/O patterns of AI workloads and document what works.
  • Plan and manage storage capacity proactively, working across teams to anticipate demand ahead of new cluster deployments.
  • Maintain high availability across storage tiers; design and validate resilience mechanisms so that single points of failure are understood and mitigated.
  • Diagnose and resolve storage incidents with urgency.
  • Conduct thorough root cause analysis following significant incidents; produce clear write-ups and implement changes that prevent recurrence.
  • Participate in on-call rotation to provide coverage for storage-related production issues; act as the escalation point for storage during major incidents.
  • Work closely with technology and operations teams on new cluster builds, ensuring storage is ready and validated.

Requirements

  • Seven or more years of hands-on storage engineering experience in production environments, with meaningful time spent operating storage at significant scale.
  • A track record of deploying, operating and troubleshooting storage systems that serve demanding compute workloads.
  • Experience working in or alongside data center environments; comfortable in the physical layer as well as the software layer.
