jobs.description:
Based in Nashville, Tennessee, Mosaic Consulting Group helps businesses of all sizes and across all industries leverage their investment in UKG and SAP Technologies. We are more than a consulting company; we are a highly skilled team delivering value and exceptional service to our clients. Every day we strive to live up to our promise: Make a difference and inspire confidence.

Thanks to our commitment to exceptional client service and a thriving team culture, Mosaic has earned recognition on the Inc. 5000 list for four consecutive years, is a certified woman-owned business, and has been certified as a Great Place to Work for five years running. In 2025, we were honored to be named one of the Best Workplaces in Consulting & Professional Services™ and proudly recognized as the 2025 UKG Partner of the Year.

Due to our rapid growth, we are looking for a remote Payroll Consultant to join our team. As a Payroll Consultant at Mosaic, you will be responsible for end-to-end payroll processing for multiple clients across varying payroll frequencies (weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly, monthly). This role ensures accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery while managing client relationships, resolving payroll issues, and driving process efficiencies within a multi-state environment.

What you’ll do:

Payroll Processing & Delivery

  • Process payroll for multiple clients with varying pay frequencies (weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly, monthly)
  • Validate payroll data including earnings, deductions, taxes, and adjustments
  • Review and balance payroll prior to finalization and transmission
  • Manage off-cycle payrolls, bonuses, and adjustments as needed
  • Ensure payroll is processed accurately and delivered within client deadlines

Client Management

  • Serve as primary payroll contact for assigned client portfolio
  • Communicate payroll timelines, requirements, and issue resolution clearly
  • Provide consultative support on payroll best practices and compliance
  • Maintain strong relationships and high client satisfaction

Compliance & Tax Management

  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local payroll regulations
  • Support tax filings, amendments, and quarter/year-end activities (W-2s, 941s, etc.)
  • Monitor changes in payroll legislation impacting clients

Data Validation & Issue Resolution

  • Audit payroll inputs/outputs for discrepancies
  • Investigate and resolve payroll errors, variances, and client inquiries
  • Partner with internal teams (tax, benefits, HRIS) for issue resolution

System & Process Management

  • Utilize payroll systems (e.g., UKG Pro, ADP, Workday) to process payroll
  • Maintain and update payroll configurations, earnings/deductions, and employee data
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve efficiency
  • Document SOPs and maintain payroll processing documentation

Time & Billing Accountability

  • Track time accurately across clients, projects, and payroll cycles
  • Meet utilization and billable hour targets
  • Support forecasting and workload balancing across client portfolio

Model Mosaic’s customer service vision of Guide, Anticipate, Exceed

Position: Coordinator, Strategic Projects & Partnerships

Status: Full-time, indefinite

Team: Strategy, Innovation, and Impact and Policy and Strategic Partnerships

Reports to: VP, Strategy, Innovation, and Impact and VP, Policy and Strategic Partnerships

Language(s): English

Location: Remote, within Canada

Starting Salary: CAD $69,940.48/year

Deadline for Applications: 8 November, 2026, 11:59pm ET

ABOUT THE EQUALITY FUND

The Equality Fund is transforming the way that resources—and power—flow into the hands of women, girls, and trans people worldwide. Designed by feminists for feminists, it is a model for sustainably resourcing feminist movements everywhere, through global grantmaking, gender-lens investing, policy advocacy, and feminist philanthropy. Launched in 2019, the Equality Fund has activated $100 million to date which flows to more than 1,800 organizations working across 100 countries.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Reporting to the VP, Strategy, Innovation, and Impact and VP, Policy and Strategic Partnerships, the Coordinator plays a critical function in managing and ensuring the success of processes, projects, and initiatives across two dynamic teams: Strategy, Innovation, and Impact (SII) and Policy and Strategic Partnerships (PSP).

SCOPE & RESPONSIBILITIES

Cross Functional

  • Acts as bilateral partner focal point for existing and prospective partners, coordinating inquiries, quarterly partnership meetings, due diligence requests, tracking action items, and other requests for information
  • Supports day-to-day team organization and operations with items such as scheduling, team meetings, engagement tracking, writing briefing notes, communication, expense submissions, timeline tracking, event logistics, presentations;
  • Supports coordination of team retreat planning and other team/stakeholder events; including travel and retreat budgets and logistics;
  • Liaises with Finance colleagues on behalf of the SII and PSP teams to facilitate key financial administrative processes including procurement, budgeting, invoices, administrative support, expense claims, payments, and purchase orders;
  • Coordinates development and implementation of administrative policies, systems, and procedures;
  • Supports and contributes to cross-organizational initiatives (ex. representing the team on internal working groups)
  • Acts in accordance with our policies around nurturing a safe and respectful work environment; never engaging in harassment, coercion, sexual exploitation or abuse of any form, or anything else contrary to our code of conduct.

Policy and Strategic Partnerships

  • Manages and produces virtual and in-person events including project timeline, technology, registration, and troubleshooting;
  • Coordination of visits and conferences including program, catering, registration, hotels, per diems, meeting spaces;
  • Manage and support Salesforce usage across the team, including: managing accounts, campaigns, contacts, and generating reports.

Strategy, Innovation, and Impact

  • Coordinate initiatives, such as the development of the Equality Fund’s annual plan, annual report to government donors, quarterly key performance measure reporting, and evaluation and learning initiatives;
  • Coordinate internal and external Learning & Impact storytelling meetings and support content management for the internal Impact Library, external website;
  • Support the Vice President, SII on special projects as needed.

QUALIFICATIONS & COMPETENCIES

Experience

  • Strong organizational skills, and ability to manage complexity
  • Effective written communication skills, and the ability to develop policies and procedures to simplify internal and external processes
  • Professional working proficiency in English
  • Ability to learn and utilize multiple platforms including project management software, data analytics software, collaboration suites/platforms, enterprise resource planning, customer relationship management platforms, and generative AI; experience with PowerBI is an asset
  • Demonstrated high ethical standards, integrity, honesty, and ability to work with sensitive information in a confidential manner
  • Ability and willingness to conduct oneself at work with high standards of ethics, integrity, and honesty
  • Commitment to the work and values of the Equality Fund, which include Anti-Racism, Anti-Oppression, and Intersectionality; Feminist Leadership; Accountability; and Radical Love
  • Professional working proficiency in French, Spanish, or another language is an asset

Adaptive Competencies

  • Flexible and responsive, understanding how to adapt processes to shifting organizational priorities; an orientation towards seeking and integrating feedback while continuing to build adaptability and a growth mindset.
  • Demonstrates respect and a willingness to arrive at a solution when conflict arises.
  • Collaborates within and across departments, knowing where and how to follow up.
  • Able to process information across many mediums, switching contexts as needed.
  • High emotional intelligence with the ability to build trust, foster collaboration, and navigate complex interpersonal dynamics.
  • Ability to thrive in a nuanced, dynamic, complex environment and respond effectively to changing priorities and challenges.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and persuasively to diverse audiences.
  • Strong coordination and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify issues and contribute to solutions.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be legally eligible to work in Canada
  • Available to travel 3-4 times per year for up to 3 weeks total per year.
  • Occasional evening and/or weekend work may be required when coordinating with people in other time zones
  • Willing and able to work remotely on mostly computer-based work

OUR ENVIRONMENT OF CARE

  • We trust our talented team and are pleased to offer a flexible and virtual work environment.
  • We are driven by our values: anti-racism, anti-oppression, and intersectionality; feminist leadership; accountability; and radical love. We believe our values are realized through collaboration, a growth and learning mindset, emotional intelligence, diversity, authenticity, a global perspective, care, and building networks. We work to share power and create space for everyone to lead.
  • Equality Fund is proud to offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package which has no waiting period and includes 4 weeks paid vacation, paid sick time, parental leave top up, medical benefits, life insurance, Group RRSP, paid birthday off, and more.
  • We root our salary decisions in fairness and role-based evaluation—not self-advocacy or negotiation skill, which are often shaped by privilege, confidence, or cultural norms. As such, we provide our best offer from the start of the recruitment process based on our compensation philosophy and practices.
  • Equality Fund is committed to providing and maintaining a safe and respectful workplace. We do not tolerate harassment, coercion, sexual exploitation, or abuse of any form. We recognize that those behaviors are often rooted in abuse of power, which is contrary to EF's mission to make a more equitable world for women, girls, and trans people.
  • Equality Fund is an equal opportunity employer. We believe deeply in equality and value diversity of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, national origin, disability, and all other protected grounds under the Ontario Human Rights Code. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and positionalities, and are committed to providing an accessible candidate experience. To let us know how we can make an accommodation or adjustment to facilitate the selection process and beyond, please reach out to .
  • This posting is for a new position.

SELECTION PROCESS

  • Use of AI technology in the screening, recruitment, or selection process: Every application is reviewed by a person on our team, and people make every decision about who moves forward and who we hire. We don't use AI to screen, score, or rank candidates. We may use Fathom, an AI notetaking tool, to record and transcribe virtual interviews so we can stay focused on the conversation and keep accurate notes.
  • Equality Fund’s People, Equity, and Culture team will work with the hiring manager to do an initial screening of applicants. Please make sure to detail your experience in your resume/cover letter to ensure the committee has the information they need to assess your qualifications for the role. This process takes about 1 week from the application deadline.
  • When there are many candidates who pass the initial screening, the People, Equity, and Culture team may conduct 15-30 minute phone screening calls.
  • The hiring committee will conduct first round interviews with selected candidates. Candidates will be sent the interview questions 48 hours in advance of their scheduled interview. Candidates are welcome, but not expected or required, to send any questions they have for the hiring committee in advance of the interview. These interviews usually occur 1-2 weeks after the application deadline.
  • The hiring committee may conduct a second round of interviews, which may include an assignment.
  • The People, Equity, and Culture team will conduct reference checks for the candidate to whom they intend to extend an offer. This process usually takes about 1 week.
  • The People, Equity, and Culture team will initiate a background check. This is intended to safeguard Equality Fund employees, grantees, and the organization. We recognize that some communities experience systemic over-policing. As such, only findings related to harassment, exploitation, coercion, sexual exploitation, fraud, abuse, or other findings specifically relevant to the duties of the role will be considered in relation to one’s eligibility for employment.
  • The People, Equity, and Culture team will send the selected candidate an Employment Agreement, which the candidate will have time to review and return.

JOIN US!

Though we work to respond to all applicants, at times we may only be able to follow-up with those selected for an interview.

Les informations personnelles collectées incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

jobs.excerpt: Sales Enablement Manager Reports to: Senior Director, Revenue Operations • Location: Remote (US) • Function: Revenue Operations The opportunity KLDiscovery is standing up Revenue Operations as a dedicated function, organized around three pillars: Pipeline & Forecast, Data & Systems, and Enablement & Adoption.
jobs.description:
Sales Enablement Manager

Reports to: Senior Director, Revenue Operations • Location: Remote (US) • Function: Revenue Operations

The opportunity

KLDiscovery is standing up Revenue Operations as a dedicated function, organized around three pillars: Pipeline & Forecast, Data & Systems, and Enablement & Adoption. This role owns the third. Reporting to the Senior Director of Revenue Operations, the Sales Enablement Manager is a senior individual contributor who will build KLD's sales enablement function from the ground up, including the onboarding curriculum, the playbooks, the training programs, and the adoption analytics that turn a redesigned sales process into how the sales team actually sells.

What you'll own

Enablement strategy and roadmap. Define the enablement charter and a twelve-month roadmap sequenced against Revenue Operations priorities, prioritized by measurable seller impact: ramp time, productivity, win rate, and CRM adoption.

Onboarding and ramp. Design and run a structured onboarding curriculum for new sales hires, with defined ramp milestones and time-to-productivity targets. Own the ongoing skills development calendar for the existing sales team.

Playbooks and process adoption. Build playbooks by buyer type (corporations, law firms, and government agencies) and translate the redesigned end-to-end sales process, including stage-gate criteria, MQL/SQL/SAL definitions, and lead routing rules, into materials sellers use daily. Adoption of the process, not documentation of it, is the deliverable.

Sales methodology. Own MEDDPICC (Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Decision Process, Paper Process, Identify Pain, Champion, Competition) as KLD's qualification standard, embedding it in stage-gate criteria, deal reviews, and Salesforce opportunity fields so every deal is scored the same way. Build Challenger Sale certification alongside it: commercial teaching, tailoring the pitch by stakeholder, and taking control of pricing conversations, so reps pair qualification rigor with a point of view they can lead with. Own the certification path, assessment, and coaching cadence for both.

Salesforce training and certification. Stand up the Salesforce training and certification program in partnership with the Data & Systems pillar. Own CRM adoption analytics and use them to target coaching where adoption lags.

Pricing and deal desk enablement. Partner with the Pricing and Deal Desk team in Finance on curriculum covering pricing methodology, deal desk workflow, and approval routing.

Content and tooling. Create and govern a single repository of enablement content, keep it current, and retire what goes unused. Evaluate enablement tooling (Highspot or similar) and make the business case as the function scales.

Measurement. Define the enablement scorecard (ramp time, certification completion, playbook and CRM adoption, win rate movement) and report it through the Revenue Operations single source of truth.

First-year outcomes

An approved enablement charter and twelve-month roadmap, sequenced against Revenue Operations priorities.

A structured onboarding curriculum in production, with ramp milestones defined and measured for every new sales hire.

Playbooks by buyer type in sellers' hands, aligned to the redesigned sales process and stage-gate criteria.

MEDDPICC and Challenger Sale certification complete for the full sales team, with MEDDPICC fields live in Salesforce and referenced in every deal review.

Salesforce training and certification launched, with adoption analytics showing measurable improvement across the sales organization.

Pricing and deal desk enablement curriculum delivered jointly with Finance.

An enablement scorecard live in the revenue single source of truth, with baselines set and targets agreed with sales leadership.

What we're looking for

Experience. Eight or more years in sales enablement, sales operations, or sales leadership, including at least one build of an enablement function from the ground up at a B2B company of meaningful scale. Comfortable as a senior individual contributor: hands-on with the work today, with the judgment to design a function others will staff tomorrow.

Industry. eDiscovery, legal technology, or legal services experience is strongly preferred. Professional services or B2B SaaS backgrounds with complex, consultative sales cycles are encouraged.

Technical. Working fluency in Salesforce from an adoption and training perspective. Experience with enablement platforms (Highspot, Seismic, Showpad), sales engagement tools (Outreach, Salesloft, Gong), and LMS or curriculum design. Enough BI literacy to read and act on adoption dashboards.

Methodology. Certified or deeply fluent in MEDDPICC (or the broader MEDDIC family) and Challenger Sale, with experience building the certification program, coaching rubric, or deal-review framework around them, not just having sold using them, but having taught and enforced them across a sales team.

Attributes. A builder energized by greenfield and undeterred by ambiguity. A credible communicator and facilitator who earns the trust of sellers and sales leadership alike. Data-driven, measuring what enablement changes rather than what it produces. Moves with urgency and holds high standards for process discipline.

jobs.description:
Why TrueAccord?

TrueAccord, a wholly owned subsidiary of TrueML, is a category-defining company. We combine machine learning with a human-based approach to transform debt resolution and to get people on the path towards financial health. Every year, more than 70 million Americans have negative experiences dealing with debt. We are changing this by providing personalized digital experiences that guide lenders and consumers through this challenging financial process.

With a world-class leadership team, passionate team members, and proprietary predictive models trained on years worth of transactional data, TrueAccord is well-positioned to deliver on a huge opportunity: helping millions of consumers to regain and keep their financial footing while lowering the cost of doing business for creditors across many industries.

About This Role:

Sitting at the intersection of analytics, technology, and deep domain expertise, you will translate consumer and portfolio signals into sophisticated, tech-enabled collection strategies. Reporting to the Senior Director of Business Planning, your critical goal is to design, launch, and optimize multidimensional strategies across email, SMS, dialing, and digital self-service channels to boost liquidation, drive payment conversion, and elevate operational performance.

What You'll Do:

  • Own Strategy End-to-End: Lead collections strategy initiatives from initial opportunity identification through design, testing, launch, and ongoing optimization.

  • Design Multi-Channel Treatments: Determine contact timing, frequency, treatment sequencing, and segmentation across email, SMS/MMS, outbound dialing, and digital self-service channels.

  • Bridge Strategy and Execution: Translate strategic concepts into actionable business requirements and clear business cases for Product, Engineering, and Operations teams.

  • Drive Cross-Functional Momentum: Partner across Data Science, Client Management, Contact Center Operations, Product, Legal, and Compliance to move initiatives into production without relying on formal authority.

  • Optimize Key Metrics: Monitor delivery, engagement, payment conversion, and payment plan break rates to improve client scorecard performance and recovery outcomes.

  • Leverage Modern AI & Analytics: Utilize AI tools to accelerate hypothesis development, research, and strategy design while building repeatable testing frameworks.

Who You Are:

  • Experienced Collections Leader: You bring 8+ years in consumer finance or lending, including 5+ years specializing in consumer debt collections and collections strategy.

  • Strategic & Analytical: You possess a deep understanding of collection levers, strong prioritization instincts, and a proven track record of improving recovery metrics through channel optimization and segmentation.

  • Collaborative Influencer: You excel at framing complex problems, building evidence-based business cases to secure product prioritization, and aligning cross-functional teams.

  • Compliance-Aware: You hold a solid working knowledge of regulatory frameworks (FDCPA, Regulation F, TCPA) to proactively design both effective and compliant strategies.

  • Tech & AI Literate: You comfortably utilize AI tools to speed up work and are familiar with champion/challenger testing, SQL/BI platforms (Looker, Tableau), and Jira.

What We Offer (Perks & Benefits)

  • Medical/dental/vision insurance

  • Traditional/Roth retirement savings options

  • Company-paid disability and life insurance

  • Flexible Spending Account & Limited FSA

  • Family-friendly parental leave, volunteer and voting time off

  • PerkSpot discount program for 900+ merchants nationwide

Remote Work, Travel Expectations, & Physical Requirements

This role supports a global, cross-functional business and operates primarily in a Remote-First environment. However, flexibility outside of standard business hours and occasional local or international travel may be necessary for global operations support, company meetings, training, offsites, and collaborative projects.

This position primarily involves computer-based work, requiring extended periods at a computer, participation in virtual meetings, and use of standard office technology. We will consider reasonable accommodations to enable individuals to perform the essential functions of the role.

Maintaining a reliable internet connection and a professional work environment is expected. The ability to protect confidential company, employee, customer, and business information while working outside of a company office is also required.

Personally Identifying Information

We collect personal information for employment purposes. We do not sell personal information. Most of the information we have is provided to us by you and/or collected as part of the employment process. For more details on how we use, share, and delete personal information see our Privacy Policy.

Dedication to Diversity & Inclusion

We are an equal opportunity employer. We promote, value, and thrive with a diverse and inclusive team. Different perspectives contribute to better solutions and this makes us stronger every day. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or other protected characteristics.

VP/SVP Finance — Job Description

Job description: VP/SVP of Finance

About Backstory

Backstory (formerly People.ai) is the leading AI answers platform for sales teams. With more than a decade of training AI models on billions of sales interactions, Backstory enables modern sales teams to ask questions and get the right answer in the moment directly within their existing AI workflows. Sales leaders from companies like OpenAI, IBM, Red Hat, Verizon, Palo Alto Networks, Iron Mountain, TransUnion, Randstad and others rely on Backstory to get trusted answers wrapped in real business context helping them orchestrate deals more effectively and drive revenue.

By connecting every signal to the right accounts and opportunities, Backstory shows teams exactly what is happening and what to do next. Customers across industries including enterprise, cybersecurity, data and analytics, and defense use Backstory to drive trillions in pipeline and revenue.

Recognized by Gartner and Forrester, the Inc. 5000, Y Combinator Top Companies, and the Forbes AI 50, Backstory is based in San Francisco and backed by ICONIQ Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Akkadian Ventures and Mubadala Capital.

The role

We’re hiring an VP/SVP of Finance to lead Finance end to end for an enterprise B2B software business: FP&A, accounting, and cash. Reporting to the CEO, you’ll lead a lean team, shape the company’s financial strategy, represent Finance on the exec team, and support board and investor reporting.

It’s a hands-on role: you’ll get into the model, the close, or the analysis when it matters.

The mandate is focused: help take the business to its next major growth milestone, making the right financial and operational choices along the way, alongside a top-tier group of venture investors.

What success looks like in your first year

  • The company is delivering on its ARR growth plan, with Finance's planning and investment decisions a visible part of how it gets there.

  • The CEO, exec team, and investors rely on a predictable forecast across subscription and usage revenue, built on clear ARR and metric definitions.

  • The Finance team is set up for the next stage of growth, with a fast, reliable monthly close.

  • The company is audit-ready and well prepared for future financing.

Key responsibilities

Financial planning and analysis

  • Own the annual budget, scenario modeling, and rolling forecasts for revenue, headcount, opex, and cash, tied directly to how each part of the business plans and operates.

  • Deliver monthly and quarterly reporting with plan-to-actuals, and partner with each operating leader to highlight and understand the drivers behind their results.

  • Partner with Sales, Customer, Marketing, and Product leaders on investment trade-offs as we move from a cash-flow-neutral business to growing cash flow.

  • Provide leadership and the board with guidance on our financial trajectory in out quarters.

Strategy and capital

  • Serve as the CEO's and executive team's trusted financial advisor on strategic decisions.

  • Prepare board materials and investor reporting with the CEO, and serve as the primary contact for routine investor reporting and information requests.

  • Prepare the company for its next funding event.

  • Keep the company audit-ready: audited financials, clean metric definitions, and an organized data room.

Pricing and unit economics

  • Partner with Product on pricing and packaging, modeling the revenue, margin, and customer impact of each SKU.

  • Build predictable forecasting across our subscription base and its usage-based element.

  • Set revenue recognition policy for commits, prepaid credits, overages, and unused commitments, including allocating contract value between subscription and usage components.

  • Keep clear definitions for the metrics we report: ARR (recurring vs. variable), committed vs. consumed revenue, net dollar retention, and RPO.

  • Model and govern gross margin, including inference, cloud, and model-vendor costs.

Deal economics

  • Assist deal desk for enterprise contracts: non-standard terms, discount governance, and contract review.

  • Design sales compensation with Sales and People, including how subscription, commits, and usage are credited, and its accounting treatment.

  • Oversee billing and collections for hybrid contracts.

Accounting and controllership

  • Ensure a timely, accurate monthly close and GAAP-compliant financials.

  • Own and improve internal controls, policies, and procedures as we scale.

  • Oversee AP, AR, payroll, revenue recognition (ASC 606, including variable consideration), and the general ledger.

  • Manage external auditors and tax advisors, and ensure compliance with tax filings, sales tax nexus, and other regulatory requirements.

Cash and treasury

  • Own cash flow forecasting, liquidity management, banking relationships, and treasury operations.

  • Monitor burn and runway, and flag risks or opportunities early.

  • Manage working capital across billing, collections, and vendor terms.

Team and People partnership

  • Lead and shape a lean finance team.

  • Partner with the VP of People on headcount planning, compensation and equity (409A, refresh pool, retention equity), benefits costs, payroll, and HR systems.

  • Build scalable finance systems, BI and reporting tools, and close processes.

Qualifications

Core experience

  • 8+ years of progressive finance leadership, currently as an SVP of Finance or as a VP of Finance ready to step up.

  • Experience across the whole finance function, with real depth in FP&A and a track record of connecting planning back to how the business runs.

  • Time at a productized, enterprise B2B software company of 50M–100M ARR, with a subscription or platform model and larger enterprise deals, run on ARR rather than recognized revenue alone.

  • A disciplined operator who has taken a business from cash-flow neutral to growing cash flow. Not a growth-at-all-costs background, and not someone who manages only to gross margin and opex.

  • A track record of building finance teams, with the judgment to assess talent across accounting, FP&A, treasury, and AP/AR.

  • Fluency in SaaS metrics and how they connect to financial performance.

  • Hands-on ownership of the monthly close, GAAP reporting, internal controls, and revenue recognition (ASC 606).

  • Experience managing external auditors, tax advisors, and banking relationships.

Leadership

  • A player-coach who sets direction and rolls up their sleeves on modeling, close, or analysis when needed.

  • Sees Finance as a partner to growth functions, not a gatekeeper.

  • A sharp, clear communicator who translates the numbers into clear implications and decisions for operating leaders and the CEO.

  • A collaborative peer who reads the exec room, gives space when needed, and claims the mic when needed.

  • A steady presence for a team coming through a leadership transition.

Nice to have

  • Experience in revtech or CRM.

  • Experience with hybrid subscription-and-usage models, and with finding predictability in variable revenue.

  • Understanding of AI and cloud cost structures and how they drive gross margin.

  • Active involvement in a strategic exit before, during, and after close.

  • Experience supporting a capital raise or debt facility.

jobs.excerpt: WHO WE ARE Trees for the Future (TREES) partners with farmers to restore their land and unlock prosperity through regenerative farming.
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Trees for the Future (TREES) partners with farmers to restore their land and unlock prosperity through regenerative farming. Our vision is a future where every farmer is a thriving climate changer—building a prosperous livelihood while restoring the land and contributing to climate solutions.

Since 1989, we’ve worked with communities to grow trees, restore landscapes, and improve livelihoods. Today, our work is farmer-led and grounded in science: farmers grow diverse trees and crops that rebuild soil health, improve food security, support biodiversity, and remove carbon from the atmosphere. By connecting farmers with markets, technology, and finance, we help turn restored land into thriving farm enterprises that strengthen rural economies.

We currently work alongside farming communities in Kenya, Tanzania, and Uganda. Joining our collaborative team means contributing to lasting change led by farmers, with benefits that reach far beyond the farm.

Learn more at .

THE ROLE

The Data Systems Senior Manager is responsible for the effective day-to-day management, configuration, implementation, and continuous improvement of TREES' Salesforce environment. This is a highly hands-on role for an experienced Salesforce professional who combines strong Salesforce administration and functional expertise with excellent project management, requirements gathering, and stakeholder engagement skills.

The Senior Manager will work closely with the Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning (MEL), Programs, Carbon, Fundraising, and other teams to understand business needs, translate them into practical Salesforce solutions, and ensure that system improvements are implemented effectively following industry best practices and adopted by users.

The Senior Manager will be responsible for taking assigned system improvements from requirements through solution design, configuration, testing, user acceptance, deployment, and documentation. The role will work closely with TREES' external Salesforce development and consulting partners to coordinate technical implementation and ensure that solutions are aligned with TREES' established data model and technical standards.

The role requires someone who can operate comfortably between users and technical teams. You should be able to sit with a Program team member to understand a workflow problem, translate that problem into a Salesforce solution, configure the solution yourself when appropriate, work with developers when custom development is required, and ensure the final product works as intended before it reaches users.

The Senior Manager will initially report to the Senior Director of Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning (MEL) and will transition to reporting to the Director of Data Systems once that position is filled.

TREES is currently recruiting for the Director of Data Systems and plans to expand the Data Systems team further by hiring a Junior Salesforce Administrator in Q4 of 2027.

This is a hands-on role. The successful candidate should expect to spend approximately:

  • 50% Salesforce administration and functional system work
  • 25% requirements gathering, user engagement, and governance
  • 25% project and implementation management

This role must be based in Kenya, Tanzania, or Uganda. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role, existing and permanent work rights for the location of work required.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Salesforce Administration & Continuous Improvement

  • Administer, configure, maintain, and optimize TREES’ Salesforce environment, including objects, fields, automation, validation rules, reports, dashboards, permissions, and access controls. Troubleshoot system issues, monitor system performance and data quality, and maintain accurate configuration documentation.

2. Requirements Gathering, Solution Design & Implementation

  • Work with MEL, Programs, Carbon, Fundraising, and other teams to understand operational needs, translate them into clear requirements and acceptance criteria, and develop practical Salesforce solutions aligned with TREES’ established data model and technical standards.
  • Manage assigned Salesforce enhancements from scoping through deployment, coordinating deliverables, timelines, dependencies, stakeholders, and external developers. Track progress, resolve implementation questions, and proactively communicate risks, delays, and outstanding actions.
  • Work collaboratively with technical partners to evaluate proposed solutions, identify unnecessary complexity, and escalate significant architectural or advanced development decisions to the Director of Data Systems.

3. Testing, Quality Assurance & Release Management

  • Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), develop test cases, track issues through resolution, verify fixes, and obtain user sign-off. Ensure changes are appropriately tested in sandbox environments, required approvals and documentation are complete, and release readiness criteria are met before production deployment.
  • Document releases and communicate changes, user guidance, and known limitations to affected teams.

4. Reporting, Integrations & Systems Harmonization

  • Develop and maintain accurate, user-centered Salesforce reports and dashboards that support operational and management decisions. Work with stakeholders to define reporting requirements and support TREES’ broader business intelligence and analytics strategy, including Power BI.
  • Support reliable integrations and consistent data flows between Salesforce and connected platforms, including TaroWorks, fundraising and communications tools, and BI and analytics systems. Document integration requirements, investigate synchronization and data-flow issues, coordinate resolution, and escalate complex integration and architecture decisions to the Director of Data Systems.
  • Support consistent data structures and business processes across Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, and other TREES operations while accommodating legitimate country-level program differences.

5. Data Governance, User Support & Technical Collaboration

  • Support TREES’ data governance and change-management processes for assigned work, maintaining clear records of requirements, decisions, enhancements, dependencies, and outstanding issues. Ensure system and process changes are documented and communicated clearly to affected users.
  • Develop practical user guidance and training materials, support Salesforce superusers and other key users, and use feedback and recurring support issues to improve functionality, usability, and adoption.
  • Work effectively with external developers and consultants to ensure solutions address business needs and remain maintainable, while recognizing the limits of the role’s technical authority and escalating decisions appropriately.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A hands-on Salesforce professional who enjoys solving real operational problems through thoughtful system configuration.
  • A strong Salesforce administrator who understands how Salesforce objects, relationships, automation, security, reporting, and data structures work together.
  • A practical and entrepreneurial problem solver who can take an ambiguous business problem and turn it into a clear, implementable solution.
  • A strong project manager who follows commitments through to completion and proactively communicates status, risks, and delays.
  • A disciplined tester who understands that “built” does not mean “ready for production.”
  • A strong communicator who can work effectively with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • A reporting and dashboard specialist who builds automated, decision-oriented Salesforce reports and dashboards and understands how to use BI platforms such as Power BI to support broader analytics needs.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple concurrent priorities.
  • Comfortable working across multiple countries, teams, and time zones.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Management, Business Systems, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5–7 years of progressive Salesforce administration and data systems experience, with demonstrated ability to independently configure Salesforce, including objects, fields, flows, validation rules, reports, dashboards, permissions, and related functionality.
  • Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM 201) or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
  • Experience gathering business requirements, analyzing operational needs, and translating them into practical Salesforce solutions, including automated reports and dashboards that support decision-making.
  • Demonstrated project or implementation management experience, including coordinating deliverables, timelines, dependencies, and stakeholders to ensure work is completed as agreed.
  • Experience coordinating user acceptance testing, resolving issues, and managing controlled system releases, with a strong commitment to quality assurance and system reliability.
  • Experience working with external developers, consultants, or technical implementation partners, as well as familiarity with data governance, change management, and integrations between Salesforce and other systems.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or comparable advanced visualization platforms.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong organizational and analytical abilities, attention to detail, and demonstrated follow-through.

Preferred

  • Advanced Salesforce certifications (ADM 211, Platform App Builder, or others).
  • Experience with Salesforce NPSP (Nonprofit Success Pack).
  • Experience with TaroWorks or other mobile data collection platforms (ex: CommCare, ODK, KoboToolbox).
  • Technical skills in APIs, SQL, Python, or other data analysis/integration tools.
  • Familiarity with online communications and fundraising applications (e.g. HubSpot, Fundraise Up, Wealth Engine)
  • Professional experience working within international development, climate, agriculture, or social impact organizations, with familiarity navigating programmatic and donor-driven data environments.
  • Experience in supporting monitoring and evaluation frameworks and impact measurement in nonprofit or international development settings.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND BENEFITS

TREES is an International Organization that strives to be the best home for staff wanting to make an impact on the farmers we serve. We believe that the diversity of our staff contributes to excellence. TREES values collaboration and teamwork that fosters increased engagement and innovation for professional growth.

We offer a multicultural, collegial work environment with a competitive salary, comprehensive medical insurance, workers' compensation, and substantial paid time off, including annual leave and sick leave.

APPLY

If this opportunity speaks to you, please apply with 1) a cover letter that explains why TREES’ work excites you and why this role is a fit for you, and 2) your resume. Ensure both documents are shared as PDF documents. Please apply no later than December 1, 2026. We review applications on a rolling basis.

Trees for the Future is an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, parental status, genetic information, or other characteristics or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We embrace and value diverse skill sets and backgrounds. Our diversity as a community is our strength, driving our ability to be empathetic, visionary, and effective leaders.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewLMI is seeking a UI/UX Designer to design intuitive, visually polished software experiences for the Robotics and Autonomous Systems (RAS) business unit.
jobs.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a UI/UX Designer to design intuitive, visually polished software experiences for the Robotics and Autonomous Systems (RAS) business unit. The Designer will translate user needs and complex workflows into usable interfaces for mission applications, data platforms, and AI-enabled tools. The role spans user research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, usability testing, and collaboration with developers through production delivery. This position requires an active Secret clearance.

The Designer will create a consistent experience across integrated applications, including shared navigation, a common entry point, and reusable interface components. The ideal candidate combines strong visual design with evidence-based user experience practices and can simplify complex tasks without obscuring information users need to make decisions.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors, helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

This is a remote position requiring an active Secret security clearance. Periodic travel may be required for user research, design workshops, demonstrations, and customer engagements. Any classified work must be performed at approved facilities.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct user interviews, workflow observations, and discovery sessions with operational users and stakeholders; translate findings into prioritized user needs, journey maps, and design requirements.
  • Develop information architecture, navigation structures, user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity interfaces, and interactive prototypes for web-based applications and integrated platforms.
  • Design dashboards, data tables, search experiences, forms, and approval workflows that make complex information understandable and support efficient task completion.
  • Create and maintain a shared design system covering typography, layout, color, components, interaction patterns, and usage guidance across products.
  • Design complete interaction states, including loading, empty, error, permission, confirmation, and degraded-connectivity conditions, with clear feedback and recovery paths.
  • Plan and conduct usability testing; document findings, prioritize improvements, and evaluate task completion, errors, and user feedback across design iterations.
  • Apply accessibility practices to layouts, contrast, keyboard interactions, focus states, and interface content; coordinate implementation and validation with engineering and testing teams.
  • Work with product managers, developers, platform engineers, and cybersecurity personnel to align designs with mission priorities, technical constraints, access controls, and delivery schedules.
  • Provide annotated designs, component specifications, assets, and acceptance criteria; review implemented interfaces and resolve usability and visual-quality issues before release.
  • Present design recommendations and tradeoffs to customers and leadership, maintain version-controlled design artifacts, and improve delivered products based on user feedback.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Active Secret security clearance, with the ability to maintain the clearance throughout employment.
  • Minimum of five years of professional experience in UI/UX design, product design, interaction design, or a closely related field, including design of software applications.
  • Bachelor’s degree in interaction design, human-computer interaction, user experience, visual design, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • A portfolio demonstrating user research, interaction design, visual design, and contribution to delivered software products. Sanitized case studies or authorized walkthroughs are acceptable for restricted work.
  • Proficiency with Figma or comparable interface-design and prototyping tools, including reusable components, responsive layouts, and interactive prototypes.
  • Experience conducting user research and usability testing and translating findings into design decisions and measurable improvements.
  • Demonstrated ability to design complex application workflows, information-dense interfaces, and consistent navigation; create or maintain reusable design systems.
  • Experience collaborating with software developers, documenting interaction behavior, and reviewing implemented interfaces. Familiarity with accessibility and responsive design practices.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, organization, and independent problem-solving skills, with the ability to work across a distributed team and support periodic travel.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience designing software for military, federal, national security, or other regulated environments.
  • Experience designing unified interfaces across multiple applications, role-based workspaces, data and analytics platforms, or AI-enabled tools.
  • Experience with operational dashboards, geospatial interfaces, robotics or autonomous-system applications, or workflows used under time and connectivity constraints.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and component-based front-end frameworks sufficient to collaborate effectively with developers; production software development is not required.
  • Experience supporting Agile delivery, maintaining design work in product backlogs, and collaborating through tools such as GitLab, Jira, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience designing for federal accessibility requirements and working with accessibility specialists to validate delivered interfaces.

Target salary range: $102,000 - $174,000

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. Why This Role Matters

Speed, precision, and growth are your playground. As a Junior Video Editor, you are the engine room of our post-production team. You’ll support Senior Editors by assembling footage, handling high-volume versioning, and applying the finishing touches that make our ads pop.

This isn’t just about cutting clips; it’s about mastering the art of performance marketing. You will learn the science behind "the hook," the rhythm of a winning ad, and the technical workflows of a world-class agency.   2. Handle Versioning & Resizing

    • Take approved "hero" edits and adapt them for various platforms and aspect ratios (9:16, 4:5, 16:9) ensuring no visual quality is lost.

    • Maintain a pristine digital workspace. ensuring all project files, assets, and exports are named and organized according to High Scale’s strict workflows.

  4. Learn & Level Up

    • Absorb feedback from Art Directors and Senior Editors to refine your technical skills and storytelling ability.

Who You Are

You will help build and maintain backend services that power registration, login, authorization, and account lifecycle flows across B2C and B2B experiences. You will work with experienced engineers and partner teams to deliver scoped identity features with strong security fundamentals, reliability, and operational rigor.

What you’ll do

Clinical Trial Manager I

Syneos Health® is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities.

Our Clinical Development model brings the customer and the patient to the center of everything that we do. We are continuously looking for ways to simplify and streamline our work to not only make Syneos Health easier to work with, but to make us easier to work for.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to accelerate the delivery of therapies, because we are passionate to change lives.

Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know:

WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
  • We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.
  • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.

Job Responsibilities

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiological Practices (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and with guidance develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • For the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes
    Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records
    Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete
    Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines
    Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical project data review and capture
    Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt, with the oversight of the Lead CRA, to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with project site personnel, or in collaboration with another CRA or Central Monitoring Associate (CMA). Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements.
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • For Real World Late Phase, the CRA I will use the business card title of Site Management Associate I. Additional responsibilities include:
    Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out
    Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs
    Chart Abstraction activities and data collection
    Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis
  • US ONLY: As part of your employment with Syneos Health, you may be deployed to Sites that require certain medical and other personal information to gain facility access. Pursuant to our Employee Privacy Notice, Syneos Health can provide the Sites with the information necessary for you to gain such access. Further, a Site may ask you for additional information beyond that which Syneos Health has in its possession. You are required to comply with any such Site requests as a condition of your employment with Syneos Health. Please note that failure to provide requested information may result in a Site barring you from entry, which could put your ongoing employment at risk.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. jobs.excerpt: About Life360Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love.
jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

This role sits on the Verticals team within Life360 — the group building the next frontier of meaningful connection beyond the core family circle. This role's initial focus is Aging in Place: helping aging parents stay safely independent while giving the families around them real peace of mind. Over time, this role may flex to support other emerging verticals — Things (Tile, connected trackers) or Pets — as priorities shift, so we're looking for someone who wants to help define the pattern for new member segments, not just ship one feature set.

We are a product-minded, AI-Native engineering team. That means AI isn't just a tool we use — it's how we work. We've redesigned our team workflows around AI, treating it as a first-class collaborator at every stage: ideation, coding, testing, review, and iteration. We ship faster and go deeper because of it, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what that looks like at scale.

About the Job

Life360 is hiring an AI-Native Engineer — a senior engineer who doesn't just use AI tools, but thinks natively in them. You'll be central to how the Verticals team builds products, where AI has reshaped how the entire team designs, builds, and ships.

You'll design and build features that serve one of our most important and fastest-growing member segments: aging parents who want to stay safely connected with, and independent from, the families who care about them. As the priorities change, you may also apply these same patterns to Things (connected trackers) or Pets.

You'll build and evolve our modern AI-Native engineering workflows — from how we write code, to how we run standups, to how we think about team velocity. You'll evolve the standard others follow.

You will take full ownership of what you build from the first line of code through production, on-call, and the member impact it has. You are someone who obsesses over the humans on the other end of the product, not just the ticket.

Full-stack experience is strongly preferred for this role — you should be comfortable moving between backend services and the mobile surfaces that expose them. Our stack spans Spring Boot microservices, Java, Kafka, and Kafka Streams on the backend, a modern cloud-native platform on AWS, and native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) apps on the client side.

In your first year, success looks like having shipped end-to-end features serving the Aging in Place member segment and establishing at least one AI-native workflow the broader team adopts.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $118,500 to $216,500 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $171,500 to $201,000CAD. Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You’ll Do

  • Ship end-to-end across the stack — from backend services and APIs through to the iOS and Android surfaces members actually use — moving fluidly between layers as the feature demands.
  • Work with AI (Claude Code) as a first-class collaborator — your primary workflow involves orchestrating agents to create specs, generate results, and perform reviews.
  • Help define and codify AI-Native engineering practices for the Verticals team, establishing playbooks the broader org can adopt.
  • Build across the full stack as needed — shipping polished, performant, and reliable experiences to tens of millions of users.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and designers to turn complex user problems into elegant, scalable engineering solutions.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions, code reviews, and a culture of craft and continuous improvement.
  • Participate in on-call rotation and incident response.
  • Use agentic workflows to dramatically increase the delivery of strong outcomes — moving faster without sacrificing quality.
  • Mentor team members and contribute to team processes, technical standards, and help evolve the team's AI-native engineering practices.
  • Support performance, reliability, and accessibility across the features you own.
  • Adapt patterns and services built for Aging in Place to future verticals (Things, Pets) as team scope expands.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience building and operating high-quality, consumer-scale services.
  • 1+ years of hands-on experience prompting, evaluating, and building with LLMs.
  • Full-stack proficiency spanning backend services and mobile client development (iOS and/or Android), with the versatility to work across the whole stack as needed.
  • Deep experience with agentic workflows, prompt engineering, context window management, and MCP/function calling.
  • A track record of using AI tooling to multiply your own output — not just as autocomplete, but as a genuine development partner.
  • A strong sense of ownership — you don't wait to be told what to fix, and you follow through past "it works on my machine" to "it works for the member, in production, at scale."
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills — you work well with product, design, and platform engineers.
  • A genuine excitement for defining what it means to be AI-Native — you're not waiting for the playbook, you want to write it.
  • Empathy for the humans behind the product — an aging parent trying to stay independent, or a family member trying to help from afar.
  • Bachelor's Degree in a Technical field, or equivalent experience.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with IoT, telematics, or embedded/hardware-adjacent systems.
  • Familiarity with Kafka, Kinesis, or other high-throughput streaming platforms.
  • Background with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, DataDog).

AI-Native Expectations

We use AI coding tools as a professional standard on this team. Here's what that means in practice:

  • Daily use: You use AI coding assistants (we support Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for real, substantive tasks: analysis, coding, refactoring, testing, navigating codebases, and documentation. Not just research or autocomplete.
  • Judgment and ownership: AI-generated code gets the same review you'd give any PR. You are accountable for everything you ship.
  • Velocity: We expect senior engineers who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage — doing more with the same time, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team.
  • Team leadership: You share what works. You automate prompting strategies that others can build on and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed.
  • Continuous learning: The tooling is changing fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.
  • Learning & Development programs.
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful.Even if you don’t meet 100% of the below qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

airSlate is a global SaaS technology company that develops no-code workflow automation, electronic signature, and document management solutions. Our award-winning products - SignNow, pdfFiller, DocHub, altaFlow, Instapage, and US Legal Forms - serve over hundreds of millions of users and more than one million customers worldwide, helping organizations of every size digitize processes, improve efficiency, and transform how they work.
We’re in an exciting phase of growth and transformation, with teammates in more than 20 countries across three continents and main hubs in the United States, Poland, Ukraine and Philippines.
At airSlate, we’re building value for customers and a culture where growth and innovation go hand in hand. We’re looking for people eager to shape products, scale a company, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.
We are looking for a hands-on leader to run Data Enablement. The team that owns how our data is modeled, trusted, and made ready for the business and for AI. You will lead analytics engineers and web analytics specialists, own the semantic layer end-to-end, and turn raw product and event data into curated, well-documented datasets that people can rely on.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

    • Lead and grow the team. Set priorities, coach, and keep a steady delivery rhythm across analytics engineering and web analytics.

    • Own the semantic layer. Design, build and evolve SQL-based models and metric definitions so that one number means one thing across all our products.

    • Raise data curation and automate the routine. Move the team from ad hoc requests to reusable, tested, documented datasets that people and our AI data assistant can query directly, with tracking checks and data-quality monitoring on autopilot.

    • Set standards and partner across the data organization. Modeling conventions, version control, testing and release practices, code review; work with Data Business Partners, Data Science / ML and Data Platform on scope and ownership. Stay close to the code on critical builds.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

    • Experience. 5+ years in analytics, data or BI engineering, including 2+ years leading a team or leading others technically.

    • Expert SQL and Python. You set query and performance standards others follow, rewrite expensive queries and explain the trade-offs, handle incremental loads, deduplication and slowly changing dimensions, and own production Python components that other teams depend on.

    • Data modeling and pipelines. You design warehouse and mart models that several teams build on, including a semantic layer, and choose the methodology (star schema, Data Vault or equivalent) to fit the queries it must serve. You optimize and troubleshoot pipelines on a cloud stack such as AWS (Athena, Redshift, Glue) and orchestration tools such as Airflow.

    • Engineering discipline. You set branching and code review standards, require schema and data tests and CI before release, and lead risky changes with a clear rollout and rollback plan.

    • Data quality and data fluency. You design validation that catches problems before stakeholders do, fix root causes rather than symptoms, set documentation standards, and investigate unfamiliar sources before trusting them.

    • Business impact. You design solution options for complex problems, split cross-team work into pieces with a clear definition of done, build dashboards around the decision they support, and become a trusted partner to business leaders.

    • AI in everyday work. You redesign team workflows around AI tools to drive adoption, and evaluate AI outputs for quality, privacy and bias.

    • Leadership and ownership. You own complex team-level projects, make high-impact decisions from complex information, coach people by spotting skill gaps and giving regular feedback, set clear scope expectations, and turn change into actionable steps for the team.

    • Communication. You clarify complex ideas, build consensus across teams and time zones, and communicate in fluent English.

    • Nice to have: experience with dbt or a similar transformation framework (we may adopt one); web analytics and tracking (GTM, GA4); B2B SaaS or document-workflow / e-signature background.

What we offer

Flexible working environment - Our teams operate across the globe. We value in‑person collaboration in our hubs, but we also embrace remote and hybrid working. You can work from one of our offices in the United States, Poland, Romania or Ukraine, or remotely from many countries.
Competitive compensation and stock options - We offer salaries that reflect local market conditions and experience, plus a performance-based bonus system and stock options so you share in the company’s growth.
Professional growth and learning - We invest in your development through courses, conferences, and access to learning resources. We encourage career growth and internal mobility, supporting teammates who want to explore new opportunities within airSlate.
Health and well‑being - We provide comprehensive benefits tailored to each country, including health coverage, wellness programmes and access to fitness options. We also dedicate quarterly company-wide Mental Health Days, when everyone takes time off to rest and recharge.
Family‑friendly culture - Family life is part of who we are, and we embrace it in many forms. From flexibility for parents to our airSlate Junior Club for kids, to company-wide family days and our pet-friendly approach, we’re committed to making work and life easier to balance.
Giving back - We support charitable initiatives around the world through the airSlate Care programme. Our current focus includes humanitarian aid in Ukraine and other regions, matching employee donations and supporting causes chosen by our teams.
Open communication - We encourage transparent dialogue at all levels. From team discussions to company-wide Q&A sessions with our CEO, we make sure everyone has the chance to be heard and to influence how we grow.

Support team members collaborate with teams across Mark43, and provide valuable insight into the perspective of our users. Qualified candidates will have strong interpersonal skills, a clear and patient style of communication, and a keen mind for problem-solving. Because Mark43 is growing quickly, successful team members will be adaptable to changing team dynamics and processes.

  • Provided excellent customer support
  • Handled requests from customers via email, phone, and chat
  • Kept responses within our internal SLA times

  • Escalated issues to our engineering and project management teams

We’re always striving to exceed the demands and expectations of our customers, and this team will be on the front line when it comes to creating a great customer experience.

People who thrive on our team also tend to share the following characteristics and skills:

  • Humble, open, and curious
  • Fearless approach to technology and demonstrated software troubleshooting skills
  • A talent for research and information-gathering
  • Clear and confident written and oral communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to multitask
