We're small, fully remote, and we treat hiring like a growth problem: we test the way we write to candidates and where we post roles, and we use AI tools to move faster. This role sits on our own internal team.

Your Role

This is lead generation pointed at people instead of customers. You'll work across many different roles and industries, and every search starts with two questions: who is this person, and what would actually make them reply? If you've done lead gen or marketing, it's the same muscle you already have. You research an audience and write messages that convert, except here a conversion is a great candidate writing back.

A lot of what you'll source for is marketing and creative work: creative strategists, paid media, performance, growth, and data roles. So if you come from a marketing or agency world, you already understand the people you're reaching and what they care about. You figure out where the right people are, write the outreach, post the role so the right people see it, and improve based on what actually gets responses. Some recruiters treat this as the boring first step of hiring. We think it's the most interesting part, and it's most of this job. No recruiting experience needed. You'll be mentored while you learn the talent side, and you'll have real tools, including a dedicated sourcing platform and AI, to do it at scale.

You'll:

  • Research each new role to understand who the ideal candidate is and where to find them
  • Write and personalize outreach, then test subject lines and openers to lift reply rates
  • Post and promote roles so the right people actually apply
  • Review incoming applicants and shortlist the ones worth talking to
  • Keep your pipeline organized and follow up so no good candidate goes cold
  • Use AI and sourcing tools to work through a large volume without losing the personal touch
  • Track what's working, and change your approach when the numbers say so

You Bring

  • Curiosity and a real drive to keep learning, since every role is a new puzzle
  • Strong written English, and the ability to write to a stranger like a human rather than a template
  • Resourcefulness: handed a new tool and no script, you'd rather figure it out than wait to be told
  • Organization and follow-through, so pipelines stay clean and nothing slips
  • A competitive streak and self-motivation, because a lot of this is chasing a number you want to hit
  • Comfort with basic metrics, and the instinct to test something and adjust
  • A concrete example of a time you used a tool, a tactic, or automation to work smarter or hit a goal

Bonus Points

  • A background in lead generation, marketing, growth, sales, business development, or customer success
  • Experience at a marketing or creative agency, since many of the people you'll reach are creative, paid media, performance, growth, and data professionals
  • Hands-on time with a CRM like HubSpot or Salesforce, or with outreach and prospecting tools
  • You already use AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) in your day-to-day work
  • A language beyond English and Spanish

What's Offered

  • Fully remote from anywhere in Latin America, part-time to start at roughly 20 to 30 hours a week with room to grow, on hours that overlap US time zones
  • Compensation based on experience, paid weekly in USD as a contractor. Share the range that fits your level and we'll go from there
  • A chance to move your lead-gen or marketing skills into a new field, with mentorship while you learn it
  • A modern stack (a dedicated sourcing platform and AI tools) so you can work at scale from day one
  • Recent graduates and career switchers are welcome, with no recruiting background required. We hire on how you think and how you write

Interview Process

1️⃣ Apply, including a short outreach exercise

2️⃣ Intro and screening call

3️⃣ A practical challenge close to the real work

4️⃣ Final conversation with the team

jobs.excerpt: About the TeamOur engineering team builds next-generation, cloud-native bare-metal orchestration platforms for AI neo-cloud environments.
jobs.description:
About the Team

Our engineering team builds next-generation, cloud-native bare-metal orchestration platforms for AI neo-cloud environments. We operate on a T-shaped engineering model: while each engineer brings deep expertise in a primary domain, every team member maintains practical fluency across neighboring systems. This shared foundation enables rigorous design reviews, effective cross-domain code reviews, and dependable on-call coverage. Our development is fundamentally based on open-source projects, and contributing to them is a major part of our work.

We develop primary control plane software in Rust and Go, leverage Kubernetes operators, and foster an OpenTelemetry-first operational culture.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong software architecture principles with deep technical domain expertise in Datacenter Networking and DPU architectures. Fitting into our T-shaped engineering model, you will drive the development of control planes powering high-density, high-throughput infrastructure for AI training and inference workloads. Familiarity with automated bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle management is a strong asset.

Core Responsibilities

  • Control Plane Development: Design, build, and maintain production-grade control plane microservices, custom Kubernetes operators, and robust reconciliation engines in Rust and Go.

  • Architecture & API Design: Author clear Functional (FR) and Non-Functional Requirements (NFR), architectural specs, system sequence diagrams, and clean gRPC/Protobuf and REST API schemas.

  • Network Integration: Develop custom integration modules and integrations for modern network operating systems (SONiC, NVUE, Cumulus) and DPU hardware platforms.

  • Observability & Diagnostics: Instrument services end-to-end using OpenTelemetry (OTel) traces and metrics, performing systematic root-cause analysis across polyglot distributed systems.

  • Quality & Engineering Excellence: Participate in rigorous, review-gated pull request workflows across Rust, Go, and SQL codebases while ensuring high test coverage via mock-driven testing.

Technical Qualifications

  • Language Proficiency: Primary mastery of Rust (Tokio async runtime, Tonic, Axum, sqlx) and strong proficiency in Go.

  • Data & APIs: Advanced SQL / PostgreSQL fluency, gRPC/Protobuf contract design, and schema evolution.

  • Concurrency & Reliability: Strong background in async concurrency models, lock-free patterns, distributed state handling, and mock-driven testing discipline.

  • Datacenter Protocols & OS: Expertise in BGP, MP-BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, L3VNI, route targets, and route server design. Hands-on experience with SONiC, Cumulus Linux, and NVUE (featuring a first-class NVUE client).

  • DPU & Fabric Ecosystem: Deep knowledge of NVIDIA DOCA, Host-Based Networking (HBN), BlueField DPU architectures, and the DPF (DOCA Platform Framework) operator model (BFB, DPUSet, DPUNode CRDs).

  • High-Performance Interconnects: Understanding of InfiniBand fabrics, NVLink / NMX-M partitioning, and RoCEv2.

  • Linux Kernel Networking: Advanced grasp of Linux netlink, network namespaces, routing tables, and internal DHCP/DNS service implementations (the project ships its own services).

  • Cloud & Kubernetes Networking: Familiarity with CNI plugins (Calico, Cilium). OVS and DPDK experience is a plus.

  • Provisioning & Boot Infrastructure: Expertise in PXE/iPXE, UEFI, Secure Boot, measured boot, and TPM attestation.

  • Hardware Management: Proficiency in Redfish, IPMI, and BMC abstractions across heterogeneous hardware platforms (Dell, Lenovo, NVIDIA reference hardware).

  • Linux Systems Internals: In-depth knowledge of boot chains, systemd, initramfs, BIOS configuration matrices.

  • Identity & Security: Practical experience with PKI, X.509 certificates, TLS, SPIFFE/SVID, Vault, KMS, Keycloak (OAuth2/JWT), and RBAC.

  • Virtualization: Experience with KubeVirt / KVM.

  • Kubernetes Control Planes: Experience writing custom controllers/operators using kube-rs or controller-runtime with CRD-driven reconciliation loop patterns.

Universal Requirements

  • Testing Discipline: Commitment to test-driven design, writing highly testable code with mock interfaces for external hardware and network dependencies.

  • Collaborative Architecture: Proven track record of writing crisp architectural specs and engaging in constructive, cross-functional design reviews.

Educational & Experience Baseline

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in cloud-native platforms, systems programming, networking, or infrastructure automation.

  • Demonstrated participation or maintainership in open-source systems projects is a plus.

What does Mirantis offer you?

  • Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry;
  • Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies;
  • Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation;
  • Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued;
  • Professional development and training;
  • Attend conferences and working groups;
  • Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks;
  • Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan.

We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy.

Work at Home Bilingual Pashto-English Video-Phone Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position Overview:


The Pashto Video-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Pashto and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.


**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**


Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Participate in online, video and audio training sessions.
  • Deliver interpretation services via video and expediently type data on a dedicated device, such as a laptop, desktop computer, mobile phone, or tablet, in order to perform the essential functions of the job.

  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the video and audio interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.

  • Construire et maintenir, avec l'équipe, des solutions de sécurité basées sur Elastic.
  • Intégrer des flux de threat intelligence dans le SIEM afin de soutenir une détection proactive.

  • Bonne connaissance de Linux, ainsi que d'environnements Windows.
  • Capacité à analyser et résoudre des incidents dans des contextes exigeants.
  • Aisance rédactionnelle et orale pour documenter les solutions et communiquer des sujets de sécurité de manière claire.
  • Expérience avec des environnements cloud native, notamment Kubernetes.
  • Connaissance des cadres et normes de cybersécurité tels que SOC2 et ISO 27001.
  • Expérience avec EDR, outils SIEM, gestion des logs, détection d'intrusion, sécurité réseau et passerelles de messagerie.

Connaissances

  • Dashboards
  • Module APM d'Elastic

Samen met de architect en de Project Manager ondersteun je de onboarding van logdata en voer je de nodige aanpassingen uit in de SIEM/Log Analytics-tools.

De opdracht focust op de implementatie en het beheer van de Elastic-omgeving, meer bepaald Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash en Kafka. Je beheert Elasticsearch- en Kibana-applicaties, voert wijzigingen uit na overleg, ontwerpt dashboards en rapportering op basis van de vooraf bepaalde noden en zorgt voor de nodige documentatie.

  • Elasticsearch gebruiken voor indexatie, opzoekingen en analyse van securitygerelateerde data.

📝 Jouw profiel

Vaardigheden

jobs.description:
Releaf is the UK's leading medical cannabis clinic. A certified B Corp, with over 170 staff, we connect patients with specialist clinicians, streamline access to prescriptions, and support thousands of people across the UK. We're on a mission to rethink healthcare - making specialist medical care more accessible, more human, and more effective.

This is an exciting moment to join Releaf. We have strong product-market fit, a growing patient base, and ambitious international plans. We're now looking for a Head of CRM to own the full post-acquisition patient journey - keeping patients engaged, on treatment, and deriving real value from everything Releaf has to offer.

The role

You'll report directly to the Marketing Director and lead a team of 5. You'll own Releaf's retention strategy end-to-end, from subscription and loyalty mechanics through to how we communicate and market the products and benefits that keep patients with us long-term.

This is a strategic role with real commercial weight. You'll need to think clearly about patient lifetime value, move fast on opportunities, and build deep cross-functional relationships across Marketing, Clinical, Operations, and Patient Support.

Main Responsibilities

Retention Strategy

  • Own Releaf's retention strategy, setting clear goals across patient activation, engagement, subscription growth, and churn reduction
  • Lead the ongoing development of Releaf+ - our subscription model - ensuring it delivers genuine value to patients and performs commercially
  • Develop and manage loyalty mechanics, refer-a-friend programmes, and other retention incentives that drive long-term patient engagement
  • Work alongside the Brand Team to market and communicate Releaf's retention products - including the Releaf medical cannabis card, Releaf Protect, and free legal support for Releaf+ patients - ensuring patients understand and use what's available to them
  • Build proactive intervention programmes that identify early signs of patient drop-off and act on them before churn happens

CRM & Communications

  • Work closely with the CRM & Lifecycle Lead to develop and execute a patient communications strategy across the full lifecycle - from onboarding through to long-term retention
  • Ensure CRM activity is data-led, well-segmented, and aligned to retention goals
  • Own the feedback loop between patient communications and operational reality - medication changes, formulary updates, patient support changes - ensuring comms reflect what's actually happening across the business

CRO

  • Work in lockstep with the CRO & Experimentation Lead and the CRO and UX Designers. to ensure the pre-payment and post-login patient experiences are continuously tested, optimised, and improving
  • Connect CRO activity to retention outcomes - what happens on the dashboard should be as informed by retention data as it is by UX insight

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Build strong working relationships with Clinical, Dev, Operations, and Patient Support teams to stay close to changes that affect the patient experience
  • Act as the commercial bridge between operational change and patient-facing communications - when something changes inside the business, you make sure it's reflected in how we communicate and retain patients
  • Work closely with the Head of Performance Marketing to ensure a clean handoff from acquisition into retention, with shared visibility on patient quality and LTV
  • Collaborate with the Marketing Director and senior stakeholders to report on retention performance, surface insights, and make the case for investment

What we're looking for

  • Proven experience in a senior growth, retention, or lifecycle marketing role, ideally in a digital health, healthtech, or subscription business
  • A track record of owning and improving retention metrics - churn, LTV, activation, engagement - not just reporting on them
  • Strong understanding of CRM strategy and patient or customer lifecycle communications
  • Experience marketing subscription products or membership programmes, including auditing and rebuilding what isn't working
  • Commercially sharp - you build business cases, set goals, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with clinical, operational, and commercial teams, not just marketing
  • Experience working in a regulated industry - you understand the constraints and know how to operate effectively within them
  • Strong analytical skills, able to translate data into clear strategy and communicate findings to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience leading and developing a small team

At Releaf, we believe that diverse teams build better businesses. We're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and able to do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences — and we're happy to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process if you need them. If you'd like to discuss this, please don't hesitate to get in touch.

jobs.excerpt: Job Title: Member of Technical Staff, Model Training (post-training research) Job Type: Full-time Location: Remote The Role In this role, you will investigate how learning algorithms, training data, and evaluation methodologies interact to produce stronger reasoning, generalization, and agent capabilities.
jobs.description:
Job Title: Member of Technical Staff, Model Training (post-training research)

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

In this role, you will investigate how learning algorithms, training data, and evaluation methodologies interact to produce stronger reasoning, generalization, and agent capabilities. You will explore new approaches to reinforcement learning, distillation, and data-efficient training, translating research insights into scalable methods that improve model intelligence.

This is a highly experimental role at the intersection of fundamental machine learning research and large-scale model development. You will have the opportunity to formulate research hypotheses, design ambitious experiments, and develop training methods that directly influence the capabilities of our models.

What You'll Do

  1. Research, implement, and scale advanced post-training methods, including supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning (RL), and on-policy distillation (OPD), across large language and multimodal models.
  2. Investigate learning objectives, optimization dynamics, exploration strategies, and credit assignment mechanisms to improve training stability, sample efficiency, and capability acquisition.
  3. Develop and refine training recipes by jointly optimizing data mixtures, sampling strategies, curricula, and evaluation methodologies.
  4. Design methods for learning from expert demonstrations, human preferences, corrections, and model-generated trajectories, identifying where human feedback delivers the greatest improvements.
  5. Research the co-evolution of generators, reward models, and graders, developing approaches that improve both model performance and the quality of the training signals they consume.
  6. Design rigorous experiments, ablation studies, and evaluation frameworks to measure generalization, reasoning, and performance on realistic downstream tasks.
  7. Own research initiatives end-to-end, from identifying promising directions and implementing new algorithms to executing large-scale experiments and validating results.

What We're Looking For

  1. Strong foundations in machine learning, deep learning, optimization, and modern model training techniques.
  2. Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, or post-training large-scale language or multimodal models.
  3. Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as reinforcement learning, model distillation, reward modeling, data selection, or learning dynamics.
  4. Strong proficiency in Python and PyTorch, with the ability to implement, debug, and optimize complex training pipelines.
  5. Experience designing controlled experiments, interpreting model behavior, and translating empirical findings into actionable research directions.
  6. Ability to independently navigate ambiguous research problems, formulate hypotheses, and iterate quickly based on experimental evidence.
  7. Strong analytical thinking and a research-driven mindset, with an emphasis on reproducibility, scientific rigor, and measurable improvements.

Nice to Have

  1. Experience with RLHF, RLAIF, preference optimization, or reinforcement learning for reasoning and agentic tasks.
  2. Familiarity with distributed training, large-scale experimentation, and GPU-based model optimization.
  3. Experience developing reward models, verifiers, graders, or automated evaluation systems.
  4. Research contributions to post-training, reinforcement learning, or related areas through publications, open-source projects, or production systems.
  5. Experience investigating synthetic data generation, curriculum learning, or iterative self-improvement techniques.

Compensation & Benefits Notice

The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $200,000 –$320,000. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. micro1 provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.

We are looking for a Senior Routing Engine Developer to design and build the next generation interaction routing platform powering enterprise-scale contact center operation. You will develop the core routing engine responsible for intelligent distribution of voice and digital interactions across agents, queues, skills, channels, and business units in real time. The role includes building highly scalable backend services capable of processing large volumes of routing decisions with strict latency, availability, and resiliency requirements. You will work primarily with Java, Spring Boot, distributed architectures, event-driven systems, and cloud-native technologies, collaborating closely with product, architecture, workforce management, telephony, and CX platform teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop enterprise-scale routing engines that distribute voice and digital interactions in real time.
  • Implement intelligent routing algorithms based on skills, priorities, capacity, availability, and business rules.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, resilience, and performance across queues, routing paths, and interaction workloads.
  • Design and maintain APIs supporting routing configuration, administration, monitoring, and integration requirements.
  • Optimize systems for high concurrency, fault tolerance, resiliency, and predictable performance.
  • Integrate routing services with telephony, digital messaging, workforce management, CRM, identity, reporting, and analytics platforms.
  • Design and develop critical Java and Spring Boot services, APIs, integration components, and reference implementations.
  • Translate business journeys and operational requirements into solution components, interaction flows, deployment views, and technical roadmaps.
  • Define non-functional requirements for availability, performance, concurrency, security, privacy, observability, disaster recovery, and supportability.
  • Review designs and code, identify technical risks, challenge assumptions, and drive pragmatic decisions that balance quality, time, and cost.
  • Establish engineering standards, reusable patterns, quality gates, documentation expectations, and technology adoption guidance.
  • Collaborate with CX domain experts to translate operational requirements into routing capabilities.
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial ownership of architecture and technical delivery for distributed applications.
  • Expert-level hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, implementing distributed systems and microservices architectures, REST APIs, persistence, security, testing, and performance engineering.
  • Experience developing routing logic for contact center, communications, or customer engagement platforms.
  • Knowledge of ACD concepts, agent states, queue management, skill-based routing, priority routing, proficiency routing, and workload balancing.
  • Experience building high-throughput, low-latency transaction processing systems.Deep understanding of API-first design, event-driven architecture, messaging, distributed systems, and cloud-native engineering.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL or comparable relational databases, data modeling, integration data flows, and transactional design.
  • Hands-on experience with contact center or CX platforms and the operational concepts behind customer routing and engagement.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical documentation and lead client-facing workshops.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with real-time communications platforms such as FreeSWITCH or Kamailio.
  • Knowledge of optimization algorithms, decision engines, or scheduling systems.
  • Experience with Genesys, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect, Cisco, Avaya, or comparable contact center platforms.
  • Exposure to WFM processes and integrations involving forecasting, schedules, adherence, etc.
  • Familiarity with Kafka or RabbitMQ, Kubernetes, Jenkins, observability platforms, API gateways, and security architecture.
  • Practical experience with AI-assisted software development or AI-enabled solutions, including tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot, is a plus.

We offer:

  • Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.
  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, and a relocation program.
  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

* Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989.
Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

PTC Java Engineer- Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: PTC Java Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Windchill Java Customization Engineer focused on deep, low-level Windchill customizations using Java, PTC APIs, and PTC’s customization frameworks. This role suits engineers who enjoy working close to the platform, extending its behavior through services, listeners, and processors while preserving a clean and upgrade-friendly customization layer. The ideal candidate will bring strong Java fundamentals, deep familiarity with the Windchill platform internals, and a disciplined, performance-aware engineering style. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop advanced Java customizations within Windchill, including custom services, listeners, processors, validators, and helpers.
  • Extend the Windchill data model with custom types, attributes, and relationships using Type and Attribute Management (TAM).
  • Build custom JSP and HTML extensions, including custom tables, actions, and wizard pages.
  • Develop custom queues and background processes for asynchronous Windchill tasks.
  • Implement complex workflow expressions and robot delegates in Java, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Optimize performance of Java customizations, including profiling, query tuning, and caching strategies.
  • Adhere strictly to PTC customization best practices, ensuring upgrade-friendly customizations.
  • Lead migration efforts to retire legacy customizations to modern PTC-supported patterns, planning phased cutovers, building backward-compatibility shims where needed, and ensuring each migration step is reversible and well-monitored.
  • Conduct code reviews and uphold internal engineering standards, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Collaborate closely with functional consultants to translate complex requirements into clean Java designs.
  • Provide hands-on post-go-live and hypercare support, working closely with operations teams to triage incidents quickly, identify root causes, and drive durable fixes that improve long-term system stability.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of Java development experience, with strong focus on Windchill customization.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with the Windchill Java API and customization frameworks.
  • Solid understanding of Windchill data model, lifecycle, and workflow internals.
  • Strong Java OO design and performance-engineering skills.
  • Experience with JSP, HTML, and Windchill client-side customization.
  • Hands-on experience with Type and Attribute Management (TAM).
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with Oracle or SQL Server.
  • Experience supporting Windchill upgrades.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  • PTC Windchill development certifications.
  • Experience with PTC ThingWorx development.
  • Exposure to Windchill RV&S customization.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tooling for Windchill.
  • Experience operating Windchill in the cloud.

jobs.title: Head of IT
jobs.excerpt: Why we existMost people with treatment-resistant depression, PTSD, or OCD spend years cycling through medications before anyone mentions there are other options.
jobs.description:
Why we exist

Most people with treatment-resistant depression, PTSD, or OCD spend years cycling through medications before anyone mentions there are other options. Treatments like accelerated TMS, SAINT, Spravato, and IV ketamine can work when nothing else has. They're also hard to find, hard to get covered, and hard to deliver well. That gap is why Radial exists.

We support the country's largest network of brain medicine clinics: 27 clinics and more than 100 clinicians across seven states, caring for patients with some of the most serious mental health conditions there are. RadialOS, our AI-native operating system, matches patients to the right treatment, coordinates their care, and takes administrative work off clinicians' plates. We're backed by General Catalyst, and in 2026 we acquired the MSO behind Mindful Health Solutions, one of the pioneers of interventional psychiatry.

Every role here supports our mission of getting patients access to the care they need as quickly as possible.

The role

When a technician can't log in at 7 a.m., the first TMS patient of the day waits. When access isn't removed on someone's last day, patient data is exposed. At Radial, IT is part of how care gets delivered.

More than 250 people across 27 clinics and our corporate team run on systems inherited from two companies. You'll own all of it: every system we run that we don't build ourselves, from identity, devices, and clinic networks to our EHR, business applications, and the security program. Our engineering team builds RadialOS. You'll own everything around it and partner closely on how it all connects.

You'll lead a strong team and will set the strategy for our security policies. You'll serve as our HIPAA Security Officer yourself until that seat is filled.

Early on, that might mean laying two companies' tool lists side by side and deciding what survives, walking a clinic to see why the network drops during treatment hours, or sitting with your team to pick the requests that should never reach a human again.

What you'll do

  • Own Radial's systems strategy: decide what we run, what we consolidate, and what we retire, and make build, buy, and kill calls with data.
  • Lead the technical integration of two organizations across identity, endpoints, collaboration, networking, telephony, and business applications, consolidating overlapping systems and vendors.
  • Own our EHR and the other clinical and business systems we buy, partnering with engineering, which owns RadialOS and its integrations.
  • Keep clinics running: hardware, connectivity, and the devices that support patient care on site.
  • Own the security program and serve as the interim HIPAA Security Officer. You will manage risk assessments, access controls, vendor risk and BAAs, incident response, and audit readiness.
  • Replace the ticket queue with automation. Stand up an AI-native service desk where employees get help in Slack, routine requests like access, onboarding, and offboarding resolve without a human touching them, and your team builds approved, auditable workflows in plain language. You'll measure success by automation rate, not ticket volume.
  • Grant access just in time and remove it automatically, with an audit trail that makes HIPAA reviews easy.
  • Set the guardrails for how the whole company uses AI safely with patient data.
  • Lead, develop, and grow a team, setting the standard for how IT operates and how it treats the people it supports.
  • Own the IT budget and vendor relationships, and make our technology cost less per person as we grow.

Backgrounds we think could thrive here

  • IT leaders at high-growth tech companies who've owned the whole stack and made it modern and automated
  • Healthcare IT leaders at multi-site provider groups who want to move faster
  • IT leaders who've run integration across acquisitions at PE-backed companies
  • Business systems or IT operations leaders ready to own the full stack

This list isn't a checklist. If you see yourself in one of these, we'd like to talk. If you don't but the role still sounds like you, we'd like to talk too.

You may be a great fit if you

  • Have owned the full IT stack, not one slice, and can tell us what you consolidated and what it saved.
  • Have retired a legacy tool and nobody missed it.
  • Think about automation before headcount when the queue grows.
  • Can explain a security tradeoff to an executive in two minutes and to an auditor in a two-hour deep dive.
  • Have led IT through an acquisition and know what to consolidate first.
  • Are current on modern IT, including cloud identity, SSO and MFA, device management, and zero-trust access, and have run a HIPAA security program hands-on, with working knowledge of frameworks like SOC 2 or HITRUST.
  • Have a team that would say you made them better.
  • Use AI in your own work, have automated real IT operations with it, and have a clear view of the risks.

Nice to have

  • Experience deploying an AI-native service management or help desk automation platform
  • Healthcare provider or health tech experience
  • Experience administering an EHR or practice management system
  • Scripting and automation skills

How we work

Work backwards from the patient. We start with what a patient experiences and build back from there. Sometimes that means launching later, or killing something that looks great on a dashboard but doesn't help anyone get treated.

Urgency with care. Many of our patients arrive after years of treatments that didn't work, and every week of delay costs them. We move fast. We also work with people at their most vulnerable, so we never trade safety or dignity for speed.

Write it down. We decide in writing. Meetings start with silent reading of a PRFAQ or short doc, so the best argument wins instead of the loudest voice. It's slower to write and faster to decide.

Conviction with an open mind. Bring a point of view and argue for it. Change your mind when someone shows you something better, not when they push harder. Once the call is made, back it as if it were yours.

Own the problem, not the lane. Go to where the work happens and learn the details until you understand them better than anyone. If a patient is waiting because of a broken handoff two teams away, it's yours until it's fixed or clearly in someone else's hands. Clinical decisions stay with our clinicians: your job is to raise the issue, not make the call.

Our commitment

Our patients come from every background, and we design for the ones the system has served worst. We build teams the same way. Radial is an equal opportunity employer. We don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Plenty of great candidates rule themselves out too early. If you care about this problem but don't check every box, apply and let us make that call after we've talked.

jobs.excerpt: Sobre el rolEn DaCodes buscamos un/a Senior Product Manager – Delivery / Client Solutions & AI para liderar proyectos digitales desde el entendimiento inicial del problema hasta la definición y entrega de la solución.
jobs.description:
Sobre el rol

En DaCodes buscamos un/a Senior Product Manager – Delivery / Client Solutions & AI para liderar proyectos digitales desde el entendimiento inicial del problema hasta la definición y entrega de la solución.

Este no es un rol de Product Management enfocado únicamente en administrar un backlog, ni un Project Manager centrado en ceremonias, seguimiento y tableros.

Buscamos a alguien capaz de entrar a una conversación con un cliente cuando la solución todavía no está completamente definida, entender cómo funciona su negocio y sus procesos, hacer las preguntas correctas, identificar el problema que realmente necesita resolverse y convertir ese entendimiento en una solución digital que diseño e ingeniería puedan construir.

La posición combina Product Management, Business Discovery, Client Consulting y Software Delivery, incorporando además Inteligencia Artificial como una herramienta práctica para analizar, explorar, prototipar y validar soluciones.

Reportará al Head of Project Managers y trabajará directamente con clientes, diseño y equipos de ingeniería en proyectos de software, procesos de Discovery y oportunidades relacionadas con IA.

Requirements

En DaCodes desarrollamos productos de software a la medida para startups, empresas medianas y grandes. Buscamos a alguien que tome los proyectos desde antes de que exista una solución definida y los lleve hasta su entrega, con autonomía y apoyándose en IA para hacer más con menos.

No buscamos un Project Manager tradicional que administre un tablero. Buscamos a una persona multifacética: que conduzca el discovery con el cliente, convierta lo que escucha en una especificación que el equipo pueda construir, negocie el alcance con criterio, y cuando haga falta, use IA para avanzar en diseño, documentación o pruebas sin esperar a que alguien más se libere.

Qué vas a hacer

Discovery con clientes

  • Conducir sesiones de discovery, desde exprés de 1 o 2 sesiones hasta procesos más profundos, para entender el negocio, la operación, los usuarios y el problema real del cliente.
  • Levantar cómo funciona hoy el proceso: quién participa, con qué volumen, qué sistemas usan y dónde vive la información.
  • Entregar documentación de negocio y técnica (diagramas, flujos, alcance) que sirva como base para estimar y construir.

Definición de producto a nivel especificación

  • Convertir requerimientos ambiguos en soluciones construibles, definiendo roles y permisos, estados, reglas de negocio, excepciones, notificaciones, trazabilidad, integraciones y el alcance mínimo de la primera entrega.
  • Definir junto con UX/UI el comportamiento esperado antes de que ingeniería empiece.
  • Escribir user stories y criterios de aceptación verificables, y priorizar el backlog según valor de negocio, riesgo, esfuerzo y viabilidad.

Gestión de alcance y relación con el cliente

  • Ser el punto de contacto principal del cliente durante todo el proyecto.
  • Cuando el cliente pida algo fuera de alcance, plantear opciones con su impacto en fecha, costo o alcance, y dejar los acuerdos por escrito.
  • Comunicar riesgos y retrasos a tiempo, antes de que el cliente los detecte.

Delivery de punta a punta

  • Tomar ownership de los proyectos desde el kickoff hasta el cierre y el handover.
  • Coordinar el trabajo entre el cliente, UX/UI, ingeniería, QA y otros stakeholders, gestionando dependencias, riesgos y desviaciones.
  • Facilitar las estimaciones con el equipo técnico.
  • Trabajar con metodologías ágiles (Scrum, Kanban o una mezcla) eligiendo la cadencia que el proyecto necesita, no la del manual.
  • Llevar varios proyectos en paralelo, con clientes e industrias distintas.
  • Conocer a fondo la plataforma que se construye: probarla, detectar problemas y poder explicarla al cliente aunque no esté el equipo técnico.

IA aplicada al trabajo

  • Usar IA en todo el ciclo: para analizar información del cliente, prototipar, documentar, generar casos de prueba y automatizar tareas.
  • Apoyar al equipo de diseño, desarrollo o QA con herramientas de IA cuando un proyecto lo requiera, sabiendo dónde sí se necesita a un especialista.

Cómo es el equipo

Cada proyecto se arma según su complejidad. La base suele ser PM, Tech Lead, AI Engineer y QA, y según el caso se suman desarrolladores front y back y diseño UX/UI. Tú lideras al equipo y eres el puente con el cliente.

Lo que buscamos

Imprescindible

  • 5+ años en Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis o consultoría digital, en proyectos de software con clientes externos.
  • Casos propios en los que hayas conducido un discovery y definido qué construir y qué no.
  • Experiencia bajando requerimientos al nivel de detalle que un equipo de ingeniería necesita para construir.
  • Experiencia negociando alcance, fechas o presupuesto con clientes.
  • Uso real de IA más allá de redactar textos: prototipos, automatizaciones, agentes o validación de soluciones.
  • Conocimiento del ciclo de vida del desarrollo de software y del diseño.
  • Inglés B2 a C1 para conducir sesiones con clientes sin apoyo.

Deseable

  • Experiencia en consultoras, nearshore o agencias con varios clientes a la vez.
  • Base técnica: APIs, integraciones, bases de datos.
  • Certificaciones en IA o cloud, por ejemplo AWS o Anthropic.

Este rol probablemente no es para ti si...

  • Tu experiencia principal es administrar ceremonias, tableros o portafolios con marcos como SAFe.
  • Prefieres recibir requerimientos ya definidos en lugar de construirlos con el cliente.
  • Buscas un rol solo estratégico o de dirección, sin involucrarte en el detalle.
  • Buscas un rol de desarrollo o de AI Engineering.

Benefits

🚀 Integración a marcas globales y startups disruptivas.

🏡 Trabajo remoto/Home office.

📍 En caso de requerir modalidad híbrida o presencial, serás informado desde la primera sesión.
⏳ Horario ajustado a la célula de trabajo/proyecto asignado.
📅 Trabajo de lunes a viernes.
🎉 Día off en tu cumpleaños.
🏥 Seguro de gastos médicos mayores (aplica para México).
🛡️ Seguro de vida (aplica para México).
🌎 Equipos de trabajo multiculturales.
🎓 Acceso a cursos y certificaciones.
📢 Meetups con invitados especiales del área de IT.
📡 Eventos virtuales de integración y grupos de interés.
📢 Clases de inglés.
🏆 Oportunidades dentro de nuestras diferentes líneas de negocio.
🏅 Orgullosamente certificados como Great Place to Work.

Information Security and Risk develops, implements, and enforces security controls to protect the organization's technology assets from intentional or inadvertent modification, disclosure, or destruction. The function of this job family is to ensure secure, authorized, and compliant access to the organization's data, systems, and physical resources. It focuses on defining, creating, managing, and governing digital identities and their associated access privileges to protect the enterprise from security breaches, insider threats, and regulatory non-compliance


We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Identity and Access Management (IAM) Engineer to join our Workforce Identity team. In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in designing, implementing, and managing IAM solutions that secure our global workforce and enterprise applications and facilitate the secure, efficient, and seamless integration of identity and access systems in context of our rapid growth through Mergers and Acquisitions. You will ensure robust access controls, streamline user experiences, and maintain operational continuity across our diverse IT landscape. By automating lifecycle events, integrating HR systems, and building intuitive self-service pathways, you will directly influence workforce productivity, security posture, and overall onboarding experience. The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise in modern IAM principles, protocols and products along with strong management and communication skills.

M&A and SSO Integration

  • Lead IAM technical workstreams for Mergers, Acquisitions, and Divestitures.
  • Consolidate disparate identity providers (IdPs) into a unified enterprise SSO platform.

Automation and Workflows

  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable IAM solutions including Single Sign-On (SSO), Identity Lifecycle Management (LCM), Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), and Privileged Access Management (PAM).
  • Develop automated workflows and API-driven integrations to streamline user onboarding, transitions, and offboarding (LCM), reducing manual provisioning overhead.
  • Implement infrastructure-as-code (IaC) principles for configuration management of IAM platforms.

  • Conduct regular access reviews, support IT compliance audits, and ensure systems comply with regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOX) to provide auditable records of access activities.

  • Leverage OTI’s content library and author network to create training that drives skill development and measurable performance improvement for practices

Support learners and practice teams

Forward Deployed Engineer (Data, ML & AI)

Location: Remote Timezone: NA/Eastern Type: Full-time Experience: 10+ Years


Role Overview

This position requires a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) specializing in Data, Machine Learning, and AI to embed directly within customer environments. You will serve as the primary technical authority transforming complex data challenges and operational bottlenecks into production-grade data pipelines, machine learning systems, and agentic AI solutions.

The role is heavily customer-facing: you will work alongside client business units and engineering teams to rapidly assess legacy data estates, build scalable modern data platforms, and deploy custom GenAI/LLM workflows that drive measurable business velocity. This is a high-ownership, hands-on role where you will leverage Spec-Driven Development (SDD) and AI-assisted workflows to build, refactor, and demonstrate immediate value directly where the customer operates.


Key Responsibilities

  • Customer Embedding & Data Delivery: Deploy directly into customer environments to understand their domain logic, underlying data pipelines, and architectural constraints. Own end-to-end delivery—from data discovery and schema design to pipeline deployment and model integration—building trust as the customer's lead technical partner.
  • Data Platform & Architectural Modernization: Partner with client business leaders to evaluate legacy technology estates (e.g., monolithic SQL databases, or unmaintained ETL jobs). Lead engineering efforts to refactor legacy data setups into modern lakehouses, event-driven streaming systems, and scalable vector/graph databases.
  • Spec-Driven Development (SDD) for Data & AI: Apply a "spec-first" engineering workflow using Generative AI tools. Write structured specifications (data models, API schemas, transformations, and evaluation metrics) that instruct AI agents to generate production data models, PySpark jobs, data pipelines, and test suites.
  • Agentic AI & LLMOps Implementation: Architect and deploy GenAI workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and autonomous AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or DSPy. Establish robust evaluation frameworks (Evals) for model accuracy, latency, and hallucination control.
  • Production MLOps & Orchestration: Build, deploy, and maintain robust ML training and inference pipelines using tools like MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, or Dagster. Ensure continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) for models and data workflows.
  • Polyglot Data Engineering: Design and audit production code across data-centric languages and frameworks (Python, SQL, Scala, Go, Rust, or TypeScript) based on speed, concurrency, and memory requirements.
  • Client Enablement & Knowledge Transfer: Elevate customer teams by establishing reusable agentic development patterns, modern MLOps practices, data reliability frameworks, and SDD methodologies so systems remain maintainable long after deployment.

Requirements

  • 10+ Years of Experience: Proven track record as a Principal Data Engineer, Lead ML Engineer, or Enterprise Data Architect building and scaling distributed data and ML platforms.
  • Customer-Facing Aptitude: Strong executive presence and communication skills to interface directly with technical teams and business stakeholders under pressure.
  • Data & ML Engineering Depth:
    • Data Infrastructure: Mastery of distributed computing (AWS Glue, Apache Spark, Databricks), modern data warehouses (Redshift, Snowflake, modeling tools (dbt), and data orchestration (Airflow, etc)
    • AI/ML & Vector Architecture: Hands-on experience fine-tuning, evaluating, and deploying LLMs, embedding models, and vector stores
    • Polyglot & Framework Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Python and complex SQL, plus fluency in at least two other languages used in modern backend/data systems (e.g., Scala, Go, Rust, TypeScript).
  • Generative AI & SDD Experience: Demonstrated skill in using natural language and structured specs to guide AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in generating data pipelines, schemas, and API adapters.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with cloud-native data services on AWS or Azure, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Willingness to Travel: Comfort with occasional travel to customer sites as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in a Forward Deployed Engineer, Data Architect, or technical consulting/professional services role.
  • Experience migrating legacy, on-premise data warehouses or legacy Hadoop estates to modern cloud lakehouses.
  • Deep understanding of data governance, security compliance (HIPAA, SOC2, GDPR), and privacy-preserving machine learning.

Compensation & Perks

  • Competitive compensation package (160K - 180K CAD / year)
  • Retirement Savings Matching Program (RRSP)
  • Access to the latest tech
  • Partnership with Perkopolis Discounts

Flexibility & Time Off

  • Remote first work environment
  • Flexible work hours & location
  • Paid parental leave options

Health & Wellness

  • Employer paid health & dental premiums
  • GreenShield+ Counselling Mental Health
  • $500 in Health Care Spending Account annually

Growth & Development

  • Peer recognition rewards

As an employer, OpsGuru, a Carbon60 Company, recognizes the importance of balancing our careers with other aspects of our lives, and our culture reflects this ethos - from flexible work hours to health and wellness incentives and having fun along the way. We look for people who thrive in an environment of accountability and at times ambiguity as we adapt and grow our business.

OpsGuru is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage applications from people with all levels of ability. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. We thank all applicants for their interest in this exciting opportunity.

Only candidates that meet the qualifications will be contacted for an interview.

Position Description & Requirements

Radiology Associates of Florida (RAF), a Radiology Partners practice, is seeking a Remote Neuroradiologist to join our growing team.This opportunity offers the flexibility and convenience of working from home while providing the stability, collaboration, and clinical excellence of a premier hybrid academic-private practice.

Unlike traditional nationwide teleradiology models,you'lldevelop meaningful relationships with referring physicians and colleagues while serving a focused regional client base. Our collaborative environment ensures that no radiologist works in isolation, with subspecialty support readily available and a team-oriented approach to patient care.

Flexible Scheduling Options

We offer multiple scheduling options designed to fit your lifestyle and career goals, including:

  • Monday through Friday daytime schedules
  • Evening shifts (2:00 PM to 11:00 PM)
  • 7-on / 7-off rotations
  • 12-on / 9-off rotations
  • Alternative scheduling arrangements available based on candidate preferences

Position Highlights

  • 100% remote work from anywhere in the United States
  • Approximately70% Neuroradiologywith a mix of general and emergency radiology
  • Collaboration with neurosurgeons on pre-operative, intra-operative, and post-operative imaging assessments
  • Participation in neuro-oncology imaging, including tumor detection, staging, and treatment monitoring
  • Strong subspecialty support with case distribution tailored to yourexpertise
  • Long-term relationships with referring physicians and a consistent group of facilities

LOCAL PRACTICE AND COMMUNITY OVERVIEW

RAF is the largest radiology practice in Florida. We serve the most prestigious,establishedhealth systems in the state, including on the east and west coasts, the Florida Panhandle, and the Keys. Our scale affords our practice stability and affords our radiologists flexibility in study mix and scheduling. We also recognize that scale alone does not beget excellence. We are quality-oriented, and we practice radiology at thecutting edge, encouraging subspecialty-level interpretations across the practice, andfacilitatingcollaboration and consultation between our radiologists.

Ourstate-of-the-artIT suite includes universal PACS across the practice, AI tools, and integrated doc-to-doc communication widgets. Mosaic Reporting™ uses ambient AI and large language models (LLMs) to structure reports as you speak naturally. You can dictate as ifyou’reteaching a fellow. Just describe what you see, and Mosaic builds the structured report automatically, even inserting normal findings for you.

Our practice is locally and democratically led, with decisions vested in the hands of the group at large, rather than in a few founders or a small group of shareholders. We are the teaching physicians for the University of South Florida Department of Radiology in Tampa. In Sarasota, our physicians’staffthe Florida State University College of Medicine, hosting medical students in their 3rd and 4th years. We also invite residents from the FSU Internal Medicine and Emergency Medicine Residency programs to rotate in our departments.

Our diverse group of radiologists work and socialize together in our communities around Florida. Even between our communities across the state, we are one practice. We look forward to letting you get to knowusbetter!

Get to know our practice!

DESIRED PROFESSIONAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Candidates must be a Doctor of Medicine or Osteopathy and residency trained in the practice of Diagnostic Radiology
  • Board eligible or certified by the American Board of Radiology or the American Osteopathic Board of Radiology
  • Candidates with fellowship training in Neuroradiologyispreferred.
  • Medical license or the ability to obtain a license in the state of FL
  • Fellows and residents welcome to apply

COMPENSATION:

The salary range for this position is $500,000-$1,000,000. Final determinations may vary based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, geographic location etc. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to this range, Radiology Partners offers competitive total rewards packages, which include health & wellness coverage options, 401k benefits, and a broad range of other benefits such as family planning and telehealth (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements).

FOR MORE INFORMATION OR TO APPLY:

For inquiries about this position, please contact Nicole Maclin 843-300-1623.

RADIOLOGY PARTNERS OVERVIEW

Radiology Partners, through its affiliated practices, is a leading radiology practice in the U.S., serving hospitals and other healthcare facilities across the nation. As a physician-led and physician-owned practice, we advance our bold mission by innovating across clinical value, technology,serviceand economics, while elevating the role of radiology and radiologists in healthcare. Using a proven healthcare services model, Radiology Partners provides consistent, high-quality care to patients, while delivering enhanced value to the hospitals, clinics, imagingcentersand referring physicians we serve.

Radiology Partners is an equalopportunityemployer. RP is committed to being an inclusive,safeand welcoming environment where everyone has equal access andequitableresources to reach their full potential. We are united by our Mission to Transform Radiology and in turn have an important impact on the patients we serve and the healthcare system overall. We hold that diversity is a key source of strength from which we will build a practice culture that is inclusive for all. Our goal is to empower and engage the voice of every teammate to promote awareness,compassionanda healthy respectfor differences.

TikTok moves fast, and so do we.

As our TikTok Content Manager, you'll take ownership of TikTok content strategy, planning, publishing, and performance. You'll work closely with Content Creators, Video Editors, and Creative Strategists to develop content that captures attention, builds audiences, and drives engagement.

jobs.title: Solutions Support Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About VGSVGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce.
jobs.description:
About VGS

VGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce. As commerce becomes agentic, payments are increasing dramatically in volume, speed, and complexity, and the companies driving that shift need a foundation they can fully trust.

That's where VGS comes in. We're the world's leader in payment tokenization, trusted by the most innovative AI and Fortune 500 companies, merchants, banks, and fintechs to power modern payments and agentic commerce. We store more than 9 billion tokens and process more than 10 billion monthly interactions, touching a third of all e-commerce. That scale isn't incidental. It's why leading companies embed our universal token vault and credential management platform directly into their stack, taming the complexity of payment data so they can move faster.

Come build the platform that enables modern payments for the world's largest companies. We're helping businesses unlock new possibilities in an industry that never stops moving. And that takes exceptional people.

About the Role

VGS is hiring a Solutions Support Engineer in Europe to be the technical front door for our European prospects and customers. As part of our European and Support organization, you will bring your expertise to the earliest stage of the relationship: scoping use cases, mapping payment flows, and designing the solution with EU Sales. Once the client is onboarded, you will continue to provide ongoing technical support. Roughly three-quarters of your time will be spent on solution work, and the remainder will be spent on technical support.

This is a growth role for a senior support, integration, or solutions engineer who wants to move upstream, and you will help shape how Solutions and Support work together in Europe.

You will operate largely in the region alongside the EU team, while the US Solutions team is offline, with a few hours of overlap with the US team towards the end of your day. We are looking for a payments nerd who, in a single day, can earn a prospect CTO's trust, map a complex payment flow with an existing customer's payments leader, help a colleague in Sales through a technical conversation, and trace a failing integration with the customer's engineers. You will partner with payment companies and enterprise merchants on global payment infrastructure, processor connectivity, credential portability, tokenization, and sensitive payment data.

You will work with the European team through the deal lifecycle, hand over approved designs to the Implementation team, and oversee them through go-live, provide support on solution questions, and stay aligned with the US Solutions team. What you learn in the field goes to Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap and our go-to-market strategy.

What You’ll Do

Solutions work for EU clients and teams (about 75% of the role)

  • Conduct technical discovery with EU prospects and customers, Sales, and Account Management to clarify business goals, requirements, risks, and product gaps.

  • Partner with EU Sales on technical strategy for strategic opportunities, from discovery through architecture approval, and support other EU opportunities.

  • Map payment flows across merchants, PSPs, processors, acquirers, card networks, wallets, and third parties.

  • Architect solutions using VGS capabilities, including vaulting, card management, Network and Agentic Tokens, Account Updater, 3DS, wallet payments, account validation, and data security.

  • Guide customers on payment security best practices, PCI scope reduction, credential portability, multi-processor setups, resiliency, and scaling.

  • Create and deliver architecture diagrams, proposals, demos, and proofs of concept, and support EU responses to RFIs, security reviews, and architecture assessments.

  • Back up EU Sales, Implementation, and Support colleagues in client conversations that need solutions depth, and coach them on solutioning with VGS.

  • Produce detailed handoffs to the Implementation team covering solution architecture, assumptions, responsibilities, testing, success metrics, and out-of-scope items, then coordinate with Support to provide technical oversight through go-live to ensure the implementation matches the approved architecture.

  • Serve as the solution-level escalation point for Support, helping diagnose and redesign where a customer's setup is the root cause.

  • Turn customer and market feedback into input for the product roadmap, and build reusable reference architectures, integration patterns, and enablement for the EU teams.

  • Coordinate with the US-based Solutions team so EU work stays consistent with VGS standards: reuse existing payment flow maps, solution designs, and reference architectures, bring new EU use cases and capability gaps back to them, and share the patterns and enablement you build.

Overflow technical support (about 25% of the role)

  • When there are no active implementations, take overflow tickets during EU business hours.

  • Reproduce issues with cURL and Postman, read logs, and trace requests across VGS infrastructure, customer systems, and downstream gateways.

  • Diagnose network problems independently, including DNS, TCP/IP, routing, timeouts, connection resets, and TLS/SSL handshake failures.

  • Resolve the issue, find a workaround, or escalate with a bug report that Engineering can act on immediately.

  • Write up nontrivial investigations as internal runbooks or public documentation, and build and deliver customer training where none exists.

  • When an incident or maintenance event affects EU customers, flag the impact to the on-call lead and help draft status page updates and customer notices.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years in technical support, integration or implementation engineering, solutions engineering, technical account management, or solutions architecture, with some of it in a senior or lead capacity.

  • Proven ability to work independently as the technical expert in a customer-facing role, deciding and then reporting rather than checking first.

  • Background at a merchant, PSP, processor, acquirer, issuer, card network, or payment infrastructure company.

  • Experience with large-scale card or credential migrations, and with multi-PSP, payment orchestration, processor-routing, or payment portability strategies.

  • Knowledge of PCI DSS, data security, privacy, and compliance architecture.

  • Strong communication skills: comfortable explaining complex concepts to technical and non-technical audiences, creating clear solution diagrams, supporting customer executive briefings, and coaching colleagues in Sales, Implementation, and Support.

  • Strong command of HTTP, REST APIs, and proxies, and independent network debugging (DNS, TCP/IP, routing, TLS/SSL handshakes). Be ready to describe a specific problem you diagnosed and how you narrowed it down.

  • Ability to read and debug code and to write working code examples in at least one of Python, JavaScript, Java, or Ruby.

  • A knack for out-of-the-box thinking that thrives in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • English at C1 or above, written and spoken.

  • Strong collaboration, negotiation, and prioritization skills.

  • Willingness to work EU business hours on a sustained basis.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with tokenization, payment processing, cryptology, or security products.

  • Direct experience with card network programs (Visa, Mastercard), such as network tokenization or account updater services.

  • Familiarity with the EU payments and data context, such as PSD2/SCA and GDPR.

  • Industry certifications such as PCI QSA, CPP (Certified Payments Professional), CISSP, or AWS Solutions Architect.

  • BA/BS degree.

We're looking for passionate professionals who take pride in their craft and want to help grow a team tackling some of the most critical problems in payments. People who thrive here are curious by nature, unafraid of hard problems, and motivated by the chance to build something that matters at scale.

If you're driven to make a meaningful impact, work at the leading edge of payment technology, and grow your career alongside a team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning, you'll feel right at home at VGS.

Our Benefits

Financial and retirement

  • Competitive salary

  • 401 (k) with a 4% match and immediate vesting (applies to US only)

  • Early equity

  • Internet Stipend

  • Learning Stipend

  • Office set-up stipend (applies to US only)

Health and Wellness

  • Insurance (medical, dental, and vision)

  • HSA/FSA Options

  • Life and disability insurance

  • Pet insurance

Vacation and time off

  • Flexible PTO

  • Paid national holidays

  • Global parental leave program

Professional Development

  • Promote from within

  • Lunch and learns

  • Team events and summits

Office life and perks

  • Remote and hybrid opportunities

  • Flexible working hours

  • Weekly office lunches

  • Employee discount platform

Equal Opportunity

We consider all applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, marital status, physical or mental disability, or other protected classes under all applicable local, state, and federal laws and ordinances (AA/EOE/W/M/Vet/Disabled).

Qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for this position in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.
