jobs.description:
Remote option is available for this position.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No sponsorship is available for this position.

Are you eager to develop your excellence in an inclusive, collaborative, and empowering community? Are you excited about joining a company that strives to make a difference – for its employees, clients, and society? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature?

If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Workplace Management team and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your new role

This role provides senior HSEQ leadership across Ramboll’s EPC/EPCM project portfolio in Ramboll Americas, supporting the safe delivery of complex engineering, procurement, construction management, commissioning, and turnover activities. The role is responsible for establishing consistent HSEQ governance, aligning contractors and project teams, supporting high-risk work planning, and enabling effective execution across multiple concurrent projects. The successful candidate will bring significant hands-on experience from large-scale EPC/EPCM construction environments and will be able to operate confidently at both strategic and field execution levels.

The ideal candidate will be a credible HSEQ leader with significant field experience on large-scale construction or EPC/EPCM projects, strong contractor management capability, and the confidence to influence senior project, client, and contractor stakeholders. They will be comfortable working across multiple projects, balancing strategic governance with practical field-based support, and helping project teams create consistent, risk-based HSEQ execution.

Your key responsibilities will be:

Strategic HSEQ Leadership

  • Lead the development of a portfolio-wide HSEQ approach that enables consistent standards, scalable processes, and project-specific execution across all EPC/EPCM projects.
  • Serve as primary HSEQ advisor to Project Directors and EPC/EPCM leadership teams.
  • Drive adoption of Ramboll’s HSEQ program and translate its expectations into practical project-level behaviours, controls, and leadership routines.
  • Provide strategic HSEQ guidance during proposals and contract negotiations to align client expectations and establish the conditions needed for effective safety management.
  • Provide HSEQ leadership within an EPC/EPCM delivery model, ensuring clear boundaries, responsibilities, and interfaces between Ramboll, clients, construction contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers.
  • Safety Program Organization & Implementation
  • Define HSEQ organization structures that are scalable with the ability to support multi-project EPC/EPCM delivery on a nationwide basis.
  • Clarify roles, responsibilities, interfaces, and governance models required for integrated EPC/EPCM/ safety programs.
  • Establish standardized HSEQ execution plans across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and turnover.
  • Establish construction readiness expectations, including contractor mobilisation, competency assurance, risk review, and field execution controls.

  • Contractor & Multi-Party Coordination

  • Align HSEQ expectations, execution standards, and performance requirements across contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and third-party stakeholders.
  • Lead contractor onboarding, alignment sessions, audits, and recurring performance reviews.
  • Ensure HSEQ requirements are embedded into contracting strategies, procurement packages, bid documents, mobilisation plans, and contractor management processes.
  • Support project teams in translating Ramboll and client HSEQ requirements into practical field execution requirements for contractors and subcontractors.

  • Risk Management, Governance and Assurance

  • Provide governance and assurance over EPC/EPCM risk management processes, including hazard identification, construction risk assessments, high-risk work reviews, and site controls.
  • Support project HSEQ resources and project leadership in establishing consistent risk management expectations, while ensuring accountability remains clear within the project delivery structure.
  • Review and challenge the effectiveness of controls for high-risk activities, including lifting, electrical work, confined space entry, work at height, ground disturbance, energisation, commissioning, and simultaneous operations.
  • Provide oversight, escalation support, and subject matter input for high-potential or higher-severity incidents, ensuring investigations are completed and lessons learned are embedded across relevant projects.
  • Conduct site visits, leadership engagements, and assurance reviews to verify that project HSEQ controls are effective, understood, and consistently applied by the relevant project teams and contractors.

  • Safety Culture & Engagement

  • Demonstrate visible HSEQ leadership that builds trust, accountability, and proactive safety behaviours across project teams and contractors.
  • Coach project and contractor leadership teams to strengthen leading indicators, reinforce expectations, and promote consistent safety leadership.
  • Promote open communication, psychological safety, learning, and continuous improvement across the EPC/EPCM project portfolio.

  • Regulatory & Compliance Oversight

  • Provide oversight of compliance with applicable health, safety, and environmental regulations, client requirements, and Ramboll HSEQ standards across EPC/EPCM projects.
  • Support project teams in translating regulatory and contractual HSEQ requirements into practical controls and assurance activities.
  • Represent Ramboll in client audits, regulatory inspections, and EPC/EPCM governance meetings, ensuring actions are effectively tracked, communicated, and closed.

  • Performance Management & Reporting

  • Establish consistent HSEQ performance reporting across EPC/EPCM projects, using leading and lagging indicators to identify trends, drive accountability, and improve performance.
  • Translate performance data into clear insights, actions, and recommendations for project leadership, clients, contractors, and internal stakeholders.

About you

  • Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, or related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive on-site HSEQ leadership experience with substantial large-scale EPC/EPCM project exposure.
  • Strong background supporting multi-contractor, high-risk industrial construction environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Proven experience supporting construction management delivery models where HSEQ performance is delivered through contractor execution and strong client/contractor interface management.
  • Working knowledge of construction-phase HSEQ controls, contractor management, incident investigation, assurance, and regulatory compliance.
  • Ability to travel regularly to project locations and engage effectively with field teams, project leadership, clients, and contractors.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred:

  • Professional certifications (CSP, CMIOSH, NEBOSH, CRSP, or equivalent).
  • Experience with energy transition, power, renewables, industrial de-carbonisation, chemicals, manufacturing, mining, or major infrastructure projects.
  • Experience supporting owner’s EPC/EPCM models across multiple concurrent projects.
  • International or remote project experience.

What we can offer you

  • Investment in your development
  • Being valued for the unique person you are
  • Never being short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
  • The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Salary Transparency Statement

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $136,497 - $197,515 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Ready to join us?

Please submit your application with your up-to-date CV. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.

Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.excerpt: About QC Servion QC Servion is the centralized hub for human resources, change management, program management, sales & marketing, safety, administration, legal, and accounting services across the QC Ecosystem.
jobs.description:
About QC Servion

QC Servion is the centralized hub for human resources, change management, program management, sales & marketing, safety, administration, legal, and accounting services across the QC Ecosystem.

We provide comprehensive operational support that empowers our companies to focus on growth, innovation, and excellence, while ensuring employees thrive in safe, engaging, and well-managed environments.

The entities in our ecosystem include DLB Associates, Galtra Solutions, AI2IO, Fluid2Chip, CEQEL Critical Commissioning, and 2AI-DC Integrators. Collectively, we deliver services across the data center industry.

Position: Recruiting Specialist

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Salary

QC Servion recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.

Job Summary

The Recruiting Specialist plays a critical role in driving full-cycle recruiting and proactive talent sourcing across a diverse portfolio of technical, project-based, field, operational, and corporate roles. This may include mechanical and electrical engineers, designers, commissioning professionals, field technicians, project and program professionals, and corporate/shared-services functions.

As a key member of the HR team, the Recruiting Specialist partners closely with hiring managers and cross-functional stakeholders to understand role requirements, business priorities, and talent market dynamics. This position is responsible for developing strong candidate pipelines, advising hiring teams, delivering a high-quality candidate experience, and driving efficient, data-informed hiring decisions.

The ideal candidate is an experienced recruiting professional who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and can move comfortably between highly technical searches and broader corporate hiring needs. This person should be proactive, resourceful, organized, and capable of independently managing a high-volume workload while maintaining strong relationships with candidates and hiring teams.

Essential Functions

Talent Acquisition & Recruiting (95%)

  • Own and manage full-cycle recruitment for approximately 15–30 active requisitions, ensuring consistent pipeline activity and timely movement of candidates through each stage.
  • Lead requisition intake and calibration discussions with hiring managers to understand position requirements, candidate profiles, business priorities, and interview expectations.
  • Proactively source and engage qualified talent using LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, internal databases, specialized sourcing channels, and targeted outreach strategies.
  • Recruit across technical, field-based, project, operational, and corporate functions, adapting sourcing and screening approaches based on the needs of each search.
  • Screen and evaluate candidates for technical qualifications, experience, career alignment, communication skills, and overall position fit.
  • Build strong partnerships with hiring managers through regular communication and recurring hiring syncs focused on priorities, pipeline health, market feedback, and interview outcomes.
  • Manage high-volume candidate and stakeholder communication with a focus on responsiveness, professionalism, and engagement.
  • Coordinate interviews and help maintain process momentum by minimizing scheduling delays and communication gaps.
  • Own interviewer feedback collection and follow-up, driving accountability and timely hiring decisions.
  • Lead the offer process from verbal offer through formal documentation and acceptance, ensuring clear communication and a positive candidate experience.
  • Maintain accurate and current information within the ATS to provide visibility into pipeline health, recruiting activity, and hiring progress.
  • Use recruiting data and market insights to identify pipeline challenges, recommend adjustments, and improve hiring outcomes.
  • Maintain consistent candidate engagement throughout the hiring lifecycle, including searches that require longer decision timelines.
  • Leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve sourcing, screening, communication, and administrative workflows.

Human Resources Support (5%)

  • Provide general HR, research, and administrative support based on team and business priorities.
  • Assist with employee engagement initiatives and HR projects as needed.
  • Support documentation and improvement of HR procedures and workflows, identifying opportunities to streamline and automate processes.
  • Collaborate with the broader HR team on initiatives that support employee experience and organizational growth.

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Communications, or a related field with 5+ years of progressive full-cycle recruiting and sourcing experience; equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Demonstrated experience recruiting for engineering, commissioning, and other highly technical roles, with the versatility to shift between technical hiring and corporate/shared-services functions as business needs evolve.
  • Proven ability to independently manage a high-volume requisition load from intake and sourcing through interviewing, offer, and close.
  • Strong proactive sourcing capabilities using LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, internal databases, and specialized talent channels.
  • Experience partnering directly with hiring managers to understand business needs, calibrate candidate profiles, provide market insight, and drive hiring decisions forward.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage, advise, and influence candidates and hiring stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of recruiting best practices, candidate experience, and broader HR processes.
  • Experience managing pipelines and maintaining accurate recruiting data within an applicant tracking system; Rippling ATS experience preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Teams.
  • High attention to detail with the ability to manage competing priorities, deadlines, and a high volume of candidate activity.
  • Experience leveraging AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve sourcing, screening, recruiting workflows, and overall efficiency.

Physical Demands

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is:

  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position.
  • Frequently moving through home office.
  • May occasionally lift up to 20 pounds.

Travel Requirements

  • Up to 5%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states.
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meeting for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

Benefits

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option).
  • Flex spending accounts (FSA).
  • Dental and vision plans.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26.
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option.
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year.
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents.
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage.
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement, and professional licensing assistance.
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment.

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is QC Servion's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

EEO

QC Servion provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Notice To Third Party Agencies
QC Servion does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to QC Servion in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where QC Servion has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. jobs.excerpt: If you think your skills, experience and aspirations make you a good match for this position, we encourage you to apply.
jobs.description:
If you think your skills, experience and aspirations make you a good match for this position, we encourage you to apply. This position may be filled anywhere in the United States. Preference may be given to candidates that can work in one of the CannonDesign locations.
As part of the application process, candidates should show us their creativity and ability to influence and bring strategy to life through visual and verbal storytelling. Please redact proprietary/confidential information as needed. Note: We acknowledge that developing these items is highly collaborative. That said, we’re looking for examples where you had a primary role in their creation. You’ll be given time to present your work during the interview — we’re interested in “how” you present your work, too.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Step into a role where ambition meets impact and innovation drives opportunity. We’re seeking a creative problem solver to work alongside firm leaders to influence strategy and drive success. This role is ideal for those who play to win, are excited by a challenge and excel at drawing insights that others might overlook.
We work in high-pressure environments, but we’ve cultivated a close-knit community built on shared knowledge, best practices and mutual support. Your drive, diligence and inquisitive nature will be key to challenging pursuit teams to deliver transformative results.
As a Pursuit Strategist, you’ll be part of our Brand, Marketing and Business Development (BMBD) team, reporting to our National Marketing Pursuits Leader and collaborating closely with the entire marketing team, as well as business developers, graphic designers, and market and client leaders throughout the firm.

Success in this role will require the ability to transform raw information into meaningful narratives that inform decision-making and inspire action. You’ll need creativity, strong writing skills and a collaborative spirit to bring ideas to life alongside our talented team. And you’ll be called upon to translate your strategic marketing instincts and talents to serve multiple areas of expertise housed within the firm.
HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL DO
Strategic Proposal Marketing
  • Lead strategy development for our firm’s most significant and complex project pursuits.
  • During early phases of the Strategic Pursuit Process, you’ll develop an overall action plan that includes profiles of decision-makers and influencers, a competitor analysis, a SWOT analysis and comprehensive market research, all of which you’ll use to develop insights that inform our strategy.
  • Partner closely with the Opportunity Leader to develop a project-specific win plan (client issues, features, benefits and proof statements), strategic teaming plan and spearhead the preliminary go/no go and strategy review.
  • Lead the effective facilitation of strategy sessions/workshops to develop a pursuit strategy targeted to the client’s needs. Drive an established agenda, guide the creative brainstorming process, challenge and tests ideas, develop action items and assignments, and synthesize the intelligence, outcomes and next steps of these sessions.
  • Ensure the greatest possibility of success by supporting compliance, readability and messaging of pursuit-related materials.
  • Collaborate with opportunity leaders and marketing leads to organize and determine the objectives of strategy sessions/workshops according to our strategic pursuit process. Identify and engage local, regional and firm resources to support the win-planning process.
  • Partner with pursuit teams to develop and implement differentiators, value propositions, key messages, project approaches and successful interview presentations.
  • Partner with the proposal content team, subject matter experts and our BMBD team to ensure messaging is translated into a compelling narrative with graphics that provide visual storytelling that reinforces and amplifies our pursuit theme throughout the proposal.
  • Serve as a presentation rehearsal coach and facilitator to organize and prepare teams for client presentations and interviews.
  • Participate in win/loss debriefs and identify and leverage lessons learned to inform future pursuits.
  • Coach and mentor Marketing Specialists and Senior Marketing Specialists across the region in proposal strategy and strategic storytelling.

Firm Knowledge & Subject Matter Expertise

  • Develop strong, in-depth knowledge of the firm’s portfolio and personnel and brand (how we express ourselves visually and verbally) to connect with clients and differentiate ourselves in the marketplace.
  • Develop subject matter expertise (across markets, typologies, services, technology or other) that adds value to our marketing initiatives and pursuit activities.

Management & Operations

  • Work with our National Marketing Pursuits Leader and Regional Marketing Team Leaders to train and develop our Senior/Marketing Specialists.
  • Provide peer review and oversight for accuracy and quality of content.
  • Self-review all work for accuracy and quality of content.

Other

  • Up to 25% travel expected.
  • May participate in external marketing activities.
HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL NEED
  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, communications or a related field required.
  • Minimum of 8 years of related work experience required. 10+ years of related work experience preferred.
  • Related experience working in a proposal management role influencing strategy and content for a professional services firm required.
  • Related experience working in the Architecture, Engineering and/or Construction industry preferred.
  • Strong proficiency with InDesign, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Familiarity with Deltek CRM Vision, Salesforce and Miro is a plus.
Core Competencies
  • Strategic thinker able to translate ideas into plans, goals and role assignments with measures to ensure implementation.
  • Enthusiasm for working as part of a driven and disciplined team, with a motivation to overcome hurdles and obstacles to find solutions.
  • Ability to command a room, gain consensus and navigate team and organizational dynamics effectively.
  • Strong time and project management skills, along with the ability to manage up as you work with large teams in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Solid skills and confidence in driving a process.
  • Able to inspire and collaborate with a creative team to bring ideas to life.
  • Effective communicator — able to share ideas with confidence and clarity, and shape creative and compelling narratives.
The salary range for this position is $ 83,200 to $104,000 annually. This salary range is the range we believe is the anticipated range of possible base compensation at the timing of the posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the anticipated salary range for the position. Employees may be eligible for discretionary bonuses. We offer a full benefit package including medical, dental and vision coverage and flexible spending account options and voluntary insurances. We have paid time off, flex-time schedules, remote work options and a 401k plan and employee perk programs. For a general overview of our benefits, please visit our careers page at . Actual compensation may vary from posting based on geographic location, work experience, education and/or skill level.
ABOUT OUR FIRM
CannonDesign is a design practice where strategy, experience, architecture, engineering, and social impact converge. We don’t just dream up solutions — we create and bring them to life in ways to solve some of the biggest challenges facing our clients and the society. At the heart of everything we do is Living-Centered Design, a bold commitment to using our talents to not just improve the world but to truly reshape it for the better. It’s more than a philosophy — it’s who we are, and it drives us to make a meaningful, lasting difference every day.
ABOUT WORKING HERE
  • We are relentless in our pursuit of client adoration (not simply satisfaction). Consistent delivery of the best service is what we are about.
  • We are committed to ensuring our practice provides equal opportunities for all employees, as we strive to connect with communities around us and focus on the future of design. We support equity, diversity, and inclusion efforts that benefit all employees through the leadership of our DEI Council, our Employee Resource Groups which are open to everyone, and other community initiatives.
  • We’re about communication and transparency here. If you want to talk to someone about an idea you have, or a challenge that needs addressing, we’re ready for you.
Please note that candidates can only apply to our positions on our company Careers site. It's not uncommon for scammers to create positions that look legitimate on other sites; never enter your information or apply for CannonDesign positions on any platform. Should an issue arise that you feel we should be aware of, please contact us. Please provide your resume and portfolio when applying.
As a condition of employment, all employees are expected to complete mandatory training, including compliance training, within required timeframes and adhere to our internal policies and our Code of Conduct.

It is therefore the firm’s policy to prohibit discrimination and harassment against any applicant, CannonDesign employee, vendor, contractor, or client on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. jobs.excerpt: SimpleTiger is hiring a part-time contract web developer to build, improve, and troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot, with the potential to grow into a larger role.
jobs.description:
SimpleTiger is hiring a part-time contract web developer to build, improve, and troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot, with the potential to grow into a larger role.

We’re a B2B SaaS marketing agency helping software companies grow through SEO, content marketing, paid media, and answer engine optimization (AEO). Our clients’ websites are where much of that work comes to life, and we’re looking for a developer who can turn ideas into clean, functional pages quickly.

As part of our delivery team, you’ll work primarily on client websites, translating designs, campaign concepts, and SEO recommendations into effective web experiences. From building new pages to fixing issues on existing sites, you’ll help turn our marketing strategy into work that’s ready to launch.

Key responsibilities

  • Build, update, or troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot CMS

  • Make technical fixes and improvements to live client sites, with clear details on what was tested, implemented, and performance comparisons using tools like Screaming Frog, pagespeed insights, and Lighthouse

  • Build and connect forms, lead routing, and simple automations between a site and the client’s marketing tools

  • Set up and check tracking, like GA4, Google Tag Manager, and HubSpot tracking in Tandem with the SEO Manager

  • Keep sites fast, accessible, and friendly to SEO (page speed, Core Web Vitals, clean markup, image optimizations, cache lifetime improvements, and so on)

  • Write clear and timely notes on what you are actively working on, and any updates pushed live so our team and the client can follow along

Qualifications and skills

  • You’re a hands-on developer who can build from scratch, troubleshoot existing sites, and make improvements without disrupting what’s already working.

Required skills

  • WordPress development: Strong experience with custom themes, child themes, blocks, page builders, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF). You can build a page from the ground up—not just edit an existing one.

  • HubSpot CMS development: Strong experience with HubL templates, modules, and themes, including building and troubleshooting pages, forms, and email templates.

  • Front-end development: Solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills, with the ability to navigate existing code and understand how changes affect the live site.

  • APIs and integrations: Experience working with the HubSpot or WordPress REST APIs, plus CRMs and marketing tools such as Salesforce, Zapier, n8n, Airtable, and Slack.

  • Technical audits and fixes: Experience using Screaming Frog to audit WordPress and HubSpot sites, interpret findings, and resolve technical issues.

  • Code review and cleanup: Comfort working within WordPress and HubSpot codebases to identify legacy or unused JavaScript and CSS, determine what’s still needed, and safely remove what isn’t.

  • Async communication: Clear, timely written communication, especially through Slack.

  • Independent work: Strong time management and the ability to meet deadlines, flag blockers early, and keep projects moving without close supervision.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Webflow development and auditing experience, including building a clean CMS structure.

  • PHP development experience.

  • Previous work at a marketing agency or with B2B SaaS clients.

  • Familiarity with SEO and conversion best practices.

  • Experience with Git and version control.

What success looks like

Success means delivering clean, reliable development work that helps our team turn marketing plans into live client experiences.

  • Designs, campaign concepts, and SEO requests become functional pages in WordPress and HubSpot.

  • Technical audit findings lead to practical fixes, with changes tested to avoid breaking existing functionality.

  • Legacy and unused code is cleaned up thoughtfully, while essential code and front-end behavior remain intact.

  • Forms, templates, and integrations work as intended and support the client’s marketing workflows.

  • Projects stay on track because you manage your workload, meet agreed deadlines, and raise questions or blockers early.

  • Teammates have clear visibility into progress through timely updates and straightforward communication in Slack.

About RSI Security

RSI Security is a leading cybersecurity and compliance consulting firm helping organizations navigate complex regulatory and security requirements. Our consultants partner with clients across healthcare, life sciences, financial services, technology, manufacturing, and other regulated industries to build practical, scalable compliance programs that reduce risk while enabling business growth.

Position Summary

The GDPR Compliance Consultant serves as a trusted advisor responsible for helping organizations achieve and maintain compliance with the European Union General Data Protection Regulation (EU GDPR) and UK GDPR.

Working directly with executive leadership, legal counsel, privacy teams, IT, security, HR, and business stakeholders, this consultant conducts privacy assessments, develops compliance programs, prepares required documentation, and implements practical privacy governance processes.

The ideal candidate possesses deep knowledge of international privacy regulations, strong consulting experience, and the ability to translate complex legal requirements into actionable business controls.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Conduct GDPR and UK GDPR readiness assessments and gap analyses. ● Develop and implement GDPR compliance programs and remediation roadmaps. ● Prepare and maintain Records of Processing Activities (ROPA).
  • Perform Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), Legitimate Interest Assessments (LIAs), and Transfer Impact Assessments (TIAs).
  • Draft, review, and negotiate Data Processing Agreements (DPAs). ● Review privacy notices, consent mechanisms, cookie disclosures, and privacy documentation.
  • Design and implement Data Subject Rights (DSAR) processes.
  • Advise clients on international data transfer requirements including EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), UK IDTA/Addendum, and the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.
  • Assess third-party privacy risks and support vendor due diligence activities. ● Develop privacy policies, governance documentation, and operational procedures. ● Support organizations processing special category data, including healthcare and clinical research information.
  • Provide guidance regarding Article 27 representative requirements and supervisory authority interactions.
  • Deliver client workshops, executive presentations, and privacy awareness training. ● Collaborate with cybersecurity consultants to align privacy and security controls. ● Remain current on GDPR guidance, enforcement actions, and evolving privacy regulations.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Privacy, Law, Business, Computer Science, Healthcare Administration, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

Professional Experience

  • Experience drafting and reviewing Data Processing Agreements. ● Experience developing privacy governance programs.

● UK GDPR

● Transfer Impact Assessments (TIAs)

● Data Subject Rights (DSAR)

● Data Processing Agreements (DPAs)

● International Data Transfers

  • EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs)

● UK IDTA/Addendum

● EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework

● Vendor Risk Management

● Privacy by Design

● Privacy Governance Frameworks

  • Article 27 Representative Requirements

● Consent Management

● Privacy Notices

● Data Mapping

● Data Retention

● Special Category Data Processing

● Healthcare

● Life Sciences

● Biotechnology

● Clinical Research

● Pharmaceutical

● Medical Device

● SaaS

● Technology

Knowledge of the following is preferred:

● ICH-GCP

● Clinical Trial Regulations

● Informed Consent Requirements

● HIPAA

Preferred Certifications

● CIPP/E

● CIPM

● CIPT

● ISO/IEC 27701 Lead Implementer

● ISO/IEC 27701 Lead Auditor

● ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer

● ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor

● Risk Assessment

● Executive Communication

● Client Relationship Management

● Problem Solving

● Project Management

● Cross-functional Collaboration

● Presentation Skills

● Critical Thinking

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by the consultant's ability to:

  • Deliver GDPR consulting engagements on time and within scope. ● Produce high-quality compliance documentation requiring minimal revisions. ● Successfully guide clients toward GDPR compliance.
  • Maintain high client satisfaction ratings.
  • Identify privacy risks and recommend practical remediation strategies. ● Build trusted advisor relationships with executive stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Stress Testing Manager serves as a subject matter expert for enterprise stress testing and quantitative risk modeling. This role is responsible for the development, implementation, execution, enhancement, and governance of stress testing models used to assess risk primarily across the loan and deposit portfolios, but also provides key support for capital and liquidity stress testing processes. The position will leverage both third-party solutions, including Moody's analytical platforms, and internally developed models to evaluate the impact of adverse economic conditions on portfolio performance and emerging risk exposures.

Working within the Second Line of Defense (SLOD), the Stress Testing Manager provides independent challenge to assumptions, methodologies, and model outputs while supporting the Bank's Enterprise Risk Management framework. This individual will partner closely with Credit, Finance, Treasury, Model Risk Management, and Enterprise Risk Management teams to ensure stress testing practices remain robust, analytically sound, and aligned with strategic and regulatory expectations.

The role requires a highly analytical and inquisitive professional with significant quantitative modeling experience, strong statistical expertise, and the ability to communicate complex analytical concepts to senior management.

Duties & Responsibilities

Stress Testing and Scenario Analytics

  • Lead the execution, enhancement, and ongoing administration of enterprise loan portfolio stress testing programs.
  • Utilize and maintain third-party stress testing solutions, including Moody's risk and portfolio analytics platforms.
  • Develop and implement proprietary stress testing methodologies for specialized segments of the loan portfolio.
  • Design and execute scenario analyses, sensitivity analyses, and adverse economic stress tests to evaluate portfolio vulnerabilities.
  • Translate macroeconomic assumptions into expected portfolio performance outcomes, including credit quality deterioration, migration trends, and expected loss projections.
  • Identify emerging portfolio risks and communicate key findings to management through meaningful analytics and reporting.
  • Apply advanced quantitative techniques including regression analysis, time-series forecasting, machine learning methods, Monte Carlo simulation, and scenario analytics.
  • Perform data analysis and model development using Python, SQL, and other analytical tools.
  • Evaluate model performance through back-testing, benchmarking, sensitivity testing, and ongoing performance monitoring.
  • Continuously enhance methodologies to improve predictive accuracy and analytical value.

Deposit and Liquidity Risk Analytics

  • Assist in the development of stress testing methodologies for deposit portfolios and funding stability analysis.
  • Support Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), Treasury, and Finance teams by providing analytical insight related to liquidity stress scenarios and deposit behavior under stressed conditions.
  • Work with Financial Risk Management (FRM) to develop quantitative approaches to evaluate deposit concentration, attrition, runoff assumptions, and customer behavior across economic cycles.

Governance and Model Risk Management

  • Maintain comprehensive model documentation, methodology documents, assumptions inventories, and supporting analytical materials.
  • Support Model Risk Management activities by ensuring models adhere to established governance standards and validation requirements.
  • Assist independent validation efforts through development of documentation, data support, model inventories, and performance monitoring results.
  • Establish controls and monitoring processes designed to ensure model integrity, data quality, and analytical consistency.
  • Maintain awareness of evolving regulatory guidance and industry best practices related to stress testing, model governance, and quantitative risk management.

Collaboration and Communication

  • Partner with Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), Credit Administration, Treasury, Finance, and Data Analytics teams to support enterprise risk initiatives.
  • Provide independent challenge and critical review of analytical assumptions, scenario design, and model results.
  • Prepare reports and presentations for management and various committees and sub-committees.
  • Communicate complex quantitative concepts and analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences

Education & Experience

Education:

  • Required Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Economics, Data Science, Financial Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related quantitative discipline. (Masters Degree Preferrred)

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in quantitative risk analytics, stress testing, forecasting, model development, or portfolio analytics.
  • Experience developing and implementing statistical or predictive models in banking, financial services, consulting, or risk management.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Strong knowledge of statistical modeling, econometrics, forecasting, and quantitative risk methodologies.
  • Experience working with large datasets and communicating complex findings to senior leadership.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Moody's risk management, stress testing, or portfolio analytics solutions.
  • Background in credit risk, commercial banking, or portfolio risk management.
  • Experience supporting model validation, regulatory examinations, and audit activities.
  • Knowledge of machine learning, cloud-based analytics platforms, and advanced quantitative techniques.
  • Key Competencies
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to translate complex quantitative analysis into business recommendations.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining strong governance and accuracy standards.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Customer Implementations
jobs.excerpt: 🤙🏼 About gaiiaAt gaiia, we're building the leading platform for Communications Service Providers (CSPs) that truly care about their customers.
jobs.description:
🤙🏼 About gaiia

At gaiia, we're building the leading platform for Communications Service Providers (CSPs) that truly care about their customers. Our core product is an operating system (OS) for telcos that manages billing, operations, automation and everything in between.

We're passionate about taking care of our people, and it's not just lip service. We want you to focus on your job while we care for everything else. We offer competitive pay and benefits, flexible vacations, attractive stock options, unparalleled transparency, and a 100% remote environment. We're excited to have you join us for your next career adventure!

🎭 Role & Team

If you love talking to customers, asking tough questions, and wrangling shifting timelines — this role might be for you.

You will join a team of Full-Stack Developers (including a Team Leads), Product Managers, Program Manager & Solution Engineers, all dedicated to solving B2B companies’ biggest challenge: customer implementation.

As a Program Manager, Customer Implemenations at gaiia, you’ll be the person who brings clarity to chaos. You’ll be responsible for turning big, complicated customer implementations into structured, visible, and collaborative projects. That means owning the plan, the timeline, the dependencies, and the delivery—across both internal teams and customers. It also means owning the relationship: you’re the person customers trust to tell them where things really stand.

This role is focused on customer implementation projects, each of which involve a new customer migrating from their systems onto our all-in-one software suite.

Our customers are ISPs. They’re technical, busy, and under pressure to Go Live on a new all-in-one platform — often while running their existing one in parallel. You’ll guide them through critical moments like data migrations, provisioning workflows, and platform setup. You’ll help define what a successful ending looks like for each project, track dependencies across teams, and make sure we’re all working from the same playbook. Many implementations depend on product work still in flight. You’ll make those product dependencies visible early, negotiate scope and timing with Product and Engineering, and keep customer commitments in line with what the roadmap can actually deliver.

Internally, you’ll collaborate closely with multiple functions to keep everything moving. Your day-to-day will involve getting deep into the weeds: working with customers to nail down inputs and delivery dates, helping teams unblock each other, and making sure our internal tools (i.e. Notion, Linear, Rocketlane) reflect reality. You’ll also zoom out regularly, distilling the detail into clear, concise updates for gaiia’s leadership and for customer executives. You’ll also be a big part of shaping how we do project management at gaiia—not with heavy processes, but by building shared practices and tools that make everyone’s life easier.

You'll also play a key role in building out our AI-powered PMO — using tools like Claude to automate reporting, surface cross-project insights, and scale how we deliver great implementations with latest and greatest that AI has to offer.

This role (new vacancy) is equal parts coordination, communication, relationship management, and tactical execution—and it’s deeply customer-facing.

🪄 What you’re going to do

  • Drive the end-to-end implementation process for new customers, from scoping through Go Live.
  • Be the main point of contact for customers during onboarding—driving timelines, setting expectations, and keeping everyone on track.
  • Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with customer stakeholders at every level, from day-to-day operators to executive sponsors. Manage expectations through difficult conversations, escalations, and changes in scope.
  • Build and maintain project plans that clarify deliverables, timelines, and dependencies across teams.
  • Identify, track, and manage product dependencies and flag early when a dependency puts a Go Live date at risk.
  • Coordinate closely with internal teams (product, customer success, customer solutions and engineering) to unblock issues and ensure smooth execution.
  • Identify risks early and adapt plans quickly when things change—without letting details fall through the cracks.
  • Distill complex project status, risks, and decisions into crisp, executive-ready updates. Present them to gaiia leadership and customer executives, both live and in writing.
  • Keep project info organized, accessible, and up-to-date, so everyone knows what’s happening and what comes next.
  • Spot patterns and inefficiencies across projects to help us scale how we deliver great implementations.
  • Use AI tools (including Claude) to build and maintain cross-customer reporting dashboards, automate status updates, and surface portfolio-level risks from your project data.
  • Help define and evolve our AI-powered PMO practices — building prompts, workflows, and lightweight automations that make the whole implementation team more effective.

🌈 What we are looking for

  • You’ve led complex projects with technical teams and customers before—and you actually like it.
  • You’re comfortable running external calls, asking customers the hard questions, and telling them what you need from them to move forward.
  • You build relationships that hold up under pressure. Customers trust you because you’re candid, reliable, and on their side, even when the news isn’t good.
  • You can take a messy, detailed situation and tell an executive what matters in five minutes: what’s happening, what’s at risk, and what you need from them.
  • You understand how software gets built and delivered, even if you’re not the one writing the code. You’re comfortable working through product dependencies and making any risks knows before they become blockers.
  • You know how to track shifting priorities without losing the thread—and you believe transparency is better than perfection.
  • You have a high bar for communication and clarity, and you’re not afraid to chase down missing info.
  • You're comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day work — not just as a novelty, but to genuinely improve how you manage projects, communicate status, and spot patterns across a portfolio.
  • Bonus if you’ve worked in B2B SaaS or with telecom/ISP customers before.

🎖️ Qualifications

  • 5–8 years of experience in a project management or implementation-driving role at a B2B software company.
  • Experience leading customer-facing projects with multiple stakeholders, tight timelines, and shifting requirements.
  • Proven relationship management skills: you’ve owned customer relationships through complex engagements, including escalations and tough conversations.
  • Experience presenting to and writing for executive audiences, such as steering committees, QBRs, or leadership status reviews.
  • Experience managing cross-team product dependencies, ideally where customer deliverables relied on features still in development.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills—you know how to keep people aligned and work moving forward.
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and driving clarity across cross-functional teams.
  • A track record of managing complex timelines and dependencies across departments.
  • Familiarity with implementation, onboarding, or data migration projects is a big plus.
  • Experience with agile tools (i.e. Linear, Notion) to track progress, surface blockers, and communicate clearly.
  • AI Fluency - 🤖 We're building an AI-powered PMO and expect every Program Manager to be an active contributor to that vision. i.e. Demonstrated experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, etc.) to improve project management workflows — e.g. drafting status reports, summarizing call notes, or generating project plans from unstructured inputs.

💰Salary

At gaiia, we have a transparent salary philosophy and a robust evaluation and compensation framework. It translates to a fair and impartial model where salaries are published internally, healthy discussions around compensation and performance can exist, and taboos are removed.

The salary range for this role is $95,000-$140,000.

🔆 Benefits

  • Flexible 25-days of vacation.
  • Stock Options Plan.
  • Group Insurance.
  • Telemedicine.
  • Life Spending Account.
  • GRSP.
  • All-remote work.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity. Our workplace is fully remote and boasts accessible technologies, ensuring all team members can thrive. Should you require accommodations due to a disability during the application process, please contact us at 581-996-9639 or as per the Accessible Canada Act and human rights legislation. We're here to support you every step of the way.

Build a high-performing tax coaching team by setting clear standards, developing coaches, and using data to deliver measurable member outcomes and contract results.

This position connects strategy with day-to-day delivery: leading a team of tax-focused Money Coaches, keeping coaching operations running smoothly, meeting the service levels set by the contract, and using data to keep improving how we coach. The Lead also coaches members directly for up to 40% of the time, so they stay close to the work and lead by example. Experience with military service members and their families is a strong plus. When this role is successful, tax consultants are equipped and supported to deliver accurate, timely, and high-quality tax guidance, members feel confident navigating their tax-related questions, and program partners see consistent service excellence, operational efficiency, and strong member satisfaction.

Team Leadership

  • Recruit, onboard, and develop a team of tax Money Coaches

  • Set clear expectations, give regular constructive feedback, and recognize strong work

Operations and Contract Delivery

  • Turn the coaching team's strategy into practical operating plans

  • Design and maintain coaching processes that balance member access, quality, and efficient use of coach time

  • Meet the service levels and reporting requirements set by the contract

Data and Reporting

  • Produce contract and team performance reporting

  • Analyze coaching metrics to spot trends, gaps, and opportunities

  • Turn what the data shows into concrete improvements in team skills and coaching methods

Member Experience

  • Work with partners across MSA to improve the member experience and increase engagement and progress

  • Collect member success stories that show sponsor value

Direct Coaching

  • Coach members directly up to 40% of the time

  • Deliver high-quality sessions that earn strong member satisfaction ratings

  • Help members reduce financial stress, improve financial habits, and get more from their sponsor benefits

  • Handle escalated member calls with professionalism, empathy, and sound judgment, resolving complex concerns, de-escalating challenging situations, and ensuring a positive member experience while maintaining service and quality standards.

Expected Outcomes

  • A strong, cohesive team.Coaches are skilled, supported, and consistently help members reach their financial goals.

  • Contract commitments are met.Service levels and reporting requirements are delivered reliably and on time.

  • Measurable member progress.Members show clear gains in progress, outcomes, and satisfaction that become compelling sponsor ROI stories.

  • Continuous improvement.Performance data shapes how the team coaches, trains, and designs the member experience, keeping MSA ahead in financial wellness coaching.

Core Competencies

  • Operational Discipline:Builds and runs processes and workflows that deliver strong results without sacrificing quality.

  • People Leadership:Builds, develops, and motivates high-performing teams through coaching, feedback, and recognition.

  • Data-Driven Decision Making:Reads performance metrics, spots meaningful patterns, and turns insights into practical improvements.

  • Tax and Coaching Expertise:Understands individual tax, financial coaching methods, behavior change, and how adults learn.

  • Member-Centered Focus:Designs experiences around member needs while delivering measurable financial wellness gains.

  • Problem-Solving Agility:Spots operational challenges early and puts solutions in place that balance member experience with business goals.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • Minimum of 5 years of tax experience

Edelweiss Software Group is an operating group of Valsoft Corporation, serving as a permanent basecamp for vertical market software companies. Our philosophy is simple: your company leads; we support the ascent. With a buy-and-hold-forever approach, Edelweiss preserves each company's brand and provides the steady guidance, capital, and resources needed to keep both products and people moving upward. We form long-term strategic alliances with existing management teams — we don't buy to sell — placing a premium on the well-being of customers and employees over short-term goals.

This role leads one of Edelweiss's mission critical businesses in the education and childcare software space. The business holds a leading position in its niche, with a large and loyal customer base, and is entering an exciting new chapter of growth and product expansion.

The Role

We are seeking an entrepreneurial and operationally minded Managing Director to lead one of our software businesses. Reporting directly to the Managing Partner, you will own the P&L, set strategic direction, and drive sustained, profitable growth across the product portfolio.

You will operate with high autonomy, supported by Valsoft's long-term investment model, operational expertise, and global network.

  • Evolve the operating model — Move toward business-unit-level ownership and accountability, with the transparency, discipline, and incentives to scale while improving E2E operational efficiency with the use of AI
  • Deepen customer value — Improve retention, satisfaction, and lifetime value, and embed a culture of customer-led innovation.
  • Own performance and outcomes — Take full accountability for revenue, EBITDA, and cash flow, with disciplined capital allocation and predictable financial performance.
  • Lead and grow the organization — Build and develop a high-performing team and a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, with a customer-first mindset.

Candidate Profile

Experience

  • Proven experience as a CEO, Managing Director, COO, VP or General Manager with full P&L ownership of a software or technology business.

  • Team leadership: Experience leading and developing a team of 10 or more.

  • Comfort with emerging technologies, including AI.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, engineering, economics, or a related field; an MBA or advanced degree is a strong asset.

Personal characteristics

  • Empathetic leader:A strong ability to influence others, and an empathetic, active listener.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit — results-oriented, driven, proactive, and a team player.
  • Both strategic and hands-on, with the ability to translate vision into actionable plans and drive results.
  • A high degree of accountability and ownership.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to change with agility.
  • A people-centric leader who leads with humility, empathy, and sound judgment.

Why This Opportunity Stands Out

  • A platform for growth — Lead an established, market-leading business at a genuine inflection point — with the core stabilized and a new product generation ready to scale.
  • True ownership — Run the business with full autonomy and accountability, empowered to make decisions and drive outcomes.
  • Long-term backing — Valsoft's buy-and-hold-forever model means you build enduring value rather than managing toward an exit.

About Positron AI

Positron AI is building next-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low-latency, high-throughput large language model inference. Our first-generation ASIC, Asimov, is a cutting-edge accelerator targeting frontier AI workloads, with additional generations already underway.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior FPGA Design Engineer to own FPGA designs from microarchitecture through lab-based silicon validation. In this role, you will work closely with inference system architects, software, verification, and hardware teams to design, implement, and release networking and digital logic functions targeting FPGA and ASIC technologies. You will also build FPGA prototypes that let the team validate architectural choices early, and you will play a hands-on role in bringing up complete systems that combine FPGA, firmware, and software. Your trade-off decisions across cost, size, power, performance, and features will directly shape the customer experience of Positron's inference platforms.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End FPGA Development

  • Create and release FPGAs through every development phase: microarchitecture, RTL design, physical implementation, timing closure, simulation validation, and lab-based silicon validation.
  • Define, design, implement, test, release, and support networking functions for FPGA and ASIC targets in partnership with inference system architects.

Cross-Functional Design & Prototyping

  • Partner with software, verification, and inference system architects and design engineers to implement digital logic functions in FPGA and ASIC technologies.
  • Build FPGA prototypes that validate architecture and design alternatives and inform trade-off decisions before committing to silicon.

System Bring-Up & Optimization

  • Bring up and test systems that combine FPGA, firmware, and software functions alongside systems architects, hardware engineering, and software teams.
  • Drive trade-off analysis that improves customer experience and optimizes target technology resources for cost, size, power, performance, and features.

  • Hands-on proficiency in SystemVerilog RTL coding.
  • A proven record of designing, testing, delivering, and supporting multiple FPGAs or ASICs that have shipped to customers.
  • Direct experience working with high-end Intel and Xilinx (AMD) FPGAs.
  • Strong working knowledge of modern ASIC and FPGA design and verification tools.
  • Deep practical experience across microarchitecture, RTL coding, FPGA optimization for timing and power, simulation, and validation.

Preferred Qualifications

Why Join Us?

  • Own FPGA designs end to end, from microarchitecture to lab validation, on hardware purpose-built for frontier LLM inference.
  • Shape the networking and system architecture of next-generation AI accelerators while working shoulder to shoulder with architects, software, and silicon teams.

Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits.

Position Overview

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will architect and build the foundational data pipeline infrastructure that powers our decentralized Data Mesh strategy. In this role, you will support the transition of our data ecosystem from legacy on-prem architecture to a modern cloud data platform leveraging Snowflake.

You will design reference architectures and reusable pipeline patterns that support batch, event-based, and streaming data movement. Crucially, you will ensure our data platform is "AI-ready" by building the high-quality pipelines and robust semantic layers needed to drive our next-generation "Self-Service 2.0" natural language data capabilities. Beyond technical execution, you will lead a small data engineering team and serve as a technical mentor to decentralized analysts across the business, empowering them to build high-quality, self-service data products. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Pipeline Architecture: Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines supporting batch, real-time streaming, and event-driven data movement from on-prem and cloud sources. 
  • Snowflake Platform Ownership: Serve as the core developer for our Snowflake data platform, ensuring optimal performance, modeling, and storage structures. 
  • AI Readiness & Semantic Modeling: Architect and build transform pipelines that deliver high-quality data inputs to Snowflake and dbt AI features. Design and maintain the robust semantic layers and metadata models required to power "Self-Service 2.0" natural language user interfaces. 
  • Data Mesh Enablement: Establish robust reference architectures, standard templates, and CI/CD best practices to enable decentralized line-of-business teams to build safely. 
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Provide direct management and career mentorship to one data engineer (with room to grow). Act as a guide for self-taught domain data analysts to mature their engineering practices. 
  • Modernization & Tooling: Drive the adoption of dbt for data transformation and explore the integration of AWS and Azure cloud data tools (ADF, Azure Functions, Stream Analytics) to optimize data flow. 

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 5–7 years of dedicated data engineering experience, with a proven track record of building production-grade data pipelines. 
  • Snowflake Expertise: Advanced, hands-on experience with Snowflake architecture, performance tuning, and data sharing is a strict requirement. 
  • Data Integration: Proven experience moving data across hybrid environments (on-prem to cloud) utilizing batch, streaming (e.g., Stream Analytics), and event-driven patterns. 
  • Semantic & AI Context: Experience building or maintaining semantic layers (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, Snowflake Cortex/Semantic definitions) and structuring data specifically for consumption by downstream AI, LLM, or natural language search features. 
  • Software Skills: Strong Python skills, particularly in cloud environments (e.g., writing Azure Functions for data workloads) and strong SQL capabilities. 
  • Frameworks & Clouds: Exposure to dbt is highly preferred. Experience with Azure data tools (Azure Data Factory) is a strong plus; familiarity with AWS data ecosystems is nice to have. 
  • Leadership Style: A collaborative, coaching mindset with a passion for teaching, establishing governance, and raising the technical bar for cross-functional teams. 

Why Join Nimble Gravity?
You'll help leading financial institutions and other clients adopt AI in meaningful ways. You'll work directly with clients, engineers, and AI specialists to turn emerging technology into measurable business outcomes. If you enjoy teaching, facilitating, influencing, and helping people embrace new ways of working, we'd love to talk.

jobs.description:
Position Title: Vice President, Product

Reports to: Chief Product & Technology Officer

Location: United States

POSITION DESCRIPTION

apexanalytix is the world's leading provider of supplier onboarding, risk management and recovery solutions. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Greensboro, NC, apexanalytix is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management Solutions. More than 320 of the world's largest companies use our AI-native platform to protect over $9.5 trillion in annual spend.

apexanalytix is seeking a product executive to serve as VP of Product, reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO) and sitting on the CPTO's leadership team. The role has two linked mandates. First, lead product discovery across the company, so that what we build is valuable, usable, feasible and viable before engineering commits to it. Second, own how investment requests reach engineering: one transparent process that weighs every ask against outcomes and funds standing teams rather than projects.

We are moving to the product operating model. Product, engineering and design are organized into four persistent trios: Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence, and Platform. Each is funded against outcome goals. The VP of Product leads the product leaders of all four trios, including the Platform product leader in Noida, India, and the product operations function.

The VP of Product works as a peer and partner to the Head of Design, VP Engineering, Head of AI & Data, SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC, and Head of GRC. Outside the CPTO organization, the role works closely with Go-to-Market, Professional Services, Assurance & Recovery services, finance and the executive team. Deep fluency in the product operating model described by Marty Cagan is required. Practical experience running Teresa Torres's continuous discovery habits is highly valued, as is a background in governance, risk and compliance (GRC), especially third-party risk management.

Trusted Advisor

  • Advises the CPTO and the executive team on product strategy, market and customer insight, and where to invest next across supplier onboarding, risk, payment controls, recovery, and data and agentic products.
  • Is the voice of the customer and of product discovery on the CPTO leadership team, bringing evidence rather than opinion to investment debates.
  • Coaches executives and stakeholders on the product operating model: why we fund outcomes instead of features, and how discovery reduces the risk of what we build.

Roles and Requirements

Product discovery

  • Discovery leadership. Owns how discovery is done across all four trios. Ensures every team tackles value, usability, feasibility and business viability risk before engineering commits to build.
  • Continuous discovery habits. Establishes weekly customer touchpoints by each product trio, with suppliers, procurement, AP, finance and compliance users. Introduces opportunity solution trees, interview snapshots and rapid assumption testing as everyday practice, not special projects.
  • Insight engine. Builds a shared source of customer, market, usage and win/loss insight. Draws on implementation and recovery services teams, who see client problems first, as core discovery partners.
  • Discovery standards. Sets clear expectations for what evidence a team needs before moving an idea into delivery, and makes that evidence visible in reviews.

Investment coordination

  • Single intake for engineering demand. Owns the process by which requests from Go-to-Market, Professional Services, clients, partners, compliance and the executive team reach engineering. Every request is framed as a problem and an outcome, not a solution.
  • Portfolio allocation. Leads, with the VP Engineering, SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC and Head of AI & Data, the allocation of capacity across the four trios. Balances new value, client commitments, platform health, security and compliance work, and technical debt, and makes the trade-offs explicit.
  • Outcome-based funding. Turns the shift from project funding to standing, outcome-funded teams into a working practice. Defines outcome goals per trio with finance and the CPTO, and reports progress against them.
  • Transparent decisions. Runs a regular investment review where requests are prioritized against outcomes and evidence. Makes sure stakeholders understand what was funded, what was not, and why.

Product strategy and leadership

  • Product vision and strategy. Sets a compelling product vision and a focused product strategy that connects company objectives to the problems each trio is asked to solve.
  • Product organization. Leads the Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence and Platform product leaders, and the product managers beneath them. Hires, coaches and develops product managers who are empowered to own outcomes, not manage backlogs.
  • India product presence. Builds Product Management in Noida, starting with the Platform product leader, so India-owned domains have product partners close to the engineers.
  • Product operations. Leads product operations: product analytics and instrumentation, research operations, the investment intake process, and the product operating cadence.
  • Trio partnership. Works as one team with design and engineering leaders at every level. Product, design and engineering share goals, plan together and review together.

Customer and market

  • Market leadership. Keeps apexanalytix ahead in supplier risk management and procure-to-pay controls, including AI-native and agentic capabilities.
  • Go-to-market alignment. Partners with Go-to-Market leadership on packaging, pricing input and launches, so customers see one connected platform aligned to the journey structure.
  • Compliance as a product requirement. Works with the Head of GRC so that regulatory, security and third-party risk requirements shape product decisions early, both for our own controls and for the compliance outcomes our clients buy from us.

First-Year Priorities

  • Publish a product vision and product strategy, approved by the CPTO, that sets the problems each of the four trios is asked to solve.
  • Agree first-year outcome goals for each trio with the CPTO, engineering leaders and finance, including a revenue goal for standalone data products.
  • Launch a single investment intake and review process for all engineering demand, with every request tied to an outcome and every decision visible to stakeholders.
  • Get every product trio running weekly customer touchpoints, with opportunity solution trees and assumption tests visible in quarterly reviews.
  • Set a baseline for discovery and delivery health (for example, share of shipped work validated in discovery, time from idea to validated learning, and adoption of what ships), and show measurable improvement against it.
  • Name or hire the product leaders for all four trios, including the Platform product leader in Noida, and close gaps in the product manager bench.
  • Stand up product operations with reliable product analytics across the platform.
  • Work with the Head of Design and engineering leaders so that every team operates as a trio with shared goals, joint planning and joint reviews.

Required Skills

  • 15+ years in product management, including 5+ years leading product organizations through product leaders and managers in B2B enterprise SaaS.
  • Deep, practical fluency in the product operating model as described by Marty Cagan (Inspired, Empowered, Transformed): empowered product teams, outcomes over output, product strategy, and the distinction between discovery and delivery.
  • A proven record of leading a transformation from a project- or feature-driven model to empowered, outcome-funded product teams, including winning over executives and stakeholders outside product.
  • Hands-on experience leading product discovery at scale, including addressing value, usability, feasibility and viability risk before committing engineering investment.
  • Experience owning portfolio-level investment decisions across multiple teams: setting capacity allocation, saying no with evidence, and making trade-offs transparent to executives and Go-to-Market leaders.
  • A track record of hiring, coaching and developing strong product managers and product leaders.
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience using product analytics, experimentation and qualitative research to make decisions.
  • Experience working in close partnership with design and engineering as a trio, and with distributed teams across US and India time zones.
  • Experience with AI-native or data products, and sound judgment about where AI and agents create real customer value.
  • Strong executive presence, able to represent product strategy credibly to the CPTO, the executive team, clients and, as needed, the Board.

Preferred Skills

  • Practical experience running Teresa Torres's continuous discovery habits (Continuous Discovery Habits): weekly customer interviews by the product trio, opportunity solution trees, and rapid assumption testing, ideally introduced across several teams.
  • Background in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) software or practice, especially third-party risk management (TPRM), supplier risk or vendor due diligence.
  • Domain experience in procure-to-pay, accounts payable, supplier management, payment fraud prevention or fintech.
  • Experience building product management in an India-based Global Capability Center.
  • Experience in a PE-backed or high-growth SaaS company, connecting product investment to revenue, retention and EBITDA.
  • Experience building and selling data products or APIs as standalone revenue lines.

Education Levels/Credentials (Degree types and Emphasis)

  • An undergraduate degree in business, computer science, engineering or a related field is required. A graduate degree or an MBA is a plus but not required.

Physical/Remote/Travel Work Environment

  • United States, with remote or hybrid arrangements considered. Regular overlap with India business hours for work with the Noida team.
  • Travel required: regular, including client visits for discovery, and periodic travel to apexanalytix HQ in Greensboro, NC, and the Noida GCC.

Scope Boundaries

This role owns product discovery, product vision and strategy, the product organization across all four trios, product operations, and the process by which investment requests reach engineering. Engineering delivery, quality and technical standards sit with the VP Engineering, the SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC and the Chief Architect. Design leadership, the design system and research practice sit with the Head of Design; the VP of Product partners closely on discovery. The Data & Intelligence trio is led by the Head of AI & Data, with its product leader reporting to this role. Security policy, compliance and third-party risk for apexanalytix itself sit with the Head of GRC. Client commercial relationships, pricing and packaging decisions sit with Go-to-Market leadership, with input from this role.

Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way - apexanalytix.com/careers/

Benefits

At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.

With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

jobs.description:
Cardinal Health, Inc. (NYSE: CAH) is a global healthcare services and products company. We provide customized solutions for hospitals, healthcare systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, physician offices and patients in the home.
