Interviewer

Job Industry: Charity / Social Services / Non- Profit Organization

Position Name: Volunteer Interviewer for Dog Rescue - Volunteer (Unpaid)

Job Location: Spokane, Washington, United States

Job Type: Part Time

Office Setting: Fully Remote

Remote: Yes

Compensation: Volunteer

Hours Per Week: 5 (flexible)

Role Mission

Path of Hope relies on volunteers heavily to achieve our mission. Due to the nature of volunteering, we have a high turnover of candidates. Your role is to support the continuous flow of qualified volunteers to fill open roles in the Rescue. You will interview candidates and assess whether they can integrate into the Rescue and effectively complete the role and duties as assigned.

What Winning Looks Like

Key Results Area #1 - Roles

  • Familiar with organization structure of the Rescue

  • Familiar with job descriptions and seeks to understand the purpose of each role in order to offer alternative roles, when it's determined that skills would be better suited to a different role

Key Results Area #2 - Self Motivated Work Ethic

  • Keep and update your personal schedule

  • Adherence to interview schedules with minimal rescheduling

  • Daily check ins with remote platform and leader

Key Results Area #2 - Interview Process

  • Conduct 30-minute phone interviews effectively, ensuring all key questions are covered while maintaining a professional and engaging experience for candidates.

  • Assess the suitability of candidates for specific volunteer roles based on their skills, availability, and alignment with the Rescue's Core Values and the role's Key Results Areas

  • Detailed interview notes and recommendations for each candidate.

  • Timely follow-up with team leads for role placement within 24 hours of the interview.

Needed Skills

  • Must love dogs and people. We can't save dogs without talented people.

  • Active listening with conversational style. Ability to listen for context clues on what type of role would be a good fit.

  • Self motivated without needing a leader to keep you on task

  • Manage your schedule and keep up to date. Daily check ins via remote chat

Unique Company Culture and Mission

Our Mission

At Path of Hope Rescue we save pregnant dogs and puppies from high kill shelters in the Southern United States.

Our Spokane, Washington based Rescue strives to decrease the euthanasia rate of high risk dogs in the southern United States by transporting pregnant dogs and puppies to the Pacific Northwest to find adoptive homes. We do not have a kennel or building location and are 100% foster based. We currently have two paid employees and rely heavily on volunteers and fosters as we work to build out our paid staff roles.

Our Vision.
Eliminating euthanasia of dogs in the South by decreasing the amount of dogs breeding unchecked and becoming the number one 'dog destination' in Spokane by capitalizing on Spokane's love of Rescue Dogs.

Core Values:

Transparency - sharing the good with the bad

Community - dog loving people who treat each other well

Integrity - doing what you say will do

Golden Rule - treating others how you would want to be treated

Our Company Culture

We are freedom loving American Patriots who love dogs, love freedom and love Jesus.

No NGO status here, we don't take a single penny from the government. We are 100% funded by small donors and our adoption program, with a few small private grants here and there. We built this organization from the ground up in 2018 with $87.

We are built tough and believe that hard work pays off. We're about rolling up our sleeves and taking responsibility for our own actions. We don't do drama. There are no victims here and the system isn't out to get you, the only thing standing in your way is you and your attitude. We reward merit, not DEI or pronouns. We don't bend to the cultural rot out there.

At the core of who we are, we love dogs. At PHR you will find people who recognize your dog before they recognize you. Where it's normal for your dog to have his own Instagram and people who expect to be invited to your dog's birthday party. We are focused on building a strong, positive community, one dog and one person at a time.

We know dogs are family and should be treated that way. And we are driven by a shared passion to make sure every dog who isn't being loved, finds their way to a family. We care for each other and have created a community of people who love making a difference in this world.

You will:

  • Consistently achieve or exceed quarterly new-logo goals.

  • Deliver strong quarterly linearity, with new customers and revenue closing throughout the quarter.

  • Build, develop, and manage a healthy pipeline that supports both the current quarter and future quarters.

  • Maintain accurate forecasting and demonstrate complete command of your business.

Quarterly Execution & Linearity

Success in this role requires more than simply hitting an annual number. We expect consistent quarterly execution.

You will be responsible for:

  • Achieving quarterly new-logo and revenue targets.

  • Maintaining sufficient pipeline coverage for both the current and following quarter.

  • Creating new pipeline every week.

  • Progressing opportunities with urgency and clearly defined next steps.

  • Closing business throughout the quarter rather than relying on end-of-quarter concentration.

Channel & Partner Execution

What Makes You Successful Here

About the role

Tech9 is hiring a Senior SharePoint Administrator to own the SharePoint Online environment for a US-based client. You'll be the client's in-house SharePoint expert, reporting directly to their IT manager.

The client is partway through a SharePoint remediation project with an outside Microsoft partner, expected to wrap up in early 2027. Your first job is to help finish it well: review the architecture plan, speak up when something isn't right for the business, and make sure the result follows best practice. After the project, you'll keep the environment clean, enforce the governance rules set by a new steering committee, and train site owners so old habits don't return.

This role is for someone who treats an environment as their own. You'll advise on strategy one hour and close a quick storage request the next.

What you'll do

During the remediation project

  • Act as the client's technical lead and advocate with the outside Microsoft partner, reviewing plans and raising concerns early.
  • Validate the information architecture: hub sites, site structure, navigation, metadata and content types.
  • Help migrate and restructure content, and build new sites to the agreed design.
  • Clean up permissions and oversharing, moving access to group-based models.

Ongoing administration and governance

  • Enforce governance policies for site creation, naming, external sharing, retention and archiving.
  • Say no to requests that break policy, and offer users the right way to get what they need.
  • Manage the content lifecycle so outdated content is archived or removed on schedule.
  • Handle day-to-day tickets: file moves, storage requests, access changes, archiving and user questions.
  • Train site owners and end users, and build simple guides that explain the why behind the rules.
  • Support the SharePoint steering committee and recommend improvements to the platform over time.

What you bring

Required

  • 5+ years administering SharePoint, with recent hands-on SharePoint Online experience in Microsoft 365.
  • At least one full migration you helped lead, from file shares or older SharePoint, using tools such as ShareGate or the SharePoint Migration Tool.
  • Experience designing site structures from scratch: hub sites, flat architecture, navigation, metadata and taxonomy.
  • Strong permissions and security management, including Entra ID groups, external sharing controls and permission cleanup.
  • Experience setting and enforcing governance: site provisioning, naming policies, retention policies and sensitivity labels in Microsoft Purview.
  • Content lifecycle management, including archiving and storage management.
  • PowerShell for administration, reporting and bulk changes (PnP.PowerShell preferred).
  • Working knowledge of how Teams and OneDrive connect to SharePoint.

Nice to have

  • Power Automate for simple workflows and approvals.
  • Microsoft 365 certifications such as MS-102 (Microsoft 365 Administrator).
  • Experience working alongside outside Microsoft partners or consultants on a client's behalf.
  • Experience supporting a governance or steering committee.

How you work

  • You speak up. You raise concerns early and explain your reasoning, even with vendors, consultants or senior leaders. You're diplomatic, but you don't stay quiet when something isn't right.
  • You take ownership. You spot problems before anyone asks and treat the environment as your own.
  • You hold the line kindly. You can say no to a request that breaks policy and still leave the person with a path forward.
  • You teach well. You explain technical ideas in plain language and help non-technical people change how they work.
  • You're senior and hands-on. You're as comfortable advising on architecture as you are closing a quick ticket.
  • You communicate clearly in English, both spoken and written, with US-based colleagues.
  • You're reliable. Strong work ethic, follow-through and consistency matter a lot on this

Based in San Francisco and New Hampshire, Bugcrowd is supported by General Catalyst, Rally Ventures, Costanoa Ventures, and others. Visit .

Job Summary

If you like owning problems end to end, making security a default property of everything we build, and working closely with engineering, we want to meet you. Bugcrowd is looking for security engineers who move beyond standard tooling and drive measurable security outcomes our customers can rely on. You will help us shape a culture where security helps others succeed, not just points out problems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Partner Closely with Engineering: Refine architecture, validate new features, and drive security investment while prioritizing engineering velocity
  • Build Security Paved Roads: Contribute to the secure defaults, libraries, and "paved roads" that systematically eradicate entire classes of vulnerabilities rather than fixing bugs one by one
  • Create Feedback Loops: Tune security tooling such as SAST, DAST, SCA, and secret scanning to reduce noise and focus on what matters
  • Be our Best Customer: Ensure our bug bounty program can be a model for other customers. Experiment with new ways to leverage the creativity of the crowd. Provide feedback on new platform features to engineering and product
  • Own Projects End to End: Lead cross-functional product security projects from scoping through delivery, influencing product and engineering roadmaps and clearly communicating risk to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Amplify our Impact: Use code and automation as a lever to scale coverage and eliminate repetitive work. Build systems based on incentives and accountability rather than just bureaucratic process

Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 3+ years of experience in product security, application security, or secure software development
  • Can review code, automate tasks, and build security tooling in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Go, Ruby, Java)
  • Hands-on experience with core application security practices — threat modeling, secure code review, and automated testing (SAST, DAST, SCA) — and a solid grasp of common vulnerability classes (e.g., OWASP Top 10)
  • Demonstrated ability to manage projects and influence cross-functional partners across engineering, DevOps, and product.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or relevant field, or equivalent practical experience

Bonus Points (Preferred but not required)

  • Previous experience with Bug Bounty or vulnerability disclosure programs
  • A background in building "paved roads" or secure-by-default internal libraries to eliminate entire classes of vulnerabilities
  • Hands-on experience securing cloud-native platforms and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Docker)
  • Experience working within a fast-paced, high-growth security or SaaS company

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements

The ideal candidate must be able to complete all physical requirements of the job with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Sitting and / or standing - Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time
  • Carrying and / or lifting - Must be able to carry / move laptop as needed throughout the work day.
  • Environment - remote, work-from-home 100% of the time

Culture

  • At Bugcrowd, we understand that diversity in the workplace is vital to a company’s success and growth. We strive to make sure that people are included and have a sense of being part of making Bugcrowd not only a great product but a great place to work.
  • We regularly hear from both customers and researchers that Bugcrowd feels like a family, and we strive to maintain that internally as well.
  • Our team consists of a broad range of people: musicians, adventure sports junkies, nature lovers, parents, cereal enthusiasts, night owls, cyclists, artists—you get the point.

At Bugcrowd, we are solving security threats and vulnerabilities that are relevant to everyone, therefore we believe solving these problems takes all kinds of backgrounds. We value the perspectives and experiences people from underrepresented backgrounds bring.

jobs.description:
The main purpose of the Account Manager is to manage their assigned clients and their stores by planning, briefing, monitoring, and executing marketing campaigns aimed at driving conversions and sales.

This includes managing, overseeing, and taking charge of the client-agency relationship for all the clients that have been assigned to you. It also includes developing and executing marketing strategies, handling client communications, writing client reports, and communicating the client’s marketing needs to other team members. You will be responsible for supplying the information your team needs to ensure that all marketing campaigns are written, designed, and executed as well as possible. Your goal as an Account Manager is to assist your clients in meeting their revenue goals using the products and services of our company.

The Account Manager will report directly to the Head of Account Managers, the Account Managers’ Leads, and the Service Director while working collaboratively with other departments.

About the Role:

Mission statement:

The primary mission of our Account Manager is to be in charge of maintaining a good relationship with your assigned clients while ensuring that our products and services are bringing results for our clients. This will include coming up with innovative ideas for clients’ marketing campaigns, monitoring the performance of such marketing campaigns, and keeping an open channel of productive and fruitful communication with our clients.

You will also be responsible for leading teams consisting of professional Copywriters, Designers, and Account Managers’ Associates to ensure that your assigned clients’ marketing campaigns are executed smoothly. This involves activities such as outlining the client's campaign calendar, briefing new campaigns, delegating creative work, and ultimately overseeing the timely delivery of marketing campaigns.

General Responsibilities:

  • Effectively managing, overseeing, and ensuring that the marketing campaigns of your assigned clients are executed and performing well
  • Building and maintaining a strong relationship with your assigned clients to ensure peak productivity, open communication, and establishing trust between our clients and Hustler Marketing
  • Being in charge of the planning, development, and execution of marketing strategies (consisting of email campaigns, SMS campaigns, pop-ups, and flows) for your assigned clients (meaning that you’ll be managing about 40 unique marketing campaigns per month)
  • Ensuring that the needs and expectations of your assigned clients are managed and met
  • Working to improve the results from email marketing for your assigned clients
  • Collaborating with team members to respond to client requests promptly
  • Working alongside a team of experienced marketing professionals productively and harmoniously to ensure that the highest quality marketing campaigns are delivered to our clients
  • Continuously staying in contact with your assigned clients, including leading and attending regular meetings with your clients
  • Collecting and analyzing data to understand the consumers’ demographics and trends to forward the clients' marketing agenda and drive better results, setting new goals weekly
  • Regularly reporting on the performance of the email marketing campaigns for your assigned clients, including reporting on aspects like revenue from email marketing, best-performing campaigns, results from A/B testing, and the measures taken to improve and optimize client revenue
  • Working with the Service Department to maintain high work standards and ensuring that the set targets for your assigned clients are met in terms of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  • Keeping a tight grip on client churn (especially for your assigned clients), and implementing strategies to prevent clients from leaving the company, with the assistance of the Service Director
  • Troubleshooting and assisting with any issues related to clients’ satisfaction and the performance of marketing campaigns as developed and executed by our team
  • Being able to effectively and productively work with any type of client with minimal supervision
  • Working on various tasks as part of the team of Account Managers
  • Participating in the Account Managers’ group calls
  • Participating in the training and skill-building sessions for Account Managers within the Service Department to improve their skills, performance, and overall expertise
  • Acting as a liaison between clients and cross-functional teams to ensure the successful implementation of new services and products offered by Hustler Marketing
  • Continuously working to identify new opportunities to expand services offered to clients through regular communication and relationship building
  • Using data analysis techniques to create targeted campaigns for upselling our services to our client segments, and to present these service offers to clients in a compelling manner
  • Continuously working to discover industry-wide best practices and standards and present your findings to the Account Managers’ Lead, the Head of Account Managers, and the Service Director
  • Being available to assist with all internal service-related needs from other departments
  • Directly reporting to the Account Managers’ Leads, the Head of Account Managers, and the Service Director (in that structural order)

Positions Specs:

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first two months (with the first two months being the trial-and-adaptation period paid at full rate)
  • Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months
  • Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months

Requirements

About You:

Profile:

The ideal candidate must be someone with extensive working experience in managing client accounts effectively, as well as experience in email marketing. Such experience should include managing a team consisting of marketing professionals (such as Account Managers’ Associates, Designers, Copywriters, and other team members) to deliver marketing campaigns that are focused on driving sales.

The Account Manager must be able to act swiftly upon receiving urgent requests from clients and must be able to work consistently with high levels of accountability.

The right person will be professional and also have considerable leadership and managerial experience, as well as strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to effectively communicate with clients and internal teams. Having been an Account Manager before, or having any agency experience is a great advantage.

Familiarity with various tools such as Slack, Hubstaff, Asana, Klaviyo, and Google Workspace Suite is a must for this role. The candidate should also feel comfortable working in a remote environment. Availability, accountability, professionalism, responsiveness, and consistency are highly important factors for us, so the Account Manager should display these qualities when it comes to workload commitments and general availability during office hours.

Key Requirements:

  • At least 12 months of experience working in a digital marketing role, together with at least 6 months of working experience in an email marketing field (Preference will be given to candidates who have worked with remote teams and team members from different countries or have any account management or agency experience)
  • A proven track record of achieving success in a leadership role is a must, especially leading a team of creatives to deliver quality work that meets the needs of clients
  • Must have the ability to work independently without compromising on work standards
  • Must be highly accountable, responsive, and have an excellent ability to meet deadlines
  • Great aptitude for working with people, problem-solving, and thinking critically / analytically, as these skills are essential for meeting the needs of our clients and resolving any issues or queries
  • Possesses a growth and results-driven mindset, and can handle and implement constructive criticism
  • Any remote work experience is a major advantage
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to clearly and effectively communicate with clients as well as marketing professionals in our Service Department
  • Must possess great problem-solving skills as it is essential for working with clients and resolving any queries, complaints, or issues
  • Must have the ability to learn and adapt quickly, and possess excellent time management skills and high levels of focus, productivity, and efficiency
  • Any knowledge or experience with email marketing, e-commerce, or Klaviyo is a huge plus
  • Familiarity with working autonomously and managing your time (remote work experience is a plus)
  • Must be available and responsive during office hours (Mondays to Fridays between 3-6 PM BCN time)
  • Must consistently work 30-35 hours per week (i.e, 140 hours per month)
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or PC, as well as be able to attend virtual video conferences
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. You must be fluent in English, although English doesn't have to be your native language
  • Being open to receiving feedback and constructive criticism and improving on it, as well as giving feedback of similar nature productively to your team

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Samsara Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will build a track record of customer success by leveraging your technical expertise, strong business acumen, and a commitment to living by Samsara's core values and operating principles. Your primary responsibilities will be to build and maintain relationships with customers and account teams, develop a technical understanding of your customers’ Samsara implementations, transform their technical support experience, update our system of engagement, and contribute to team growth. These activities will enable you to proactively set your assigned customers up for success by optimizing their Samsara platform and mitigating risk with particular care during critical peak events.

As a TAM, you will occasionally be the point of contact for significant incidents, being responsible for the customer’s expectations and communications through resolving such incidents. Our TAM is the primary technical interface on behalf of our customers and works closely across internal and external stakeholders, as required, to address customer needs.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in Canada.


You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Transform your assigned customers’ support experience through technical proficiency and problem solving. Demonstrate an understanding of Samsara's products, including APIs, hardware, and software troubleshooting.
  • Act as the primary technical point of contact between Samsara and assigned customers, ensuring their technical requirements and objectives are met.
  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of our customers' business operations and use this knowledge to align Samsara's solutions with their specific needs. Identify opportunities for additional value and growth while presenting outcomes achieved.
  • Cultivate solid and long-lasting relationships with technical stakeholders within your customers’ organizations. Establish yourself as a technical trusted advisor, advocating for customer interests within Samsara.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of customer interactions and activities in our system of engagement.
  • Actively participate in scaling and building the Technical Account Management team, sharing knowledge and best practices to enhance the team's capabilities.
  • Be available for occasional travel to customer sites and may need to be online for some after-hour or weekend coverage depending on the customers’ needs.
  • A strong passion for technology and a commitment to continuous learning, with a demonstrated interest in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and their practical applications in a business context.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s Operating Values and Principles in how you show up to work.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 7+ years of experience in technical account management, customer success, or a similar role.
  • We welcome applications from candidates with a bachelor's degree in a technical field, or those who have gained equivalent expertise through practical experience in areas such as Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields.
  • Exceptional technical literacy, with the ability to understand and troubleshoot hardware, software and AI technology.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain customer relationships.
  • Business acumen with a focus on understanding customer needs through a data-informed approach.
  • Strong bias for action, ownership, ability to dive deep, and insistence on the highest standards.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Python coding skills, allowing you to provide enhanced technical support and solutions to our customers.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-level customers in a SaaS, IoT, or PaaS environment.
  • Organized, with a commitment to maintaining accurate account records.
  • A team player who can collaborate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Prior experience with Salesforce, Zendesk, Jira, Gainsight, Tableau, and AI (Gemini preferred).

About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need a Motion Graphics Editor who can turn static assets into kinetic masterpieces and elevate our video content with high-end visual polish.

Why This Role Matters

Movement, energy, and visual communication are your playground. As a Motion Graphics Editor, you are the visual alchemist of our post-production team. You bridge the gap between graphic design and video editing, using animation to explain complex product benefits, reinforce brand identity, and keep viewers glued to the screen.

In the world of performance marketing, dynamic text and seamless transitions are often the difference between a skip and a sale. If you thrive on creating kinetic typography, stunning visual effects, and fluid motion that drives conversion, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Design & Animate High-Impact Assets

    • Create dynamic motion graphics for social media and TV ads, including kinetic typography, logo reveals, lower thirds, and transition effects.

    • Take static design assets (Ps/Ai) and bring them to life using Adobe After Effects.

    • Design engaging "explainer" sequences and infographics that visually communicate product USPs (Unique Selling Propositions).

  2. Elevate Video Edits

    • Collaborate with Video Editors to layer high-end motion graphics over live-action footage.

    • Apply visual effects (tracking, compositing, screen replacements) to enhance production value.

    • Ensure all graphics align perfectly with the brand guidelines and visual identity of our diverse DTC clients.

  3. Build Scalable Systems (MOGRTs)

    • Create and optimize Motion Graphics Templates (.mogrt) for use in Premiere Pro, allowing our editing team to scale their output efficiently.

    • Develop reusable animation libraries and assets to speed up the post-production workflow.

  4. Innovate Visual Styles

    • Stay ahead of the curve on motion design trends (e.g., collage style, liquid motion, retro-tech) and implement them into our campaigns.

    • Experiment with new plugins and techniques to constantly raise the bar of our visual output.

Who You Are

  1. A Motion Design Pro

    • 3–5 years of experience in motion graphics and video editing (agency, broadcast, or high-end freelance).

    • A strong reel showcasing not just animation skills, but a strong eye for design, layout, and typography.

  2. Adobe Suite Master

    • Expert proficiency in After Effects (compositing, expression scripting, shape layers) and Premiere Pro.

    • Strong command of Photoshop and Illustrator for asset preparation.

    • Bonus: Experience with Cinema 4D or Blender is a plus, but not required.

  3. Performance-Driven

    • You understand that motion graphics in advertising must serve a purpose. You know how to use motion to guide the viewer’s eye to the most important information (the CTA).

  4. Organized & Efficient

    • You keep your project files and pre-comps meticulous. You know how to structure a project so that other editors can navigate it easily.

    • You can render fast and manage version control without errors.

  5. Collaborative Communicator

    • Strong English proficiency is required. You can interpret feedback from Art Directors effectively and explain technical constraints or opportunities clearly.

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: Influence the visual language of major global brands and lead motion initiatives.

  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one keyframe at a time.

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Professional Recruiter to support full-cycle talent acquisition for a healthcare organization serving the Charleston, South Carolina market. This is a 100% remote, temporary contract opportunity expected to last approximately 3–6 months.

In this role, you will independently manage the entire recruitment lifecycle for clinical and nonclinical healthcare positions, from candidate sourcing and screening through interview coordination, offer negotiation, and pre-employment processing. Your recruitment portfolio will include a variety of positions, with an emphasis on hard-to-fill clinical, allied health, licensed professional, administrative, and leadership roles. You will partner closely with hiring managers and internal stakeholders to identify staffing needs, develop targeted recruitment strategies, and ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process.

This opportunity is ideal for a Recruiter with at least three years of professional recruitment experience who thrives in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment and enjoys managing multiple requisitions independently. The position offers the flexibility of fully remote work, a consistent 40-hour workweek, and the opportunity to support a broad range of healthcare recruitment initiatives while serving as a trusted talent acquisition partner to hiring managers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage full-cycle recruitment for clinical, allied health, nonclinical, corporate, administrative, and healthcare leadership positions.
  • Partner with hiring managers and department leaders to understand staffing needs, position requirements, hiring priorities, and workforce challenges.
  • Develop and execute strategic recruitment plans to attract qualified candidates for both high-volume and hard-to-fill healthcare positions.
  • Source candidates through multiple channels, including LinkedIn, Indeed, CareerBuilder, job boards, social media, professional networks, and employee referrals.
  • Proactively identify and engage passive candidates through targeted outreach and relationship-building strategies.
  • Review applications and resumes to evaluate candidate qualifications, relevant experience, and alignment with position requirements.
  • Conduct telephone screenings, virtual interviews, and candidate assessments to identify qualified applicants.
  • Present qualified candidates to hiring managers with clear recommendations based on skills, experience, and organizational needs.
  • Coordinate interviews between candidates, hiring managers, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Manage candidate communication throughout the recruitment process, ensuring timely updates and a positive hiring experience.
  • Prepare, negotiate, and extend employment offers, including discussions regarding compensation, employment terms, and candidate expectations.
  • Coordinate completion of pre-employment requirements and collaborate with appropriate teams to support successful onboarding.
  • Serve as a consultative talent acquisition partner to hiring managers, providing guidance on sourcing strategies, labor market conditions, candidate availability, and recruitment best practices.
  • Develop creative recruitment strategies to address difficult-to-fill positions and competitive healthcare labor markets.
  • Monitor recruitment pipelines, candidate activity, requisition status, and hiring progress using applicant tracking systems.
  • Track and evaluate recruitment performance metrics, including hiring volumes, vacancy rates, turnover, productivity, and other established talent acquisition goals.

Job Title: Executive Director, Digital Product Management -Research

Job Location: South San Francisco, California, United States|Thousand Oaks, California, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do. Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions, and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, the Executive Director, Digital Product Management - Research will be the senior digital technology leader for Research. The Executive Director will translate Research strategy and portfolio priorities into a coherent technology, data and AI agenda that accelerates science, improves the quality and reuse of scientific data, and creates durable advantage in how Amgen discovers medicines. As a member of the Research Leadership Team, the Executive Director will help transform how science is done, and shape investment priorities to ensure that digital technologies are actively moving the portfolio forward from disease understanding and target selection through molecule design and synthesis, and translational safety. Success would include evidence of better scientific decisions and faster experimental learning.The Executive Director will own the technology environment for Research, including benchtop environment, electronic lab notebooks, scientific workflows, and the data products and platforms that connect Research disciplines. The successful candidate will lead a talented organization and serve as a trusted thought partner to scientific leaders, ensuring that Research teams have dependable, well-designed capabilities that enable better and faster science.


Responsibilities include:

  • Research strategy, portfolio impact, and executive leadership
  • Set and continuously evolve the multi-year Research Technology, Data & AI strategy in partnership with Research, linking capability investments to the Research portfolio, scientific priorities, and measurable outcomes.
  • Serve on the Research Leadership Team as a strategic advisor and decision-maker; bring technology and data insight to portfolio choices, operating plans, capital decisions, and risk discussions.
  • Own portfolio prioritization and investment recommendations across the function, balancing scientific value, urgency, adoption, technical dependencies, risk, cost, and organizational capacity.
  • Establish clear outcomes, OKRs and value measures; use evidence to redirect investment, retire low-value solutions and scale what demonstrably advances the science.
  • Scientific technology, laboratory workflows, and data products
  • Own the technology foundation that enables Research scientists to do their best work: benchtop and instrument-adjacent technology, electronic lab notebooks, LIMS, and integrated scientific workflows.
  • Deliver reliable, scalable products that scientists want to use, improve workflows, and demonstrate measurable value.
  • Lead the modernization and integration of scientific data workflows from capture at source through analysis, reuse, and decision-making, with a strong emphasis on data quality, metadata, terminology, and fit-for-purpose governance.
  • Build a coherent portfolio of governed, reusable data products that connect experiments, observations, models, and knowledge across Research, making data discoverable, trustworthy, and ready for analytical reuse.
  • Advance digital capabilities across the Research portfolio, including disease understanding, target selection, small molecule discovery, large molecule discovery, DNA-encoded libraries, and antibody-drug conjugates, while enabling productive collaboration across scientific domains.
  • Ensure platforms and workflows are designed around scientist needs and continuously improve the end-to-end user experience.
  • Technology, data, and operating leadership
  • Lead and develop a high-performing organization spanning research informatics, laboratory and benchtop technology, digital products, and scientific data enablement.
  • Build strong partnerships with Research scientific leaders, the Technology and AI & Data organizations, and external collaborators; resolve cross-functional dependencies and material trade-offs.
  • Demonstrate robust technology investment discipline across platform rationalization, build-versus-buy decisions, and managing technical debt.
  • Set a high bar for product and delivery excellence: clear problem framing, scientist co-design, strong architecture, rigorous vendor management, reliable operations, adoption, lifecycle management, and realized value
  • Create a culture that combines scientific curiosity with accountability; one that moves quickly, learns from evidence, anticipates risk, and delivers dependable services to laboratories and research teams
  • Communicate strategy, investment decisions, performance, risks, and opportunities clearly to executive audiences, translating complex scientific and technical choices into decisive action

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The candidatewe seek is an experienced leader with the following qualifications. They will also embody the Amgen leadership attributes which are:


  • Inspire: Create a connected, inclusive, and inspiring work environment that empowers talent to thrive
  • Accelerate: Enable speed that matches the urgency of patient needs by encouraging progress over perfection
  • Integrate: Connect the dots to amplify the collective power of Amgen to drive results for patients, staff, and shareholders
  • Adapt: Lead through change by adapting to an ever-changing environment and defining a clear course of action to deliver results

Basic Qualifications:

  • Doctorate degree & 6 years of technology experience OR
  • Master’s degree & 10 years of technology experience OR
  • Bachelor’s degree & 12 years of technology experience AND
  • 6 years of managerial experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs or directing the allocation of resources

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of progressive leadership experience, including direct leadership of senior leaders and/or responsibility for a substantial, multi-disciplinary organization
  • Experience leading technology, data, digital, informatics or computational capabilities in a research-intensive, life sciences environment
  • Scientific credibility that they can earn the trust of scientists and enable existing assumptions to be challenged
  • Understanding of drug discovery research lifecycle and builds credibility with scientists across relevant disciplines, such as small molecules, biologics, DELs, ADCs, disease biology, or translational science
  • Experience setting multi-year strategy in partnership with business functions and leading enterprise-scale changes across laboratory technology, scientific software, data platforms, scientific workflows, or research informatics
  • Experience in creating and scaling scientific data products, FAIR data practices, metadata and terminology capabilities, and integrated data-to-insight workflows
  • Technology and data judgment, with the ability to make informed decisions across cloud platforms, architecture, laboratory systems, data engineering, analytics, and vendor ecosystems
  • Ability to influence senior executives, lead through ambiguity, resolve consequential cross-functional trade-offs and create alignment without relying solely on formal authority
  • Executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex scientific, technical and investment choices into clear recommendations and action
  • Experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical research or another highly regulated, technology-intensive environment strongly preferred

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way. The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is $249,042 to $336,940. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications. In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:


  • Comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts.
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives
  • Award-winning time-off plans and bi-annual company-wide shutdowns
  • Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease. Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer. ★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

Litigation Paralegal

Location: Colombia
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote, Full-Time (9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time)
Employment Type: Independent Contractor
Industry: Legal Services / Law Firm
Compensation: $10–$12 USD per hour
Experience: 5+ Years
English Proficiency: Advanced English (Subject to Confirmation)

About the Company

Our client is an established U.S.-based law firm with decades of experience in personal injury and criminal defense representation.

The firm represents injury victims in cases such as car and truck accidents, slip and falls, premises liability, wrongful death, and dog bites, and also provides criminal defense. It works with a seasoned team of trial attorneys and legal support staff, and it is committed to professionalism, responsiveness, and strong results for its clients.

The firm is looking to grow its remote support team with legally trained professionals from Latin America.

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented, and legally trained Litigation Paralegal to support the firm's personal injury litigation practice, ideally an attorney or law graduate who wants to apply their legal education and experience in a remote paralegal role.

You will support the Personal Injury Litigation Attorney with case management, discovery, filings, medical records, liens, settlement preparation, client communication, and administrative tasks, while escalating legal decisions to U.S.-licensed counsel.

This role is ideal for someone who is organized, fluent in professional English, and able to manage routine case needs independently while working under attorney supervision.

Why This Opportunity?

  • Work directly with a U.S. trial law firm on active personal injury litigation.
  • Gain practical exposure to U.S. litigation, discovery, medical records, liens, and settlement processes.
  • Develop your case management, documentation, and client communication skills.
  • Work fully remotely with U.S. Eastern Time business hours.
  • Join a growing team with opportunities to learn and take on greater responsibility.

What You'll Do

Litigation & Case Management

  • Assist with pleadings, discovery, correspondence, court filings, and service of process.
  • Track open records requests, affidavits of service, court deadlines, and case calendars.
  • Monitor cases, identify outstanding tasks, and escalate issues requiring attorney attention.

Medical Records & Documentation

  • Request, organize, and track medical records and billing statements.
  • Follow up with providers and prepare medical treatment and billing summaries.
  • Identify missing documentation and maintain complete case files.

Liens & Settlement Support

  • Conduct lien lookups and coordinate Medicaid requests.
  • Track medical liens, balances, and settlement obligations.
  • Prepare settlement distribution statements and closing documents for attorney review.

Client Communication & Administration

  • Communicate with clients, providers, insurers, opposing offices, process servers, and government agencies.
  • Draft routine correspondence and follow up on outstanding documents and requests.
  • Maintain electronic files, case notes, calendars, and expense records.
  • Assist with filings, service fees, incoming correspondence, and other case-related administrative tasks.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of relevant legal experience.
  • Law degree from a recognized university in Mexico or another Latin American country; licensed attorneys are encouraged to apply.
  • Advanced written and spoken English proficiency.
  • Strong legal research, drafting, organization, document review, and deadline-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple cases independently and provide accurate status updates.
  • Reliable internet, a private workspace, and commitment to confidentiality and information security.

Preferred

  • Experience with a U.S. law firm, personal injury litigation, or civil litigation.
  • Knowledge of discovery, pleadings, court filings, service of process, and litigation calendars; Georgia procedure experience is a plus.
  • Experience with medical records, billing, liens, and settlement documentation.
  • Familiarity with MyCase or similar case-management software.

How Success Is Measured

  • Accurate case files and timely completion of assignments.
  • Reliable calendaring and deadline tracking.
  • Consistent follow-up and professional communication.
  • Accurate documentation and proactive litigation support.
  • Organization, reliability, and proactive communication with the team.

Why Join Us

You'll join a collaborative, fully remote support team that values ownership, professionalism, clear communication, and continuous professional development.

The firm offers hands-on exposure to U.S. personal injury litigation, close work with experienced trial attorneys, and opportunities to grow your expertise in litigation support.

Important Notes

  • This is a paralegal and legal support position, not a U.S. attorney position.
  • All work is performed under attorney supervision. The position does not authorize independent U.S. legal advice, attorney representation, legal strategy decisions, or unsupervised legal practice. Substantive legal questions and settlement advice must be referred to the assigned attorney.
  • The position requires strong ownership of tasks, attention to detail, and reliable follow-through.
  • Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a written English and legal-support skills assessment.
  • Please submit your CV in English, detailing your legal education, bar admission or professional credentials (if applicable), English proficiency, and relevant litigation or U.S. law firm experience.

This is a fully remote position.

work shift : 10 AM to 2 PM UAE time .

This is not a high-volume, spray-and-pray outreach role. We’re looking for someone who can identify the right companies, understand potential gaps in their digital presence, and start relevant conversations with decision-makers.

Your primary responsibility is to prospect, qualify, and book meetings for the sales team.

You are not responsible for closing deals or managing projects. Your focus is creating qualified sales opportunities.

    • Outdated or underperforming websites

    • Stronger brand positioning

    • Mobile responsiveness

Success in this role is not measured purely by outreach volume.

We care about relevant conversations and qualified opportunities.

A successful SDR consistently identifies companies with genuine web development or redesign potential, reaches the right decision-makers, and converts those conversations into qualified discovery meetings for the sales team.

Requirements

1–3+ years of experience in a B2B SDR, BDR, Lead Generation, Appointment Setting, or Outbound Sales role.

Organized and disciplined with follow-ups, CRM updates, and pipeline management.

Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a part-time, target-driven environment.

jobs.excerpt: Position Summary... What you'll do... The Senior Product Marketing Manager, Competitive Intelligence is a senior individual contributor role responsible for building the analytical and competitive intelligence backbone for product and business decision-making.
jobs.description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...

The Senior Product Marketing Manager, Competitive Intelligence is a senior individual contributor role responsible for building the analytical and competitive intelligence backbone for product and business decision-making. This role leads deep market, product, and competitor analysis to uncover strategic gaps, quantify opportunities, and shape product inbound, roadmap direction, and go-to-market decisions.

This role is centered on unpacking our product features, functionality, positioning, and future vision against a defined competitor set, then translating that analysis into clear, decision-ready recommendations for Product, PMM, and business leaders. It brings structured, market signal into roadmap decisions and helps turn product capability into measurable commercial impact.

What you will own

  • Lead the competitive intelligence discipline for priority product and solution areas.
  • Build and maintain frameworks for competitive benchmarking, feature teardown, opportunity sizing, and strategic comparison.
  • Analyze our product portfolio against competitors across capability depth, differentiation, packaging, pricing, adoption, and future product direction.
  • Quantify trade-offs, risks, and growth opportunities to support roadmap and investment decisions.
  • Deliver rigorous, structured insights that influence product inbound, roadmap prioritization, and commercial strategy.
  • Enable PMMs and cross-functional partners to use competitive intelligence methods at scale.
  • Establish standards for CI analysis quality, confidence levels, and post-decision validation.

Core responsibilities

  • Conduct product and competitor teardowns that compare current capabilities, gaps, and strategic positioning.
  • Build market sizing, forecasting, and scenario models to quantify opportunity and inform prioritization.
  • Perform competitive benchmarking using weighted scoring, maturity models, and capability frameworks.
  • Run statistical and analytical work including regression, cohort analysis, clustering, and driver analysis to understand what drives competitive wins and losses.
  • Design and analyze experiments and causal tests to validate hypotheses and measure impact.

The future is full of possibilities. At Banner Plans & Networks, we’re changing the industry to reduce healthcare costs while keeping members in optimal health. If you’re ready to change lives, we want to hear from you.

Banner Plans & Networks (BPN) is a nationally recognized healthcare leader that integrates Medicare and private health plans. Our main goal is to reduce healthcare costs while keeping our members in optimal health. BPN is known for its innovative, collaborative, and team-oriented approach to healthcare. We offer diverse career opportunities, from entry-level to leadership positions, and extend our innovation to employment settings by including remote and hybrid opportunities.

As a Health Plans Grievance and Appeals Coordinator, you will play a critical role within Banner Plans & Networks, ensuring the timely intake, review, investigation, and resolution of grievances, appeals, and provider disputes. This is a high-volume, fast-paced position that requires prior knowledge of grievance and appeals processes. In this role, you will research complex claim and service issues, determine appropriate levels of review, coordinate with internal teams and providers, document findings, and prepare professional correspondence including acknowledgment and resolution letters. Success in this position requires exceptional attention to detail, strong written communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to efficiently navigate multiple systems while delivering accurate, compliant, and timely resolutions that support both provider satisfaction and business objectives.

In this role, you will primarily be working in a remote setting. CANDIDATES MUST RESIDE IN THE STATE OF ARIZONA TO BE CONSISDERED. Work shifts will be 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. Monday-Friday. If this role sounds like the one for you, Apply Today!

Registry/Per Diem positions do not have guaranteed hours and no medical benefits package is offered. Completion of post-offer Occupational Health physical assessment, drug screen and background check (includes employment, criminal and education) is required.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position handles member and provider grievances, appeals and claim disputes. This position will act as a key advocate and contact for HP members with general health care and accessibility concerns and inquiries on the various levels of the grievance and appeals process.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Determines which claim disputes meet acceptable claim dispute criteria, specifically screening for Untimely claims and Resubmissions; maintains a log, categorizes and tracks all received documents, notices, returned receipts; decides and responds to those appeals and claim disputes not meeting criteria with appropriate correspondence and routing. Assists in resolving member questions and concerns regarding the health care system in an effort to prevent the need for members to file formal grievances or appeals.

2. Enters all accepted appeals and claim disputes and its corresponding information into the CRM; creates and maintains case files, including appropriate review sheets for Medical Review and/or Claim Review according to policy, AHCCCS, HCG, and CMS regulations; updates CRM for ongoing cases with responses from reviewers. Assesses individual cases and documents in various CRM programs for pertinent information for referral and/or transmission to co-workers.

3. Ensures all appeals and claim disputes are acknowledged, by official correspondence, within AHCCCS, HCG, and CMS contractual timelines; protects the confidentiality of member information and other information. Facilitates, communicates and accepts input regarding member and provider appeal information from appropriate individuals that would include employees, providers, Medical Director, Plan Administrator, RNs, Risk Management, attorneys, AHCCCS, HCG, CMS and others.

4. Responds to all incoming phone calls, researches and resolves member and provider questions and concern regarding grievances, appeals and claim disputes. Opens, reviews, researches (if necessary), date stamps and routes or responds to all incoming mail. Responds in an expedient manner that is consistent with the mission and values of UAHN and in support of related regulations and policies and procedures to member, staff and physician grievances, appeals and claim disputes with minimal supervision.

5. Creates and submits all resolution and extension correspondence, utilizing appropriate Arizona Revised Statues, Arizona Administrative Code, Code of Federal Regulations, and other supporting regulatory policies and statutes for all UAHP managed plans. Self-audits daily to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

6. Recognizes, facilitates and gathers relevant medical records, coding and claim documentation that is required for the reviewers to fully investigate grievances, appeals, and claim disputes. Responsible for trouble shooting, identifying, and resolving special handling requirements related to grievance and appeal issues.

7. Reports at Grievance/Appeals meetings, as appropriate, all incoming, attended and scheduled State Fair Hearings.

8. Works internally with other departments in order to facilitate timely responses and inquiries, and assists with workgroups as requested. Provides technical expertise to other departments regarding grievances, appeals and claim disputes.

9. This position works under supervision, prioritizing data from multiple sources to provide quality care and support. Incumbents work in a fast-paced, sometimes stressful environment with a strong focus on customer service. Interacts with staff at all levels throughout the organization.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

High school diploma/GED or equivalent working knowledge. Two years of work experience in health care related field or experience managing projects/initiatives, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Knowledge of AHCCCS, HCG and/or CMS regulations. Knowledge of MS Word, Excel and Microsoft Office Suite required. Knowledge of Medical terminology, claims processing guidelines, and CRM & IDX. Knowledge of grievance, appeal and claim dispute processes.

Strong interpersonal, organizational and problem solving skills. Strong oral and written communication skills required. Ability to work independently ensuring all deadlines/timelines are met and to work with various levels of healthcare professionals. Ability to be flexible and work on a variety of projects simultaneously under tight time constraints. Strong analytical, critical-thinking and time management skills. Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize multiple tasks daily. Ability to quickly identify, summarize and present (verbally and orally) options to issues which may arise, and to consistently meet and exceed regulatory reporting requirements for all lines of business.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

The Staubli FCS Data Centers Key Account Manager is responsible for managing and building strategic, long-term relationships with Stäubli key clients to maximize mutual value, drive revenue, and ensure customer retention. Responsibilities include acting as the primary contact, understanding client needs, coordinating within the FCS Division to meet customer demands, developing account strategies for growth, and analyzing sales data. A successful Key Account Manager possesses excellent communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills, a strong understanding of the industry, and the ability to act as a trusted advisor.

Reports to:

FCS Data Centers Local Business Head – North America

Responsibilities and Objectives:

  • The Data Center Key Account Manager will be the primary point of contact with Staubli’s Data Center key accounts
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with current or new customers, channel partners, and co-suppliers on regular basis, ensuring a deep understanding of their needs.
  • Educate and persuade potential customers on the value and advantages of Stäubli products and services.
  • Gain market insights to identify product development opportunities, share competition intelligence, to ultimately generate new Business Development opportunities for Stäubli Data Center product portfolio.
  • Prepare and deliver technical presentations, demos, and workshops to customers and prospective clients, creating value.
  • Participate in weekly North American & Global meetings and calls, to align on strategy and activities with management and the Data Centre team.
  • Define and share forecasts and periodic market & customer trend analysis.
  • Actively and timely communicate and create reports to both local and global Data Center Segment Team members – utilizing Stäubli CRM.
  • Actively attend various marketing events, trade shows, and industry functions to network and promote the company offering.
  • Generate and follow up on leads in timely manner.
  • To gain and provide needed technical specification information to Technical/Applications Team to generate new projects.
  • To efficiently handle any customer’s claim in a shortest timeframe and keep highest standard of customer satisfaction.
  • Adheres to all safety, quality and environmental standards.
  • Bachelor’s degree is required
  • Bachelors degree in Engineering with a specialization in Mechanical or Thermal Engineering is highly preferred
  • 3 years of sales experience in a technical field is required
  • 5+ years of key account manager in technical field, with a focus on thermal management solutions in the datacenter of high-performance computer industry is preferred
  • Proven experience in key account management with the ability to foster long-term client relationships
  • Must live near a major airport - preferrable within 1-2 hours flight to the west coast.

Physical Requirements

  • Periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Periods of driving
  • Must be able to lift, push, pull, and carry objects
  • Must be able to lift up to 25 pounds at times
  • Dexterity and accuracy as needed to operate equipment

Work schedule:

  • Willingness to travel as required both domestically and internationally (up to 75%)
  • This position will be fully remote with travel to Duncan, SC office for initial onboarding and training.

Stäubli Corporation is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Stäubli is a value driven technological solutions provider with four dedicated activities: Electrical Connectors, Fluid Connectors, Robotics and Textile. We strive for innovation and excellence and are market leaders in many industrial segments. Stäubli guarantees high quality, reliability, and performance - our strong basis for the trusted partnership with our customers worldwide.

jobs.title: SR People and Culture Business Partner (930832)
jobs.excerpt: The Senior People & Culture Business Partner (Sr.
jobs.description:
The Senior People & Culture Business Partner (Sr. P&C BP) is a hands-on HR partner responsible for providing day-to-day People & Culture support to leaders and employees across an assigned portfolio of the business. This role works closely with managers to address employee relations matters, performance concerns, policy questions, workforce needs, and other people-related issues while ensuring consistent application of company practices and processes.

A significant part of this role involves directly managing employee relations matters from intake through resolution, including conducting investigations, advising leaders on performance and attendance concerns, supporting corrective action, and helping managers navigate complex employee situations.

The Sr. P&C BP also plays an important role in executing core People & Culture processes, including performance management, organizational changes, talent reviews, employee engagement, and workforce planning. While the role partners with senior leaders and provides thoughtful guidance on people decisions, this is a highly hands-on position that requires someone who is comfortable moving between advising leaders and personally managing the details and follow-through required to get the work done.

This role operates in a dynamic, fast-moving environment and supports multiple priorities at the same time. We’re looking for an experienced HR professional who is practical, responsive, comfortable working through complex employee situations, and willing to roll up their sleeves to support the business.

People & Culture Business Partnership

  • Serve as the primary P&C partner for assigned leaders, managers, and employees, providing practical guidance and day-to-day support.
  • Build strong working relationships with operational leaders to understand their teams, workforce needs, and people-related challenges.
  • Provide guidance on company policies, P&C practices, employee concerns, performance management, attendance, and other workplace matters.
  • Partner with leaders on workforce planning, talent needs, organizational changes, retention concerns, and other people-related decisions.
  • Ensure P&C processes and practices are consistently implemented across assigned business areas.
  • Work collaboratively with other P&C functions, including Talent Acquisition, Benefits, Payroll, HRIS, Learning & Development, and P&C leadership, to resolve issues and support business needs.

Employee Relations & Performance Management

  • Manage a high volume of employee relations matters from intake through resolution.
  • Provide hands-on guidance to managers regarding performance concerns, attendance issues, workplace conduct, policy violations, and corrective action.
  • Conduct workplace investigations, including gathering information, interviewing employees and witnesses, documenting findings, and partnering with appropriate stakeholders on next steps.
  • Coach managers on appropriate documentation and effective handling of employee concerns.
  • Support performance improvement plans, written warnings, and other corrective actions.
  • Partner with leaders and P&C leadership on employee separations and other complex employment decisions.
  • Help ensure employee matters are handled fairly, consistently, and in accordance with company policies and applicable employment laws.
  • Maintain appropriate documentation and follow-through on employee relations cases.

Manager Support & Coaching

  • Serve as a trusted and accessible resource for managers navigating day- to-day people situations.
  • Coach managers on employee communication, performance conversations, documentation, conflict resolution, and effective people management practices.
  • Help managers address issues proactively and escalate matters when appropriate.
  • Support managers through difficult employee conversations and complex workplace situations.
  • Provide practical recommendations that balance employee needs, business needs, company practices, and compliance considerations.

Talent & Performance Processes

  • Support managers through annual and ongoing performance management processes.
  • Partner with leaders to identify performance concerns, development needs, retention risks, and talent needs within their teams.
  • Participate in talent reviews and succession planning processes and assist leaders with required follow-up actions.
  • Support onboarding and integration of new leaders and employees when appropriate.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and hiring leaders on workforce and recruiting needs.
  • Provide P&C support for internal movement, promotions, transfers, and other employee changes.

Employee Engagement & Culture

  • Partner with leaders to understand employee concerns and identify opportunities to improve the employee experience.
  • Support execution of employee engagement initiatives and follow-up actions within assigned business areas.
  • Help leaders address workplace or team concerns that may be affecting engagement, communication, or retention.
  • Reinforce company values and expected workplace behaviors through regular interactions with leaders and employees.
  • Support company-wide P&C programs and initiatives as needed.

Organizational Changes & Workforce Support

  • Provide hands-on P&C support during organizational changes, restructures, contract transitions, reductions in force, leadership changes, and other workforce actions.
  • Coordinate with leaders and appropriate P&C partners to ensure employee changes are properly planned, communicated, documented, and executed.
  • Support leaders and employees through changes and address questions or concerns as they arise.
  • Partner with P&C leadership and other teams on more complex or higher-risk employee actions.

P&C Operations, Compliance & Reporting

  • Ensure employee actions and P&C processes are properly documented and completed in accordance with established processes.
  • Partner with HRIS, Payroll, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, and other support teams to resolve employee issues and ensure appropriate follow- through.
  • Review workforce and employee data to identify trends or areas requiring attention.
  • Maintain accurate documentation related to employee relations matters, performance actions, organizational changes, and other P&C activities.
  • Support P&C reporting, audits, compliance activities, and other operational requirements as needed.
  • Identify opportunities to improve or simplify P&C processes based on recurring issues or business needs.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and relevant HR experience may be considered in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
  • HR certification such as SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR is preferred.

Experience

  • 5+ years of progressive Human Resources/People & Culture experience, preferably in an HR Business Partner or HR Generalist capacity.
  • 3+ years of experience directly managing employee relations matters, preferably in a high-volume, multi-location, or operational environment.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting workplace investigations and advising managers on performance, attendance, corrective action, and employee conduct matters.
  • Experience supporting managers and employees across a broad range of day-to-day HR issues.
  • Experience supporting performance management, organizational changes, talent processes, and employee separations.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment and managing multiple employee matters and priorities simultaneously.

Skills & Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of HR practices, employee relations, performance management, and applicable employment laws.
  • Strong hands-on employee relations and investigation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage employee matters from initial intake through resolution.
  • Strong judgment and ability to navigate sensitive or complex employee situations.
  • Ability to provide managers with clear, practical, and actionable guidance.
  • Strong coaching, communication, conflict resolution, and problem- solving skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly when managing documentation and multiple cases simultaneously.
  • Ability to balance employee experience, business needs, company practices, and compliance considerations.
  • Comfortable working directly with employees and with leaders at different levels of the organization.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Benefits, HRIS, Legal, and other partners.
  • Proficiency with HRIS platforms, Microsoft Office, and other HR technology

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
