Job Type: Permanent
Work Model: Remote
Reference code: 135742
Primary Location: Toronto, ON
All Available Locations: Toronto, ON; Burlington, ON; Calgary, AB; Edmonton, AB; Fredericton, NB; Halifax, NS; Kitchener, ON; Moncton, NB; Ottawa, ON; Regina, SK; Saint John, NB; Saskatoon, SK; St. John's, NL; Vancouver, BC; Victoria, BC; Winnipeg, MB

Our Purpose

R8dius is an Indigenous majority-owned professional services, technology implementation and managed services business. Our purpose is to “Widen the Circle”, or in other words, to expand the horizons of opportunity and prosperity so that Indigenous Peoples can be leaders in the professional services space. We are united by the goal of forging a new path for all of us to walk and prosper together.

It’s a rare thing when you get to help build the future; but that’s every day at R8dius. We’re working hard to turn R8dius into a meeting place, enabled by our shared purpose, where we can learn, work, and grow together. We are compelled to find solutions to challenging problems that drive our people, our company, and our clients forward.

By living our Purpose, together we will make an impact that matters.

  • Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching
  • Collaborate with a supportive, values-driven team committed to creating a culturally safe environment where knowledge, lived experience, and diverse perspectives are respected and shared
  • A remote first workplace - work where you want within Canada. For those who qualify, work tax-exempt from your community.

Widening the circle

In response to growing calls for reconciliation and lasting societal change, Indigenous leadership and businesses have come together in partnership with Deloitte Canada to forge long-term partnerships, create new avenues for growth, and drive economic advancement. R8dius is a national network comprised of First Nations and Deloitte’s service capabilities. We share values, a focus on long-term change, and the belief that a purpose-led organization can make an impact for all.

Step into a purpose-driven role at R8dius, where your lived experience and knowledge can make a profound difference. We're actively seeking empathetic individuals with a background in customer service or contact center operations to join our team as Remote Contact Centre Agents, dedicated to assisting Indigenous Peoples and communities in navigating the complexities of Indigenous Class Action Administration Projects.

If you identify as Indigenous (First Nations, Inuit, Métis) and have a passion for supporting others during sensitive moments, we invite you to bring your cultural sensitivity, compassion, and listening skills to our team. This position can be done remotely, and tax exemption work is encouraged for those who qualify. We are hiring 12-15 team members on an initial contract basis, with the opportunity to transition to permanent employment based on performance, business needs, and demonstrated commitment to our team and vaules.

Scheduled shifts will be assigned within our operating hours of 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. EST and team members will be guaranteed a minimum of 30 hours per week. We strive to provide schedules that balance business requirements and employee needs whenever possible.

What will your typical day look like?

Join R8dius’ Contact Centre group for an impactful role as a Remote Contact Centre Agent on Indigenous Class Action Administration Projects. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

Empathetic Customer Support:

• Engage with compassion and cultural sensitivity when responding to customer inquiries via phone and email.
• Navigate through sensitive topics related to Indigenous class-action settlements with empathy and understanding.

Exceptional Communication:

• Provide timely and accurate responses, using industry technologies to ensure efficient and effective communication.
• Adapt your communication style to meet the diverse needs of individuals, demonstrating a commitment to inclusivity.

Navigating Complexities:

• Assist individuals in understanding and navigating the complexities of Indigenous Class Action Administration Projects.
• Guide clients through sensitive issues, maintaining a non-judgmental and supportive approach.

Innovation and Improvement:

• Identify opportunities for innovation to enhance the overall client service delivery experience.
• Collaborate with the team to improve processes, ensuring a streamlined and supportive experience for those seeking assistance.

About the team

R8dius is an Indigenous professional services, technology implementation and managed services business. R8dius’ founding investor and partner is Kitsaki Management, one of Canada’s leading First Nation economic development corporations and the economic development arm of Lac La Ronge Indian Band in Saskatchewan. Supported by Deloitte Canada, R8dius will widen the circle of opportunities for Indigenous Peoples and Nations to lead in the professional services space and engage in sustainable partnerships across Canada.

As an independent business, R8dius will operate with an Indigenous-majority board to deliver innovative and impactful Indigenous technology services in Canada, in response to the growing market need. R8dius includes a national network of Indigenous and non-Indigenous leaders, fusing unique perspectives and capabilities to deliver world-class solutions and technologies to clients across the economy to address Canada’s most complex challenges. As R8dius grows, it will continue to engage Indigenous economic development groups to invest in the business and drive economic diversification within their communities.

Certified as an Indigenous Business by Indigenous Services Canada (ISC) and the Canadian Council of Indigenous Business (CCIB), the ‘8’ in R8dius is representative of the Eighth Fire Prophecy – a First Nation’s prophecy related to creating a better future through aligning values of Indigenous and non-Indigenous communities. Accounting & month-end close

  • Own full-cycle accounting, including AP, AR, general ledger, journal entries, accruals, and deferrals.

Revenue operations & billing

FP&A & financial modeling

Compliance & advisory coordination

Required Qualifications:

Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

About the Team

The Identity & Security team owns the front door to Binance. We build and operate the registration, login, and account security experience used by every one of our 300M+ users — social login, OAuth and third-party authorization, multi-factor authentication, passkeys and FIDO2, device management, account activity, and account closure.

We are currently building an in-house AI facial recognition security product for KYC verification and user safety, replacing our existing third-party vendor solution. This is a to-C product serving hundreds of millions of users, directly impacting account security and identity verification experience at scale.

Our work sits where three forces meet: enormous scale, strict security and regulatory constraints, and the reality that one extra verification step can block an attacker or lock out a legitimate user. We ship across web, mobile mini programs, and in-app webviews, and we publish the shared authentication libraries and SDKs that the rest of Binance builds on.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain the login, registration, and account security applications across web and mobile clients
  • Build the in-house AI facial recognition security product end to end — KYC verification, liveness detection, face matching — replacing the existing third-party vendor solution
  • Build authentication capabilities end to end: passkeys / FIDO2 (WebAuthn), authenticator apps, security keys, SMS and email verification, and biometric flows
  • Own the multi-factor authentication orchestration layer — verification strategy, step-up logic, and user-level customization — balancing security strength against completion rate with measurable outcomes
  • Collaborate closely with the AI algorithm team to integrate facial recognition, liveness detection, and other AI model capabilities into the product frontend and backend, building high-concurrency, low-latency online inference services
  • Maintain and evolve the shared security component and logic libraries consumed by multiple product applications, and the authentication SDKs published to teams across the company; take responsibility for bundle size, initialization behavior, and backward compatibility
  • Develop and operate the Node.js server-side layer: server-side rendering, route-level authentication guards, session validation and redirects, localized routing, and first-paint performance
  • Build and refine the BFF layer — aggregating upstream security services and turning raw error codes into results the frontend can consume and users can act on
  • Implement platform-specific behavior for web, mini program, and low-end device targets while keeping shared and platform-specific code cleanly separated
  • Drive engineering quality: unit and end-to-end test coverage, instrumentation and observability, build and local development experience
  • Use funnel and event data to find drop-off in login and verification flows, and drive optimization from evidence rather than intuition
  • Collaborate closely with product, design, risk, customer support, backend, iOS, and Android teams; independently own the end-to-end design and delivery of a sub-domain such as passkeys, MFA orchestration, or facial recognition verification

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent industry experience
  • 3–8 years of frontend or full stack engineering experience, including consumer-facing products taken from zero to one or evolved over multiple years
  • Strong web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, browser rendering, networking, caching, and performance optimization
  • Deep proficiency in React 18+ and TypeScript, with solid command of state management, data-fetching patterns, and complex multi-step form and flow orchestration
  • Production Node.js experience: server-side rendering or isomorphic applications, BFF layering, API aggregation and caching, and the ability to independently debug server-side runtime issues
  • A clear methodology for modeling complex flows — authentication and verification are highly branched, stateful, interruptible, and resumable, and need to be abstracted into testable, reusable models rather than nested conditionals
  • Solid engineering practice: modular architecture, component design, unit and E2E testing, CI/CD, and responsible judgment on breaking changes to shared libraries (versioning, staged rollout, rollback)
  • Proficient with AI-assisted development tools (Cursor / Claude Code / Copilot, etc.) with practical experience incorporating them into daily development workflows
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for diagnosing production issues, compatibility problems, and performance bottlenecks independently

Why Binance

  • Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
  • Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning

jobs.excerpt: About seQuraseQura provides innovative, flexible and easy-to-use payment technologies that help merchants acquire, convert and retain more customers.
jobs.description:
About seQura

seQura provides innovative, flexible and easy-to-use payment technologies that help merchants acquire, convert and retain more customers.

We make a difference in sales performance by tailoring our solutions to different sectors, to address their unique pain points and deliver superior results in Retail, Education, Eyewear, Repairs and Travel.

We also empower smart shopping to consumers who seek more value, convenience, and flexibility in their shopping, with new payment experiences that allow them to save, access interest-free credit, or pay in small, comfortable installments of up to 24 months.

Born in Barcelona, seQura is a privately-owned fintech, currently expanding throughout southern Europe and Latin America, growing above 50% CAGR.
Over 6000 businesses, almost 3 million shoppers, and almost 400 employees continue to rate us as one of the most loved and trusted fintechs out there, with an NPS of 87%, a Trustpilot rating of 4.7/5, and a Glassdoor rating of 4.1/5.

About the role 🤓

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform team and help us build the platform that lets every engineer at seQura ship safely, quickly, and on their own.

seQura is expanding into new international markets, and the platform has to grow with it without growing its cost at the same pace. At the same time, AI is changing how infrastructure is built and run. We already put AI agents to work on our everyday platform work, from reviewing infrastructure changes and explaining plans to helping engineers resolve incidents on their own. Our goal is to go much further: independent agents working across the whole scope of the platform, with engineers who decide what matters and own the outcome.

You'll work in a cloud-native AWS environment, in a regulated fintech, where security, compliance, and reliability are part of the product we offer to the rest of engineering.

How we build at seQura 🤖

AI-assisted development is how our engineers work every day. We use AI agents to think through problems, write, review and iterate on code, and we're looking for engineers who already work this way, or are actively making the shift.

What matters to us isn't whether you know the syntax and idioms of your preferred programming language or tech stack by heart. It's whether you understand the problem you're solving, can explain the business logic behind it, and own every line you ship, no matter who (or what) wrote it first.

AI helps you move faster, challenge assumptions, explore different approaches and improve your solutions. But knowing which questions to ask, making sound technical and product decisions, and taking responsibility for the outcome is always up to you.

Our technical interviews reflect this approach: you'll use your own AI tools, and we'll ask you to walk us through your solution, both the business reasoning and the code.

If you're only interested in technical challenges without engaging in the product decisions behind them, or you'd rather not work with AI, this probably isn't the right role for you.

About the Platform team 🧩

Team Mission

To empower engineers with secure, efficient, and compliant infrastructure, while continuously improving through automation and collaboration.

What we own

  • Our multi-account AWS foundation and the Kubernetes (EKS) clusters where seQura's products run

  • Infrastructure as Code with Terragrunt, delivered through pull requests and Atlantis

  • Deployment and GitOps tooling: Helm charts, shared deploy configuration, and CI/CD pipelines

  • The observability stack used across engineering: metrics, logs, traces, and alerting

  • Security and compliance foundations: secrets management, access control, PCI DSS, and the controls required to operate regulated entities across multiple countries under regulations such as DORA, NIS2 and those still to come.

  • Internal developer tooling, including the AI agents and Claude Code plugins that engineers use to work with our platform on their own

How we work

  • We're enablers: internal teams are our customers, and we measure success by how much they can do without us

  • We're autonomous end-to-end: we code, deploy, observe, improve, and document what we build

  • Everything as code, everything through a pull request, everything reviewed, and every important decision written down in an ADR

  • Strong opinions, held weakly; collaborators over rock stars; blameless by default

  • We plan by quarter and choose initiatives by their impact on users and on the business

We work closely with every product engineering team, with Security, with the Data Platform team, and with Compliance.

What challenges you'll be solving 🚀

  • International expansion: help seQura launch in multiple new markets, with the isolation, compliance, and reliability each one requires

  • AI-native platform: move from AI that assists us to independent agents that operate across the whole scope of the platform, from infrastructure changes to support and incident response

  • Keeping up with open source in the AI era: define new strategies to adopt, upgrade, and secure the open source software we depend on, now that it moves faster than ever

  • Scale without raising our baseline cost: design the strategies that let the business keep growing while our base infrastructure cost stays flat

What to expect in the next 90 days 🏁

Month 1: Learn the terrain 🧭

You'll join initiatives the team already has in motion, pairing with your teammates and shipping your first changes to production. You'll learn how we work, why we made the decisions we made, and what the rest of engineering expects from us.

By the end of the month: you've shipped to production and you know who to ask for what.

Month 2: Own your first mission 🎯

We'll hand you an opportunity the team has already identified, and it's yours: from the technical design to running it in production. You'll keep discovering seQura along the way, and we'll be there whenever you need context.
By the end of the month: you've delivered an initiative end-to-end and you have your own opinion on where the platform should go next.

jobs.title: AI Workflow Transformation Lead
jobs.excerpt: Cint is moving from AI experimentation to enterprise-wide AI-enabled operating change.
jobs.description:
Cint is moving from AI experimentation to enterprise-wide AI-enabled operating change.

The next phase is not about adding more tools or running isolated pilots. It is about helping functions change how work happens: where humans lead, where AI assists, where AI automates, and where autonomous AI can safely operate.

As AI Workflow Transformation Lead, you will work with teams across Cint to identify, shape, deliver and embed AI-enabled improvements. You will help turn business priorities and operational pain points into better workflows, smarter practices and measurable improvements in how work gets done.

This is a broad, hands-on transformation role. Some work may involve workflow redesign. Some may involve functional support, delivery coordination, requirements shaping, governance navigation, adoption support or helping teams move from experiment to scalable practice.

The purpose is simple: help Cint turn AI potential into practical operating improvement.

Where the role sits

You will join the AI Transformation Office and report to the Director, Enterprise AI Transformation.

You will work closely with:

  • Director, Enterprise AI Transformation — AI roadmap, priorities, governance, value tracking and executive reporting.

  • AI Enablement & Adoption Lead — adoption, capability building, manager enablement, playbooks and behaviour change.

  • AI/Data Architecture capability — architecture, data readiness, build / buy / configure recommendations and integration design.

  • Business Technology — implementation, systems integration and operational handover.

  • Legal, DPO, InfoSec, Infrastructure and Functional AI Domain Leads — governance, compliance, technical readiness, business ownership and adoption.

You will not own every system or every team. Your job is to create clarity, momentum and practical progress.

What you will do

Identify and shape opportunities

You will work with functions to understand their priorities, pain points and opportunities for AI-enabled improvement.

You will help assess where AI can improve speed, quality, productivity, decision-making, risk reduction, employee experience or operating leverage.

You will separate useful opportunities from interesting distractions. Not every AI idea needs a project plan and a parade.

Redesign work where needed

You will help teams understand how work happens today and where it gets stuck: manual effort, handoffs, rework, bottlenecks, unclear ownership, data gaps or decision delays.

You will support future-state workflow design before technology is applied.

You will help clarify where work should remain human-led, where AI should assist, where automation makes sense and where review or escalation is needed.

Support delivery in the right way

You will help turn AI opportunities into practical plans with clear outcomes, owners, dependencies, risks and success measures.

Depending on the need, you may lead structured transformation work, support a function-led initiative, help shape requirements, coordinate stakeholders, unblock delivery or guide a team through governance.

Connect business, technical and governance partners

You will work across functions, AI/Data Architecture, Business Technology, Legal, DPO, InfoSec, Infrastructure and Enablement to make sure AI-enabled improvements are practical, safe and supportable.

You will help ensure the right technical owners, implementation routes, governance gates, adoption plans and handover expectations are clear.

Measure value and capture learning

You will define success measures and track whether changes are creating real value.

You will help capture reusable patterns so Cint does not solve the same problem from scratch in every function.

Support adoption

You will partner with the AI Enablement & Adoption Lead to make sure new ways of working are understood, adopted and embedded.

You will gather feedback, identify adoption blockers and help teams improve as they go.

What we are looking for

You will likely bring:

  • Experience in business transformation, operational excellence, process improvement, programme delivery, consulting, AI transformation, SaaS operations or a similar field.

  • Strong ability to understand, map and improve business workflows or operating practices.

  • Experience turning ambiguous business problems into clear opportunities, plans and outcomes.

  • Comfort working across business, technology, data, automation, legal, risk or compliance stakeholders.

  • Practical understanding of AI tools, automation, workflow tooling or digital transformation.

  • Good delivery discipline without unnecessary bureaucracy.

  • Commercial judgement and a clear link between workflow change and business value.

  • Strong communication, facilitation and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience in SaaS, technology, digital platforms, consulting or high-growth global businesses is strongly preferred.

How you work

  • You are structured, practical and comfortable with ambiguity.

  • You are curious about how work really happens, not just how people say it happens.

  • You can bring order to messy problems without creating theatre or bureaucracy.

  • You influence without authority, communicate clearly and help busy teams make decisions.

  • You care about shipped outcomes, measurable value and adoption that sticks.

  • You bring low ego, high standards and enough humour to survive cross-functional transformation work.

What success looks like

Within the first 3 months, you will have built a clear understanding of priority functional opportunities, helped shape the first wave of AI-enabled improvement work, and established practical ways of working for opportunity assessment, workflow redesign, delivery support and measurement.

Within 6–9 months, Cint should have visible AI-enabled improvements in priority areas, with clear adoption data, value tracking and reusable learning.

Over time, you will help Cint build a repeatable transformation capability: one that helps functions identify high-value opportunities, redesign work intelligently, apply AI where it makes sense and prove the impact.

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.

More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (www.cint.com)

Company Culture

At Advarra, we seek to foster an inclusive and collaborative environment where everyone is treated with respect and diverse perspectives are embraced. Treating one another, our clients, and clinical trial participants with empathy and care are key tenets of our culture at Advarra; we are committed to creating a workplace where each employee is not only valued but empowered to thrive and make a meaningful impact.

Advarra has as its core function the institutional review board (IRB) review of all human subject’s research from survey research to first-in-human research sponsored by pharmaceutical companies, biotech companies, institutions, hospitals as well as clinics and private physician offices. Within the IRB the regulatory department is responsible for the expedited review of research, the full board review of research and the drafting and writing of the meeting minutes. The regulatory department also collaborates with other parts of the organization on thought leadership, client guidance, and operational efficiencies.

Affiliated Board Members (ABM) are full-time Advarra employee board members who conduct IRB reviews on behalf of the organization. Based on educational background, experience, and expertise ABMs can be designated as either scientific or non-scientific and workload is distributed accordingly. A scientific ABM is a board member who has scientific expertise either professionally or based upon education.

Help ensure the timely execution of the core review activities of the Institutional Review Board while preserving the highest quality of professionalism and regulatory compliance
  • Be a resource to answer questions and help to solve day-to-day challenges whether in collaboration with Advarra staff or other board members, utilizing scientific knowledge and regulatory expertise
  • Assist as necessary with the triaging and review of submissions for expedited or full board review

  • Identify to senior regulatory staff areas that would benefit from guidance, inconsistencies in Board reviews, and other like issues

  • Enhance and encourage a work atmosphere centered on accountability through motivation, team building, training, mentoring, collaboration, and respect to create a highly efficient and successful workplace

Location

This role is open to candidates working remotely in the United States.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • One (1)+ years of IRB or Clinical Research Industry experience preferred, OR minimum 3 years’ experience in healthcare within the last 6 years

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree or other graduate level degree with an emphasis in a scientific background
  • A strong understanding of biological and/or pharmacological sciences (either through education or experience)

  • Verbal communication; listening and understanding, responding, and speaking

indaHash is a global influencer marketing platform connecting brands with over 5 million creators worldwide. Through our technology and expert-led services, we help brands run scalable, data-driven influencer campaigns across multiple markets, working with leading global brands and agencies.

Our mission is simple: make influencer marketing smarter, faster, and more effective.

About the role

We’re looking for a proactive and commercially driven Senior Sales Manager to help grow our business in Italy as part of our expansion across Europe.

This role is perfect for someone who enjoys hunting for new business, building relationships, and turning opportunities into long-term partnerships. You’ll take ownership of the sales process, from identifying prospects and opening conversations to negotiating and closing deals.

You’ll bring proven experience in selling creator economy solutions or digital marketing services, alongside strong knowledge of the Italian market. We’re looking for someone who understands how local brands and agencies buy, can confidently engage decision-makers, and has a track record of generating new business revenue.

What you’ll be doing

  • Identify and win new business with brands and agencies in Italy
  • Generate opportunities through targeted outreach, networking, referrals, and market research
  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification to proposals, negotiation, and closing
  • Build relationships with key decision-makers and understand their marketing objectives
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop pitches and proposals tailored to client needs
  • Build and manage a strong sales pipeline, maintain accurate CRM records, and provide reliable forecasts
  • Take ownership of sales targets and drive new business revenue
  • Use local market knowledge to identify opportunities and shape our approach in Italy
  • Stay up to date with trends in influencer marketing, digital marketing, and the creator economy

Who we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of experience in sales or business development within the creator economy or digital marketing services
  • A proven track record of winning new clients, closing deals, and achieving revenue targets
  • Strong local expertise in Italy, including knowledge of the brand and agency landscape, buying processes, and business culture
  • Experience independently managing the full sales cycle
  • Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
  • A proactive, self-motivated, and resilient approach to business development
  • Commercial thinking and the ability to connect client needs with relevant solutions
  • Fluent Italian and English

What makes you a great fit

  • You have an established network of brand or agency decision-makers in Italy
  • You’ve successfully sold influencer marketing, branded content, social media, or other digital marketing services
  • You enjoy opening doors and building lasting client relationships
  • You’re comfortable working independently while collaborating with international teams
  • You’re organised, accountable, and motivated by measurable results

Why indaHash

  • Work with global brands and international markets
  • Help shape our growth in Italy
  • Be part of the fast-growing creator economy space
  • Collaborate with teams across multiple regions
  • Develop your career in international sales and digital marketing
  • Fully remote work environment

indaHash, powered by ArabyAds, is the fastest growing technology platform that connects influencers from all over the world. Currently, indaHash operates in over 88 markets and owns offices in the United Arab Emirates, Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, the UK, South Africa and Poland. We cooperate with over 5,000,000 influencers and work with the biggest brands from the Fortune 500.

Since 2016 indaHash has conducted more than 23 000 campaigns for the world’s largest brands (Coca-cola, McDonald’s, L’Oreal, Electrolux and many more) in over 88 markets. indaHash cooperates parallelly with media houses and advertising agencies from around the world to carry out effective global campaigns on Instagram, Facebook, Snapchat, Twitter, TikTok and many more.

jobs.title: Head of Tax Information Reporting
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

OKX is hiring a Head of Tax Information Reporting to build and run our global tax information reporting function. The function covers the OECD Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF), the EU's DAC8 directive, the amended Common Reporting Standard (CRS 2.0), FATCA, and US Form 1099-DA across multiple reporting entities and a large global user base, with annual reporting across the EU, Brazil, and other CARF jurisdictions.
Most of the work is data: getting the right user, transaction, and balance data out of our platform, reconciling it, and turning it into accurate filings. You will own the relationship with our reporting vendor, the data specification that feeds it, and the quality checks that decide whether a file goes out.
You will run a central function that owns policy, data, vendor, QA, and submission for every entity in scope. Each reporting entity names an accountable signatory. Local compliance and entity leads are consulted on local requirements and support registration where the law requires a local filer. You will work closely with Product, Data Engineering, Finance Operations, Group Tax, Legal, Data Privacy, and the local entity leads.
Location: remote available, with a strong preference for the US or EU. Some travel to OKX offices.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the end-to-end CARF, DAC8, CRS 2.0, FATCA, and 1099-DA reporting cycle for every OKX entity in scope: population definition, self-certification coverage, data extraction and reconciliation, file production, QA, filing, corrections, and tax authority queries.
  • Define and own the data specification that feeds the tax platform vendor: which users, which transactions, which balances, how they are aggregated by user and jurisdiction, and how they reconcile to the ledger. Work with Product and Data Engineering to build and test the pipeline.
  • Build and run the QA framework. Reconcile every file to source, validate it against the OECD XML schema and local variants, sample-test self-certification reasonableness checks, and run cross-entity consistency checks for users who hold accounts with more than one OKX entity. Nothing files without your release.
  • Manage the tax platform vendor: contract scope, delivery calendar, test cycles, output validation, issue resolution, and the annual renewal decision.
  • Set the group reporting policy and interpret the regimes for OKX: reportable crypto-assets, transfers to unhosted wallets, staking and reward income, retail payment thresholds, residency tie-breakers, and TIN rules, exercising independent technical judgment, supported by Legal and external tax advisers.
  • Own the global tax self-certification design in onboarding, including validation rules, refresh triggers, and the backlog remediation program for existing users, working with Compliance and Product.
  • Define the process for restricting undocumented accounts under DAC8 and CARF, including reason codes and customer communications, with restrictions applied automatically in Product and monitored by the central team.
  • Maintain the entity-by-entity readiness tracker covering domestic enactment, registration, self-certification coverage, and deadlines. Report weekly to the CCO and monthly to the CARF steering committee.
  • Hands-on leader. Build a small, senior team, scaled through the reporting vendor and outside advisers. Coordinate with and train local compliance and entity leads.
  • Support independent testing by Compliance Monitoring, Risk, and Internal Audit, and support tax authority examinations with complete, reproducible records.

What We Look For In You

  • 7+ years in tax information reporting, tax operations, or regulatory data reporting at a global exchange, broker, bank, fintech, or digital asset platform, including at least 3 years leading a team.
  • Hands-on experience in a global, distributed digital asset business: you have worked with exchange or wallet transaction data, multiple legal entities, and users spread across many jurisdictions. This is required.
  • Strong data skills. You can write SQL, define data specifications for engineers, reconcile large transaction datasets to a ledger, and find the gap when the numbers do not tie. You have built or run data quality controls on reporting output.
  • Working knowledge of CARF, DAC8, CRS, and FATCA, including due diligence rules, self-certification requirements, reportable transaction categories, and the XML schemas used for exchange. Direct CARF or DAC8 implementation experience is strongly preferred given live DAC8 obligations and upcoming CARF reporting.
  • Experience managing a tax reporting vendor or reporting platform, including scoping, testing, and holding the vendor to a delivery calendar. the tax platform vendor experience is a plus.
  • Experience building a function from a small base: writing the policy, designing the controls, hiring the team, and running the first cycle.
  • Ability to explain data and tax issues plainly to executives, engineers, and local compliance officers, and to run a steering committee.
  • Judgment on when to escalate, comfort working across US, EU, and Asia time zones, and a record of meeting hard filing deadlines.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with US Form 1099-DA or 1099-B production, backup withholding, or Qualified Intermediary reporting.
  • Experience with the DAC8 60-day account restriction process or equivalent undocumented account remediation at scale.
  • Familiarity with GDPR requirements for sharing customer data with tax authorities, including data protection impact assessments.
  • Python or similar scripting for data validation, and experience with data warehouse tools such as Databricks.
  • Experience working inside a Three Lines Model, including supporting second-line monitoring and Internal Audit.
  • A CPA, chartered tax adviser, or equivalent; or a degree in data science, computer science, or accounting.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

OKX Statement:

OKX is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

We run a global, fully managed, multi-tenant SaaS platform that helps organizations manage, secure, govern, and distribute software artifacts at scale.

Our customers use Cloudsmith as critical infrastructure for CI/CD, developer workflows, security controls, compliance, and software distribution. We proxy and cache public open-source indexes, scan artifacts for vulnerabilities, licensing issues, and malware, and let organizations enforce policy as a dependency firewall. We support 30+ formats across languages, containers, and operating systems.

We recently raised our Series C to accelerate Cloudsmith 2.0: deeper artifact intelligence, stronger policy and provenance, faster package-aware delivery, and infrastructure built for engineering teams, as well as the modern AI-driven software factory.

By developers, for developers. We care about craft, openness, and transparency.

The Role

As Engineering Manager, you’ll lead high-performing teams delivering a large-scale, cloud-native application to software teams worldwide.

You’ll play a pivotal role in driving new features on our artifact management platform, scaling operations to support our continued growth, fostering a strong engineering culture, mentoring engineers in their professional development, and guiding ongoing improvements across engineering.

Growth & Development

You’ll work closely with product and technical stakeholders on strategy, and play a direct part in how our engineering organisation grows. The more powerful you become, the better for all of us.

jobs.description:
Grow our AI image service.

The role

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

  1. The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years and we do not screen on your CV, because we decide on what you do in the trial.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video.
  2. A short written step: your internet speed, your computer, and a few questions in your own words.
  3. Aptitude tests, with a published floor.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A short call with the founder.
  6. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

    1. Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.
    2. Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
    3. Strong written English.
    4. Based in Argentina.
    5. You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

1300 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

Reports to: Operations Manager, Airline Division

Location: Remote

Overview

The Intake Specialist, Airline Division, serves as the first point of contact for airline partners and passengers. This role is responsible for delivering responsive, professional, and solution-focused support while ensuring claims are accurately documented, efficiently processed, and resolved in a timely manner. Key priorities include accurately entering and documenting airline claims, reviewing department emails ensuring all messages are actioned, responded to, and claims updated.

Platforms Used

  • Outlook
  • Teams
  • Salesforce
  • Global
  • Talkdesk

Shifts

All times CST, schedule to be confirmed

  • Evenings: 4:00 PM – 12:00 AM
  • Overnights: 12:00 AM – 8:00 AM
  • Weekends: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM / 4:00 PM – 12:00 AM / 12:00 AM – 8:00 AM

Role Requirements

  • Communication: Excellent English, written and verbal
  • Speed and accuracy: Picks things up quickly and captures information accurately
  • Documentation: Keeps clear, thorough records
  • Proactive: Thinks ahead, builds relationships and owns intakes
  • Tech skills: Computer savvy and able to multitask
  • Support type: Inbound and outbound calls, with personal, human-to-human service rather than transactional support
  • Ownership: Manages each case through to resolution, including coordinating across departments

What That Actually Involves

Handle Incoming Calls

  • Answer all airline calls promptly and professionally, while listening to and assisting passengers/airlines, including those who may be upset or frustrated
  • Enter claims into the system while on the phone and gather all necessary information
  • Balance multiple tasks at once, including phone calls, claim entry, emails, and follow-ups
  • Remain calm, patient, and empathetic, even in difficult situations

Process Claims & Documentation

  • Review and document all claim details accurately
  • Ensure all required information is captured and completed
  • Verify and confirm claim notes, updates, and next steps with the passenger/airline

Manage Emails & Follow-Ups

  • Review, respond and action all airline department emails requesting evening assistance
  • Ensure all incoming emails are actioned, responded to and notes are updated in the claims
  • Keep communication clear, timely, and professional

Ensure Accuracy & Accountability

  • Read all notes and ensure accuracy
  • Move reviewed notes into the portal and make them visible
  • Action the claim, if required

Work with the Team & Support Operations

  • Email the next shift when action is required on a claim
  • Provide feedback to the Airline Division Operations Manager when required
  • Attend onsite meetings when requested by the Airline Division Operations Manager

Requirements

What You Will Need

  • Bilingual French or Spanish is an asset.
  • A minimum of three (3) years of customer service experience, preferably in a call center or insurance claims environment.
  • A minimum typing speed of 45 WPM (error rate less than 5%).
  • Strong customer service skills with a commitment to delivering a positive customer experience.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Proven ability to multitask effectively with excellent organizational, prioritization and time management skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accuracy and quality in all work.
  • Effective problem solving and critical thinking skills
  • Ability to remain professional, composed and effective under pressure while working in a fast-paced environment
  • Flexibility to work days, evenings, weekends and/or statutory holidays as needed is required

Who We Are

The Company is North America’s leading mobility enhancement company. We rent, repair and service scooters, wheelchairs, walkers, oxygen, and all other types of personal mobility equipment in over 2,500 locations across North America and recently moved to directly selling mobility equipment through our online store and call center. Since 1997, the Company has been a proven innovator in developing solutions for travelers requiring personal mobility equipment. Today, the Company is the only company in the world uniquely positioned to accommodate a growing demographic utilizing these services worldwide. The Parent Company is the parent company for the Company worldwide.

The Parent Company was founded in 2012 in Japan to build a platform for short-distance mobility. Providing people with access to an innovative and well-designed personal mobility solution that can be used comfortability whenever needed. The company came together to redefine the perception of mobility devices through design and innovation. From personal mobility devices to fleet management and autonomous solutions, the Parent Company is at the forefront of personal Transportation.

Benefits

Additional Information

  • Fun, flexible, team-oriented environment

Position: Recruitment Administrator

Salary: Php 30,000 - Php 35,000/monthly

Working Hours & Conditions: Rotational - AU Working Hours and Holidays

Working Arrangement: Full-Time Remote - Independent Contractor

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

The company is a premier Australian workforce solutions partner operating across critical industry sectors, including Aviation, Supply Chain, Hospitality, Consumer Products, and Retail throughout Australia and New Zealand. Built on a foundation of operational agility and exceptional service delivery, the company connects leading enterprise clients with skilled talent, managing end-to-end recruitment, rapid workforce deployment, and strict regulatory compliance across dynamic, high-volume markets.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

The Recruitment Administrator serves as an operational linchpin in the company's fast-paced labor-hire and staffing ecosystem. Reporting to the recruitment delivery leadership, this role manages dynamic employee rostering, rapid-response shift backfilling, and rigorous workforce compliance for our AU/NZ client accounts. You will act as a primary communications bridge among hiring managers, corporate clients, and frontline contract workers, ensuring shifts are fully covered, documentation is audit-ready, and daily staffing fluctuations are resolved with speed and precision.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Workforce Rostering & Schedule Optimization: Build, update, and actively maintain complex multi-site shift rosters and master schedules, aligning workforce availability directly with client demand forecasts.
  • Rapid-Response Staffing & Incident Coordination: Serve as the frontline responder for incoming shift cancellations, unexpected absences, and urgent replenishment requests, mobilizing backfills quickly to protect service delivery.
  • B2B & Talent Stakeholder Communication: Maintain prompt, professional phone and email communication with client hiring contacts, site managers, and a culturally diverse frontline workforce.
  • Onboarding & Regulatory Compliance Tracking: Coordinate full-cycle documentation for new and existing placements, verifying right-to-work status, industry licenses, medical clearances, and mandatory site inductions.
  • Data Integrity & Administrative Recordkeeping: Maintain structured tracking systems, roster databases, and master Excel workbooks, ensuring zero data discrepancies across personnel and operational logs.
  • Operational Standby & Contingency Coverage: Remain accessible during designated operational windows to troubleshoot live scheduling emergencies, urgent client escalations, and schedule adjustments.

Requirements

  • Recruitment Operations Background: Prior administrative, coordination, or operational experience within a labor-hire agency, high-volume recruitment firm, or dynamic workforce solutions environment.
  • Advanced Office & Data Capabilities: Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly MS Excel (lookups, formulas, data validation, pivot reporting) and recruitment/scheduling database platforms.
  • Business-Level English Fluency: Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills, with the clarity and professional demeanor required to interface with Australian/New Zealand clients and candidates.
  • High-Paced Multitasking: Proven track record of managing competing priorities, high inbound call volumes, and real-time scheduling crises without compromising output quality.
  • Operational Flexibility: Demonstrated willingness to work rotational shifts aligned with AU operating hours and public holidays, including standby availability for urgent coverage needs.
  • Work-from-Home Infrastructure: A dependable, distraction-free home office setup with high-speed, stable internet and backup power solutions suitable for independent contractor engagements.

Preferred

  • Direct experience handling blue-collar, aviation, logistics, retail, or hospitality labor-hire accounts across Australia and New Zealand.
  • Familiarity with AU Fair Work standards, standard enterprise award interpretations, and mandatory labor-hire compliance workflows.

OVERVIEW

We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a FCL Export Ocean Freight Coordinator. Our client is a US-based freight forwarder seeking an experienced ocean freight professional to manage full-container-load export shipments from origin through to destination. This role requires hands-on
experience with FCL exports, US shipping regulations, and carrier coordination.
This is a fully remote position supporting a US client and requires alignment with US Eastern Standard Time (EST) business hours. The successful candidate will work independently, managing multiple active shipments while serving as a direct point of contact for customers, carriers, and

overseas agents.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage FCL export shipments end-to-end, from booking through sailing, discharge, and arrival at destination
  • Obtain ocean freight quotes, confirm bookings with carriers, and manage sailing schedules, ERDs, and shipping cutoffs
  • Arrange container pickups, drayage, and terminal deliveries in coordination with transport providers and exporters
  • Prepare shipping instructions, issue and review House and Master Bills of Lading, and complete AES/EEI export filings
  • Coordinate export licenses and commodity-specific documentation where applicable
  • Track container movements, manage exceptions and delays, and resolve operational issues proactively
  • Communicate shipment updates to US customers and international agents, and process shipment invoicing through the TMS

REQUIREMENTS

  • Matric (Grade 12) as a minimum; a National Diploma or relevant NQF Level 6 qualification in Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field is advantageous
  • Minimum 3 years of ocean freight operations experience at a freight forwarder or NVOCC, with proven hands-on FCL export experience
  • Strong working knowledge of ocean freight documentation, including Bills of Lading, Incoterms, and export compliance requirements
  • Experience using ocean carrier portals such as Maersk, MSC, CMA CGM, or Hapag-Lloyd
  • Proficiency with a freight forwarding or Transportation Management System (TMS)
  • Comfortable communicating professionally and directly with international clients, carriers, and logistics partners in a remote environment

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Prior experience handling US ocean freight exports, including AES/EEI filings and US export regulations
  • Experience coordinating with US-based manufacturers, drayage providers, and port terminals
  • Exposure to ocean freight pricing and rate negotiations with carriers
  • Hazardous cargo experience in line with IMDG regulations

KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Strong communication skills
  • High attention to detail
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Ability to work independently
  • Professionalism and reliability

jobs.description:
Reporting to:VP of Growth

Location:UK or Netherlands, Remote

As Growth Operations Manager, you will drive measurable pipeline impact across all demand channels (Marketing, SDR, and AE). You own the marketing ops tooling stack, dig into the data to find where growth is being left on the table, and bring the right people together to act on it. You balance global consistency with regional agility across all product lines. You combine all of this to drive commercial innovation: testing new motions, tools and plays, and scaling the ones that work.

Core Pillars

  1. Marketing Ops Tooling Stack:Own and optimize the demand gen tech stack (Salesforce, Pardot, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) so data flows cleanly from first touch to qualified pipeline.

  2. Analytics & Opportunity Identification:Analyze funnel, segment and channel data to find what's working, what isn't and why, and turn that into concrete actions.

  3. Stakeholder Alignment:Bring Marketing, SDR, Sales and Enablement together around shared definitions, processes and targets, and keep teams accountable to them.

  4. Commercial Innovation:Combine tooling, insight and alignment to design, test and scale new ways of generating pipeline.

Key Responsibilities in the role

1. Marketing Ops Tooling Stack

  • Own attribution in Salesforce, building models that give a defensible view of marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline.

  • Support the technical setup of Pardot and its integration with Salesforce, including sync, field mapping, lead routing and data flow between the two.

  • Implement and scale prospecting data and automation (Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) for enrichment, signal-based orchestration and personalized outbound.

  • Keep all marketing processes and tools aligned with Salesforce as the global source of truth.

  • Manage vendor renewals and tool utilization to get maximum return on global spend.

2. Analytics & Opportunity Identification

  • Go beyond dashboards: dig into funnel conversion, velocity and drop-off to find root causes, not just symptoms.

  • Find untapped opportunity by segment, region, product line and channel, and size it.

  • Build segmentation models, including territory and coverage analysis, to direct each channel where it will have the most impact.

  • Turn findings into specific, prioritized recommendations with clear owners, and track whether they moved the numbers.

  • Test hypotheses with data before they become plans, and challenge assumptions when the data says otherwise.

3. Stakeholder Alignment

  • Define and maintain global lifecycle models (Lead/Account), with regional variations where needed.

  • Work with SDRs and AEs to improve lead handoff, qualification and self-sourced prospecting workflows.

  • Partner with Enablement to drive onboarding and adoption of demand gen tools and processes.

  • Run a regular operating rhythm with channel owners: agree the metrics, review them, and follow up on commitments.

4. Commercial Innovation

  • Identify and pilot new demand motions, plays and tools (including AI), with clear success criteria.

  • Scale what works across regions and channels, and retire what doesn't.

  • Automate manual steps across the funnel to improve speed and data quality.

Experience & Profile

  • Experience in Marketing or Revenue Operations (global/multi-region experience preferred).

  • Hands-on CRM expert (Salesforce preferred), with experience building attribution and funnel models.

  • Hands-on experience with Pardot or a similar marketing automation platform.

  • Modern stack savvy: experience with Clay or similar enrichment/GTM automation tools, and you enjoy experimenting with new tools and AI.

  • Analytical rigor: you find the "so what" in the data and push it through to action, with pipeline impact ahead of vanity metrics.

  • Diplomacy: able to influence senior stakeholders and bridge regional differences without losing your mind (or our data integrity).

What Success Looks Like

Within 6 months, demand gen processes are measurably better, attribution is trusted across Marketing, Sales and Finance, and your analysis has led to concrete changes in how and where we go to market. Teams move faster thanks to enrichment and automation, and at least one new commercial motion has been piloted and is either scaling or has been stopped based on the evidence.

jobs.description:
Purpose of the Job:

To provide L2 functional support, configuration, continuous improvement and project delivery for SAP EWM across DXC-supported companies. The L2 consultant is the functional owner for assigned EWM processes, with in-depth knowledge of end-to-end warehouse business processes and SAP configuration. The role receives incidents and service requests escalated from L1 support, performs functional analysis and root cause investigation, resolve issues within the application layer, and escalate product defects or issues requiring intervention of SAP L3 when appropriate. The consultant works closely with business users, key users, L1 support, other SAP functional and technical teams, service management, project team and external service providers. The role also supports change requests, implementations, rollouts, upgrades, and migrations and proactively identifies opportunities to improve process efficiency, system utilization, controls and user experience.

Key Accountabilities (duties and responsibilities):

 Provide Level 2 functional support for SAP EWM incidents, service requests and problems

created by business users or L1 support team, ensuring timely resolution in line with agreed

priorities and service levels.

 Own functional investigation and root cause analysis of EWM issues, identify corrective and

preventive actions and escalate confirmed products defects to SAP with complete supporting

evidence.

 Analyze business requirements and translate them into appropriate EWM solutions while

considering standard SAP capabilities, business controls, integration impacts and total cost of

change.

 Configure, test and support EWM processes including inbound, outbound and internal

warehouse processes, warehouse tasks / orders, putaway, picking, replenishment, posting

change, physical inventory, handling units…etc.

 Maintain and configure EWM organizational structure, warehouse process types, storage

types, sections, bins, activity areas, work centers, queues, resources and other relevant

master data / configuration objects.

 Configure and support integrations with SAP ERP ECC/S4HANA and relevant SAP modules

such as MM, SD, PP, QM, and end-to-end process dependencies.

 Configure and support RF/mobile warehouse processes and related technologies, including

SAP RF Framework, ITS Mobile/SAP console where applicable, barcode scanning and RFID-

enabled processes.

 Support and Configure EWM capabilities such as Yarm Management, Labor Management,

Cross-Docking, Post Processing Framework (PPF) and other relevant warehouse functions

where used by businesses.

 Analyze and support interfaces and integration technologies relevant to EWM, including RFC,

ALE/IDoc, web services/APIs and middleware integrations; coordinate with technical

integration teams for issues resolution and enhancement.

Prepare functional specifications for developments, enhancements, forms, reports, interfaces

and conversions; work closely with ABAP and perform functional analysis when required.

 Participate in business workshops, process review, requirement gathering, fit-gap analysis

and document agreed solutions.

 Deliver and support change requests and project requirement through configuration,

functional specification, testing, deployment and post go live support in accordance with DXC

governance.

 Prepare test scenarios and test cases, perform integration and regression testing, support

business on UAT.

 Assess business, technical, integration, security and operational impact of proposed changes

and support quality gates and required approvals before deployment.

 Monitor EWM business processes, interfaces, and background activities, identify recurring

failures, performance issues and improvement opportunities and coordinate corrective

actions with relevant teams.

 Monitor EWM Master Data quality and work with business owners and relevant functional

teams to address data quality issues.

 Provide user guidance and training for new or changed EWM processes and support business

users during critical operational periods and go-lives.

 Support audit, compliance and control requirements by providing requested system

evidence.

 Contribute to SAP EWM S4HANA roadmap activities, upgrades, migrations and new

technology adoption and continuously develop knowledge of relevant SAP capabilities and

warehouse technologies.

 Share knowledge and actively participate in team knowledge management and continuous

improvement activities.

Requirements

5-10 years of experience in SAP EWM (strictly SAP EWM, not SAP EM). Candidates must have strong hands-on SAP EWM (embedded and/or centralized) functional experience, including a minimum of 3-4 full lifecycle implementations.

Technical

 Strong hands-on SAP EWM (embedded and/or centralized) functional experience with

minimum 3 lifecycle implementation.

 Understanding of interfaces and integration technologies such as RFC, ALE/IDoc, web

service/APIs and middleware.

 Knowledge of barcode, RF, RFID and warehouse automation technologies

 Knowledge in the relevant business processes

 ITIL Foundation and SAP Application Lifecycle Management knowledge

 SAP Solution Manager knowledge

 Business and financial awareness of the impact of changes Experience in integration points

with other SAP modules

Interpersonal

 English language (fluent in both written and verbal)

 Strong communication, facilitation and stakeholder management skills

 Ability to communicate technical and process issues clearly to business

 Strong analytical, data gathering and diagnostic ability

 Ability to understand complex system landscapes and assess issues from end-to-end business

process perspective

 Ability to work independently, and with teamwork.

 Attitude and stamina required to deliver in a challenging environment

 Strong knowledge in one or several SAP cross functional technologies

jobs.description:
Our Company

The Electricity Information Sharing and Analysis Center (E-ISAC ) was formed in 1999 in response to Presidential Decision Directive 63. The E-ISAC, in collaboration with the Department of Energy (DOE) and the Electricity Subsector Coordinating Council (ESCC), is designed to serve as the primary security communications channel for the electricity industry. Its vision is to become a world-class, trusted source of quality analysis and rapid sharing of security information for the electricity industry, and its mission is to reduce cyber and physical security risk to the electricity industry across North America by providing unique insights, leadership, and collaboration. By fulfilling the vision and mission, E-ISAC will enhance the industry's ability to prepare for and respond to cyber and physical security threats, vulnerabilities, and incidents.

The E-ISAC is a member-focused organization that interacts with and requires the support of a broad spectrum of stakeholders, including electricity industry asset owners and operators, governmental organizations, industry trade associations, research organizations, and supply chain vendors. Its primary focus is on security issues at the bulk power and local distribution system levels and strengthening cross-sector resilience.

The E-ISAC is operated by NERC and is organizationally isolated from NERC’s enforcement processes.

Our Mission

The vision for the ERO Enterprise, which is comprised of NERC and the six Regional Entities, is a highly reliable and secure North American bulk power system. Our mission is to assure the effective and efficient reduction of risks to the reliability and security of the grid.

Your Impact

The Senior Business Analyst serves as a bridge between E-ISAC business stakeholders and the Data Analytics team, helping translate business needs and operational challenges into clear requirements, actionable analysis, and effective solutions. Working closely with stakeholders, data analysts, project managers and technical partners, the role evaluates business processes, identifies opportunities for improvement, supports the development of metrics and reporting, and helps ensure analytics and technology solutions deliver meaningful business value. The Senior Business Analyst brings strong critical thinking, communication and problem-solving skills to help turn data and business needs into informed decisions and measurable outcomes.

Reports To: Manager – Data Science & Analytics

Your Role

  • Business Analysis & Requirements:Partner with stakeholders to understand strategic objectives, operational challenges and opportunities for improvement. Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business, functional, reporting, and data requirements, translating them into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows and technical specifications.
  • Data Analysis & Insights:Conduct exploratory analysis to assess business performance, identify trends and issues, and support informed decision making. Help define and maintain KPIs, metrics, business rules, and reporting requirements that provide meaningful insight into E-ISAC programs and operations.
  • Process Improvement & Solution Design:Evaluate current-state and future state business processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, effectiveness, automation, and user experience. Support business cases and cost-benefit analyses and assess the potential impact of risks of proposed solutions.
  • Stakeholder Engagement and Collaboration:Serve as a connector among business stakeholders, the Data Analytics team, project managers, and technical partners. Facilitate requirements, discussions, solution demonstrations, stakeholder reviews, and feedback sessions to maintain alignment from initial need through implementation.
  • Solution Delivery & Continuous Improvement:Support prioritization and delivery of analytics and technology solutions, identify data-quality and reporting gaps, monitor implemented solutions, gather stakeholder feedback, and recommend enhancements that increase business value and user adoption.
  • Documentation & Communication:Maintain clear requirements, process documentation, decision logs, and other project artifacts. Communicate analytical findings, recommendations, business impacts, and project updates effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will have at a minimum:

  • Goal oriented with strong critical thinking skills, curiosity, desire to learn, and passion to solve complex issues and problems
  • 7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Data Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, or similar role supporting business and technology initiatives.
  • Bachelor’s degree in system analysis, business, computer science, information systems, or equivalent degree
  • Experience eliciting, documenting, and validating business and functional requirements.
  • Experience facilitating meetings, workshops, and requirements gathering sessions with diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Experience translating business needs into user stories, process flows, technical specifications, and acceptance criteria.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify business process improvement opportunities.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently analyze data using SQL to identify trends, validate requirements, investigate business issues, and support KPI development.
  • Desire and ability to work both independently and collaboratively with teams and to support multiple assignments concurrently.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred candidates will also have:

  • Experience supporting analytics, business intelligence, data science, or data engineering teams.
  • Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and master data management concepts.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure data, AI, and machine learning services, or similar cloud-based analytics platforms.
  • Experience with Artificial Intelligence technologies, including prompt engineering, model training and tuning, and large language models (LLMs).

Other

  • In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.
  • This position has been classified as exempt.
