jobs.title: Domain Delivery Lead - Access & Stay
jobs.excerpt: 📋 Tâches et responsabilités[FR]Environnement de travailDans le cadre d'un programme de transformation numérique, une administration fédérale modernise ses applications métier, renforce la collaboration entre les équipes et fait évoluer son environnement IT vers un modèle plus intégré et plus agile.
jobs.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

[FR]

Environnement de travail

Dans le cadre d'un programme de transformation numérique, une administration fédérale modernise ses applications métier, renforce la collaboration entre les équipes et fait évoluer son environnement IT vers un modèle plus intégré et plus agile.

Pour ce rôle de Domain Delivery Lead, vous coordonnez plusieurs équipes agiles autour d'une vision commune, pilotez la livraison d'applications métier stratégiques et soutenez la montée en autonomie, en expertise et en capacité de delivery.

Le poste s'inscrit dans un contexte de changement important, avec des enjeux de structuration, de collaboration transversale et d'amélioration continue. Vous travaillez avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires et des parties prenantes variées pour transformer une vision ambitieuse en résultats concrets.

Description des tâches

Au sein du programme, vous intervenez comme chef de projet et Domain Lead. Vous guidez les équipes par l'influence, la clarté de la vision et la confiance, afin de leur permettre de livrer de la valeur au métier.

  • Fédérer plusieurs équipes agiles autour d'objectifs communs et garantir l'alignement entre les priorités métier et celles des équipes.
  • Mettre en place un cadre clair qui favorise l'autonomie, tout en accompagnant la montée en maturité des squads selon les principes du servant leadership.
  • Construire la planification globale avec les équipes, coordonner les dépendances et arbitrer les priorités de manière transparente.
  • Animer les rituels inter-équipes, les revues et les rétrospectives, et encourager le partage des bonnes pratiques.
  • Identifier les obstacles à la delivery et faciliter la collaboration avec les autres équipes, les interlocuteurs métier et l'IT.
  • Accompagner les collaborateurs, encourager le feedback et entretenir une culture de confiance, de transparence et d'amélioration continue.
  • Gérer les demandes de changement en concertation avec les parties prenantes.
  • Assurer un reporting régulier sur l'avancement, avec une vision claire des risques, des difficultés et des arbitrages nécessaires.
  • Escalader à temps les changements ou incidents majeurs qui dépassent les seuils de tolérance définis.
  • Assurer le suivi des fournisseurs en les impliquant comme partenaires de delivery.
  • Prendre en charge le suivi budgétaire et la gestion de capacité.

📝 Votre profil

[FR]

Compétences clés

  • Capacité à traduire des concepts IT complexes en messages clairs et compréhensibles pour le métier.
  • Aptitude à transformer une vision stratégique et des besoins métier en roadmap opérationnelle et en priorités de delivery.
  • Leadership de type servant leadership, avec une forte capacité à guider les équipes sans recourir à l'autorité hiérarchique.
  • Excellente maîtrise du stakeholder management dans un environnement public complexe, avec des intérêts parfois divergents.
  • Bonne connaissance des pratiques de gouvernance IT et de leur application dans des environnements de delivery structurés.

Expérience requise

  • Expérience solide dans une fonction de liaison entre le business et l'IT, par exemple comme Product Owner senior, Business Relationship Manager ou responsable de programme.
  • Expérience confirmée dans la coordination de grandes équipes multidisciplinaires réparties en plusieurs squads ou équipes autonomes.
  • Pratique avérée de la gestion budgétaire, de la capacité et de l'allocation des ressources dans un cadre public.
  • Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans une fonction similaire, avec pilotage de plusieurs équipes et gestion de parties prenantes complexes dans des projets de digitalisation.
  • Maîtrise des approches agiles et itératives appliquées aux projets IT, ainsi que du leadership d'équipes projet.
  • Bonne connaissance des méthodologies de gestion de projet, de la gouvernance et des pratiques de delivery.
  • Expérience significative dans des projets IT de grande envergure comportant des dépendances transversales.
  • Expérience en optimisation et réingénierie des processus métier.
  • Compréhension des enjeux de change management dans les transformations organisationnelles et digitales.
  • Connaissance de la gestion du cycle de vie applicatif, de la maintenance et de l'évolution des applications.

Compétences et aptitudes

  • Structurer, planifier et prioriser les activités selon les objectifs stratégiques, les besoins métier et la capacité de delivery.
  • Analyser les risques, les dépendances et les pistes d'amélioration avec rigueur et recul.
  • Coordonner efficacement plusieurs équipes et favoriser une collaboration fluide entre IT, métier et partenaires externes.

Qualités humaines et leadership

  • Influencer et mobiliser sans autorité hiérarchique directe.
  • Adapter sa communication à des interlocuteurs variés, y compris les équipes, la direction et les fournisseurs.
  • Créer un climat de confiance et de sécurité psychologique propice à l'expression et au progrès.
  • Gérer les tensions avec diplomatie et négocier des solutions équilibrées.
  • Adopter une posture de facilitateur et de coach auprès des équipes.
  • Rester résilient, orienté solution et ouvert à l'apprentissage continu.
  • Faire preuve d'intégrité et de transparence dans le pilotage du domaine.

Langues

  • Vous êtes néerlandophone ou francophone, avec une bonne connaissance de l'anglais.

[NL]

Werkomgeving

Binnen een programma voor digitale transformatie moderniseert een federale overheidsomgeving haar bedrijfstoepassingen, versterkt ze de samenwerking tussen teams en bouwt ze verder aan een meer geïntegreerde en agile IT-werking.

Als Domain Delivery Lead brengt u meerdere agile teams samen rond een gedeelde visie, stuurt u de oplevering van strategische bedrijfstoepassingen aan en ondersteunt u de verdere groei in autonomie, expertise en leveringscapaciteit.

De functie situeert zich in een context van ingrijpende verandering, met aandacht voor structuur, samenwerking over teams heen en continue verbetering. U werkt met multidisciplinaire teams en diverse stakeholders om ambities te vertalen naar tastbare resultaten.

Taakomschrijving

Binnen het programma neemt u de rol op van projectleider en Domain Lead. U stuurt via invloed, heldere richting en vertrouwen, zodat teams maximaal waarde kunnen leveren aan de business.

  • Meerdere agile teams verenigen rond gemeenschappelijke doelstellingen en de afstemming bewaken tussen businessprioriteiten en teamprioriteiten.
  • Een duidelijk kader creëren dat autonomie ondersteunt, en squads begeleiden in hun groei naar meer maturiteit volgens de principes van servant leadership.
  • Samen met de teams de globale planning uitwerken, afhankelijkheden coördineren en prioriteiten transparant afwegen.
  • Interteam-rituelen, reviews en retrospectieven faciliteren en kennisdeling tussen teams stimuleren.
  • Belemmeringen voor de delivery detecteren en samenwerking met andere teams, business en IT vlotter maken.
  • Mensen coachen, feedbackcultuur versterken en een omgeving van vertrouwen, transparantie en continue verbetering bevorderen.
  • Wijzigingsaanvragen beheren in overleg met stakeholders.
  • Regelmatig rapporteren over de voortgang, inclusief risico's, knelpunten en nodige beslissingen.
  • Belangrijke wijzigingen of problemen tijdig escaleren wanneer tolerantiedrempels worden overschreden.
  • Leveranciers opvolgen en hen betrekken als volwaardige deliverypartners.
  • Budgetopvolging en capaciteitsbeheer opnemen.

📝 Jouw profiel

[NL]

Kerncompetenties

  • Complexe IT-concepten helder kunnen vertalen naar begrijpelijke businesstaal.
  • Een strategische visie en businessbehoeften kunnen omzetten in een operationele roadmap en duidelijke deliveryprioriteiten.
  • Sterk servant leadership, met het vermogen om teams te begeleiden zonder formele hiërarchische sturing.
  • Uitstekende ervaring in stakeholdermanagement binnen een complexe publieke context, met uiteenlopende belangen.
  • Goede kennis van IT-governancekaders en hun toepassing binnen gestructureerde deliveryomgevingen.

Vereiste ervaring

  • Stevige ervaring in een brugfunctie tussen business en IT, zoals senior Product Owner, Business Relationship Manager of programmadirecteur.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het aansturen van grote multidisciplinaire teams, verdeeld over meerdere autonome teams of squads.
  • Ervaring met budgetbeheer, capaciteitsplanning en resourceallocatie binnen een publieke context.
  • Minstens 10 jaar ervaring in een gelijkaardige functie, met coördinatie van meerdere teams en complex stakeholdermanagement in digitaliseringsprojecten.
  • Grondige beheersing van agile en iteratieve werkmethoden binnen IT-projecten, evenals van projectteamleiderschap.
  • Degelijke kennis van projectmanagementmethodologieën, governance en deliverypraktijken.
  • Aanzienlijke ervaring met grootschalige IT-projecten met transversale afhankelijkheden.
  • Ervaring in procesoptimalisatie en business process reengineering.
  • Inzicht in change management binnen organisatorische en digitale transformaties.
  • Kennis van applicatiebeheer, inclusief lifecycle, onderhoud en evolutie van toepassingen.

Competenties en vaardigheden

  • Activiteiten kunnen structureren, plannen en prioriteren op basis van strategische doelstellingen, businessnoden en deliverycapaciteit.
  • Risico's, afhankelijkheden en verbeterkansen scherp kunnen analyseren.
  • Meerdere teams efficiënt coördineren en samenwerking tussen IT, business en externe partners versterken.

Menselijke kwaliteiten en leiderschap

  • Kunnen beïnvloeden en mobiliseren zonder directe hiërarchische macht.
  • Communicatie aanpassen aan verschillende gesprekspartners, waaronder teams, directie en leveranciers.
  • Een klimaat van vertrouwen en psychologische veiligheid creëren.
  • Spanningen diplomatisch aanpakken en werkbare oplossingen onderhandelen.
  • Een faciliterende en coachende rol opnemen naar teams toe.
  • Onder druk rustig en oplossingsgericht blijven, met openheid voor bijsturing en leren.
  • Handelen met integriteit en transparantie.

Talen

  • U bent Nederlandstalig of Franstalig, met een goede kennis van het Engels.

Technische beschrijving

  • Agile: 5 jaar
  • Projectervaring met complex stakeholdermanagement in een digitaliseringsproject: 10 jaar
  • Leiderschap van projectteams: 10 jaar

Start: zo snel mogelijk, na afloop van de selectieprocedure.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

(Freelance est également possible)

Overview

LMI is seeking a Cyber Security Engineer to own and coordinate cybersecurity compliance for an AWS-hosted Army application. This role manages vulnerability findings, security scanning, eMASS records, and RMF/ATO activities while working closely with the ISSO and engineering team. The position requires technical security knowledge and the ability to drive remediation through closure.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Own the cyber compliance backlog, priorities, reporting, and coordination with the ISSO and government security stakeholders.
  • Coordinate security scans, including ACAS, application, dependency, and container scanning; review results and validate findings.
  • Triage CVEs and other vulnerabilities, assess applicability and risk, assign remediation owners, track due dates, and verify closure through rescanning or technical evidence.
  • Maintain eMASS records, RMF artifacts, control evidence, POA&Ms, and continuous monitoring documentation to support ATO attainment and sustainment.
  • Coordinate control evidence, inherited controls, assessment responses, and compliance milestones with the ISSO, engineering team, and platform or image owners.

  • Active Secret security clearance.

  • Experience coordinating vulnerability scanning, CVE remediation, and compliance activities with an ISSO and technical teams.
  • Technical understanding of Linux, AWS security, containers, and vulnerability assessment tools.

Occasional travel for technical coordination, security assessments, and program milestones.

The Digital Core Reinvention practice builds industry super-ontologies: industry- and ecosystem-specific agentic AI and data engines that encode how a vertical actually operates — its entities, its regulations, its rhythms — so AI systems can reason inside the industry rather than about it.

At the Senior Manager grade you hold authority across engagements in the vertical. We assess that fit at interview, not at requisition.

Company Overview
Our client is a fast-growing, venture-backed SaaS company helping frontline workers access life-changing benefits like childcare, elder care, and nutrition assistance. Their AI-powered platform connects employees to available government programs—cutting through complexity and delivering support where it matters most.

Used by major retailers, healthcare providers, and Fortune 500 companies, the product is trusted to handle sensitive workflows in regulated environments. The fully remote team is mission-driven, pragmatic, and growing quickly, with strong enterprise backing and a clear expansion path.

Your Role

As a Product Manager, you’ll help shape the future of their platform, guiding cross-functional teams across engineering, design, and operations. You’ll own the lifecycle of key features — from discovery to delivery — ensuring their solutions are not only innovative and scalable but also accessible, secure, and compliant with HIPAA and SOC 2 standards.

This is a highly collaborative role that blends product strategy, technical fluency, and user advocacy, supporting initiatives across B2B SaaS domains, white-label experiences, integrations with HRIS/payroll systems, and AI-driven automation features.

You’ll:

  • Product Strategy & Discovery

    - Collaborate with leadership, customers, and partners to refine product vision and strategy across our multi-tenant SaaS platform.

    - Translate high-level business goals into actionable roadmaps that deliver measurable impact.

  • Execution & Delivery

    - Lead the end-to-end software development lifecycle, working closely with engineers, designers, and QA to deliver high-quality features.
    - Break down complex workflows (e.g., eligibility screening, income and employment verification, PDF pre-fill, automated workflows) into clear, prioritized backlogs.
    - Use agile best practices (scrum, kanban) to run sprints, stand-ups, retrospectives, and demos.

  • Stakeholder Communication

    - Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.
    - Clearly communicate priorities, trade-offs, and timelines, balancing customer needs with technical feasibility and compliance requirements.

  • Continuous Improvement

    - Monitor feature performance and user behavior to inform iteration and optimization.
    - Collaborate with data and engineering teams to integrate insights from analytics and monitoring platforms (e.g., Datadog, Segment, QuickSight).
    - Stay informed on industry trends in SaaS, benefits technology, and regulatory environments to guide innovation.

You Bring:

  • 4+ years of experience in product management for SaaS platforms or B2B/B2C applications, including experience building or managing AI-powered or AI-integrated products.

  • Experience delivering AI/GenAI features end-to-end, including products leveraging LLMs, document processing, intelligent automation, or conversational interfaces.

  • Working knowledge of LLM capabilities and tradeoffs (accuracy, latency, cost, reliability), and experience defining requirements, evaluation metrics, and iteration strategies for AI-driven features.

  • Experience collaborating closely with engineering and data teams to integrate model APIs and AI services into production systems.

  • Strong collaboration skills with engineering, design, and operations teams; ability to lead discussions across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience with agile/lean product development processes.

  • Familiarity with cloud-native architectures (AWS), APIs, and data integrations (HRIS, payroll, third-party APIs), and automation workflows.

  • Excellent organizational, communication, and time management skills.

  • Experience in early-stage growth startup environments is preferred.

  • Background in engineering, computer science, data science, machine learning, or analytics is a strong bonus.

What’s Offered

  • Fully remote, async-friendly work with flexible hours

  • Competitive hourly USD rate, flexible based on experience and fit

  • A focused, collaborative team that values speed, clarity, and mission impact

  • Growth potential in a fast-scaling SaaS company with a strong emphasis on innovation, security, and customer success.

  • Opportunity to work at the intersection of technology and social impact, building tools that improve access to critical benefits.

Director, Business Development

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
    • We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.

Job Responsibilities

Director of Business Development

The Director of Business Development is responsible for driving sales growth across an assigned geographic territory. This role blends strategic account farming with targeted hunting activities—balancing proactive expansion of existing accounts with the pursuit of new opportunities. By developing tailored engagement plans, building trusted relationships, and orchestrating multi-functional solution development, the Director of BD drives both immediate impact and develops long-term value. Leveraging data-driven insights, this leader prioritizes time and resources to maximize territory performance and elevate Syneos Health’s presence within the biopharmaceutical industry.

Responsibilities

·Develops and executes a comprehensive sales strategy for a defined book of business and geographic territory, balancing new client acquisition with growth of existing accounts.

·Manages an optimized territory through data-informed prioritization of time, client opportunity, and market potential.

·Identifies, engages, and nurtures key client relationships with decision-makers, influencers, and stakeholders at all levels.

·Leads the orchestration of tailored, multi-touchpoint sales strategies based on client needs, pipeline dynamics, and strategic goals.

·Drives expansion playbooks, including therapeutically aligned strategies, renewal opportunities and next-phase conversions, to deepen account value.

·Collaborates closely with cross-functional teams—including operations, therapeutic strategy, deal strategy, and delivery —to co-develop solutions that address client-specific challenges.

·Acts as a client champion internally by sharing insights on client culture, preferences, and strategic priorities to enable effective team alignment and proposal development.

·Stays current on industry trends, competitor developments, and emerging client needs to continuously refine engagement strategies.

·Represents Syneos Health at client meetings, industry conferences, and other relevant events to build brand presence and uncover new opportunities.

Requirements

·Related experience including business development experience within the industry with preferrable experience in the Clinical Trials industry.

·Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or biopharma in a business development, commercial, or strategic sales role.

·Proven success managing complex B2B sales cycles and navigating mid- to executive-level client relationships.

·Strong consultative selling skills with a demonstrated ability to uncover client needs and co-create impactful solutions.

·Excellent interpersonal, influencing, and negotiation abilities with a collaborative leadership style.

·Highly organized with the ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

·Data-driven decision maker with strong business acumen and strategic thinking capability.

·Proficient in Salesforce or similar CRM platforms; Microsoft Office Suite experience required.

·Ability to travel up to 40% for client meetings, conferences, and internal events.

At  Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position may include a company car or car allowance, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, eligibility to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and individual performance, and flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Syneos complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Standard Job Description

WHAT WE'RE DOING

Join the Kingdom of Saudia Arabia (KSA) Command, Control, Communications, Computers, and Intelligence (C4I) Modernization Team and be a critical contributor on the first-phase design team helping to shape the project’s overarching modernization initiatives.

The team’s primary focus during the design stage is to shape the functional architecture and system capabilities that will rapidly modernize the customer’s product line. Day-to-day activities will include (but are not limited to) requirements governance, architecture definition, system documentation, CONOPs development, and integration guidance/planning. This is an opportunity to help design and develop the updated baseline while working directly with an international customer.

THE WORK

The KSA C4I Team is seeking a systems engineer to join our development team. In this role, you will:

  • Decompose customer requirements and use cases into system capabilities and functions
  • Perform requirements tracing to ensure that the necessary system and subsystems are developed in accordance with customer requirements/expectations
  • Create/refine MBSE models depicting system architecture and system activity/sequence diagrams
  • Help contribute to various SE CDRL documents, including (but not limited to): SEMP, ICD, SDD’s, TEMP
  • Help refine and develop overall system CONOPs to ensure planned modernization capabilities continue to meet the overall mission needs

PLEASE NOTE

  • This position may require travel to customer sites throughout the KSA.
  • This position may occasionally support off-hours test events, including overnight and weekend activities.

WHO WE ARE

The KSA C4I Modernization Team is a geographically dispersed project team that will operate in an Agile Scrum environment. Team members have the opportunity to work directly with an international customer and gain exposure to the technologies and processes supporting this upgrade.

Come be a part of a rapidly developing, fast-paced project team that is empowered to quickly develop and iterate potential design upgrades, with a condensed feedback loop that allows for quick iterations on proposed updates. This customer environment is a unique experience for an engineer to put their stamp on drafting new system functionality with a very engaged customer in an accelerated design cycle. If the thought rapidly performing various design activities and growing your knowledge on the numerous types of systems engineering artifacts that are developed and delivered as part of design stage of a modernization upgrade project is exciting, then the KSA C4I Team is the place to be!

This team/position is contingent upon contract award.

jobs.title: Network Engineer (Journeyman)
jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks four Journeyman Network Engineers to support data-center networking, software-defined networking, enterprise connectivity, infrastructure modernization, and outage restoration for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks four Journeyman Network Engineers to support data-center networking, software-defined networking, enterprise connectivity, infrastructure modernization, and outage restoration for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

The Network Engineers will provide hands-on technical support for Cisco Nexus and Application Centric Infrastructure environments, software-defined networking, top-of-rack switching, and data-center connectivity. These positions will support network installations, technology refreshes, maintenance activities, service outages, and equipment-relocation cutovers.

The Network Engineers will work with senior network engineers, network leadership, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity personnel, Government stakeholders, vendors, and the Outage Response Team to maintain secure, reliable, and resilient network services.

These positions are remote. Travel or on-site support may be required for installations, site surveys, equipment refreshes, outages, or relocation cutovers. Work outside normal business hours may also be required during maintenance windows or mission-critical events.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Network Engineer will:

  • Configure, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot Cisco Nexus data-center switching environments.
  • Support Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure fabrics and approved policy-based network configurations.
  • Assist with configuration and maintenance of Application Policy Infrastructure Controllers, tenants, virtual routing and forwarding instances, bridge domains, endpoint groups, contracts, and external connectivity.
  • Support software-defined networking configurations across data-center network infrastructure.
  • Install, configure, maintain, refresh, and troubleshoot top-of-rack switches, data-center switches, network appliances, and related connectivity.
  • Support physical and logical connectivity among servers, storage platforms, virtualization environments, appliances, cloud services, and enterprise networks.
  • Configure and troubleshoot VLANs, trunks, port channels, virtual port channels, routing, access controls, and redundant network paths.
  • Support network architecture, integration, implementation, testing, troubleshooting, and performance-analysis activities.
  • Gather and document technical requirements for network installations, data-center connectivity, equipment refreshes, and relocation activities.
  • Assist with development of implementation procedures, migration plans, cutover plans, validation steps, rollback procedures, and outage contingencies.
  • Execute approved network installations, configuration changes, equipment refreshes, and hardware replacements.
  • Support relocation cutovers involving network equipment and associated infrastructure at USMEPCOM and MEPS locations.
  • Perform equipment staging, configuration validation, connectivity testing, implementation, and post-cutover verification.
  • Coordinate with cabling personnel on rack layouts, patching, fiber, copper cabling, network drops, and equipment interconnections.
  • Support site surveys and update physical and logical network diagrams, rack layouts, as-built documentation, and equipment inventories.
  • Test network devices and configurations before installation in production environments.
  • Apply approved firmware, operating-system, vendor, security, and configuration updates to network devices.
  • Configure network devices in accordance with applicable security requirements and DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides.
  • Monitor network availability, utilization, performance, capacity, faults, interfaces, and data-center connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot Layer 2, Layer 3, fabric, switching, routing, latency, packet-loss, and connectivity issues.
  • Support WAN, LAN, circuit, SD-WAN, firewall, VPN, wireless, and cloud-connectivity troubleshooting when issues affect data-center services.
  • Participate in Outage Response Team activities involving network degradation or service outages.
  • Support technical diagnosis, restoration, workarounds, corrective actions, and root-cause analysis.
  • Coordinate technical escalation with senior network engineers, Cisco, DISA, telecommunications providers, equipment vendors, and other external support organizations.
  • Support remote MEPS and other locations with router, circuit, firewall, VPN, ISP, cloud-service, and network-connectivity issues.
  • Follow approved incident, change, configuration, release, and service-transition processes.
  • Maintain network configurations, implementation records, change documentation, test results, troubleshooting procedures, and technical knowledge articles.
  • Identify recurring network issues, performance constraints, configuration problems, and potential points of failure.
  • Escalate complex technical issues, operational risks, and proposed network changes to senior engineering personnel.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Networking, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Between 3 and 7 years of relevant network engineering, network administration, data-center networking, or enterprise infrastructure experience.
  • Current Cisco Certified Network Professional certification.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience supporting Cisco Nexus switches and Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting ACI tenants, VRFs, bridge domains, endpoint groups, contracts, Application Policy Infrastructure Controllers, and external network connectivity.
  • Experience with software-defined networking and policy-based data-center network architectures.
  • Experience configuring top-of-rack switches, virtual port channels, port channels, VLANs, trunks, routing, and redundant network paths.
  • Experience supporting data-center connectivity among compute, storage, virtualization, cloud, security, and network platforms.
  • Experience supporting network installations, hardware refreshes, migrations, maintenance activities, and relocation cutovers.
  • Experience executing method-of-procedure documents, implementation plans, test plans, rollback procedures, and cutover checklists.
  • Experience supporting network-related outages, service restoration, vendor escalation, and root-cause analysis.
  • Knowledge of Cisco routing and switching technologies, including EIGRP, OSPF, BGP, VLAN routing, and Quality of Service.
  • Experience supporting WAN, LAN, SD-WAN, circuits, firewalls, VPNs, wireless infrastructure, load balancers, and cloud connectivity.

jobs.title: Compliance Administrator
jobs.excerpt: Stay Organized.  Keep Compliance Moving. Compliance has a lot of moving pieces.
jobs.description:
Stay Organized. Keep Compliance Moving.

Compliance has a lot of moving pieces.

Sometimes it's coordinating a vendor review.

Sometimes it's researching a regulatory question.

Sometimes another department needs help understanding what a requirement means for them.

As our Compliance Administrator, you'll help connect those pieces. You'll research compliance issues, coordinate vendor management and business continuity activities, maintain important systems and documentation, and help teams across the credit union navigate regulatory requirements.

Some people track the details. Others dig deeper to understand what those details mean.

What You'll Be Supporting

This role includes the coordination and administrative responsibilities you'd expect in compliance, but your impact goes beyond those responsibilities. You'll:

  • Coordinate vendor due diligence reviews and risk assessments, working directly with decision makers across the credit union.

  • Support business continuity through department reviews, annual testing, training, meetings, and documentation.

  • Review disclosures and agreements, research potential compliance issues, and help determine how regulations apply.

  • Turn regulatory information into clear, useful guidance for departments across the organization.

  • Maintain compliance, vendor management, and business continuity systems, records, policies, procedures, and user access.

  • Track audit and exam responses and supporting documentation to make sure information is accurate, current, and complete.

Why This Role Matters

This role gives you the opportunity to:

✅ Build deeper knowledge of credit union compliance
✅ Research and work through real regulatory questions
✅ Partner with leaders and teams across the credit union
✅ Support vendor management and business continuity
✅ Grow into managing key responsibilities independently

You won't be doing the same thing every day. You could be reviewing a disclosure, researching a compliance question, coordinating with a vendor decision maker, preparing for business continuity testing, or making sure documentation is ready when it's needed.

That variety is what makes this role matter.

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

You like to read, research, ask questions, and understand the why behind a requirement, not just check a box.

You bring 3-5 years of financial institution experience and a broad understanding of credit union compliance and regulatory requirements. You're organized, comfortable working independently, and able to communicate professionally with people at different levels of the organization.

Most importantly, you have the judgment to work through a problem, make decisions within your scope, and know when you need to bring someone else into the conversation.

Details Have an Impact

A vendor review completed thoroughly. A disclosure reviewed carefully. A regulatory question researched before it becomes a bigger issue.

Those things may happen behind the scenes, but they help the credit union stay prepared and make informed decisions.

The answers aren't always obvious. That's why curiosity, sound judgment, and follow-through matter.

Ready to dig into the details, solve problems, and help keep compliance moving? We'd love to talk.

We’re looking for a Junior Data Scientist to join our tech team and help build the future of neuro-contextual advertising at global scale.

Who We Are

At Seedtag, our mission is to transform advertising by proving that effectiveness and user privacy can truly coexist.

As the leading Neuro-Contextual Advertising Company, we combine Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and neuroscience to understand not only what content is about, but how it makes people feel and what they intend to do next.

Founded in 2014 by two ex-Googlers, Seedtag has grown to 500+ Seedtaggers in 17 countries, backed by €250M in funding, and operates today as a global ad-tech leader.

If you enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and building AI-driven systems at scale, you’ll feel right at home here.

Your Challenge

As our Junior Data Scientist, you will join our Insights team to transform contextual, audience, and campaign data into actionable insights for clients and commercial teams, leveraging Liz, Seedtag's AI.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Data Pipelines & Analytics: Build and maintain pipelines to analyse campaign performance, audience behaviour, and contextual data across the open web and CTV.

  • Data Products: Turn analyses into scalable data products using tools such as dbt, Trino, and Airflow, ensuring data quality and reliability.

  • AI Agents & Automation: Prototype LLM-based agents and workflows using techniques such as embeddings, classification, clustering, and summarisation.

  • Experimentation & Evaluation: Design and evaluate experiments to ensure automated insights are accurate, reliable, and actionable.

  • Data Quality & Troubleshooting: Investigate data anomalies, identify root causes, and improve pipeline reliability.

  • Data Storytelling: Communicate findings through clear visualisations and actionable recommendations for Product, Sales, and clients.

Our Core Values

Outcome over Output
We measure success by impact and value, not by volume of features or lines of code.

Failure Is Allowed, Learning Is a Must
Experimentation is key to innovation. We test early, iterate often, and learn fast.

We Are All Scouts
We take ownership and leave things better than we found them.

We Are Data-Driven
Data informs our decisions and helps us continuously improve our systems and results.

Tech Stack

You'll work with modern data and AI technologies to build scalable insights products.

Our stack includes:

  • Languages & Libraries: Python, SQL, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn.

  • Data Engineering: dbt, Trino, Airflow.

  • AI & Machine Learning: LLMs, AI agents, embeddings, classification, clustering, NLP.

  • Agent Frameworks: LangGraph, PydanticAI, MCP, OpenAI and Claude Agent SDKs.

  • Cloud & Data Platforms: GCP, BigQuery.

  • Development Tools: Git, unit testing, code review.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 0–2 years of experience in Data Science, Analytics, or Machine Learning, including internships, research, or personal projects.

  • Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Strong Python and SQL skills, with a solid understanding of statistics, machine learning, and model evaluation.

  • Hands-on experience building LLM-based agents or agentic workflows, including tool calling, structured outputs, or multi-step processes.

  • Good software engineering practices, including Git, testing, and clean, reproducible code.

  • Strong analytical thinking and data storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Curious, proactive, and eager to learn, with professional working proficiency in English.

Why Join Seedtag?

  • A key moment of growth with real ownership and global impact.

  • Flexible work model with 100% remote or hybrid options.
    (Remote contracts available in Spain, Italy, UK, Belgium, Netherlands, France, and Germany.)

  • Continuous learning through a learning platform and optional language classes.

  • A supportive, trust-based culture that values well-being.

  • Team activities, offsites, and opportunities to connect beyond work.

Additional Perks

  • Home office setup budget up to €1,000

  • Paid trips to our HQ in Madrid

  • MacBook Pro M3

Ready to Join the Seedtag Adventure?

At Seedtag, we create an environment where everyone can thrive. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, let us know and we’ll ensure a positive experience.

Send us your CV and let’s build the future of neuro-contextual advertising together.

jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Global Benefits & Compensation Lead owns the benefits GoGlobal provides to the people it employs on behalf of clients, worldwide — and the competitive compensation data behind our offers. Sitting within the HR Services (HRS) product line and reporting to the Global Product Owner, HRS, you make sure that in every country we operate, our employees receive benefits that are competitive, compliant and cost-effective, and that renew on time with no gaps in cover.

This is a hands-on, build-and-run role. You research and source benefits market by market, select and negotiate with brokers, insurers and providers, and run the renewal and renegotiation calendar so cover never lapses and pricing stays sharp. You set the global benefits standards and catalogue, keep every programme compliant with local statutory requirements, and give Revenue and our country teams the competitive compensation and benefits data they need to win and retain business.

You will be based in one of our Regional Delivery Centres — Malaysia, Romania or Colombia — operating as a global function for the HRS product.

Roles & Responsibilities

Benefits sourcing & market research

· Research and benchmark statutory and supplementary benefits — medical/health, life, disability, retirement/pension, leave, wellness and allowances — across the countries we operate in.

· Build and maintain a global benefits catalogue: what we offer, where, at what level and at what cost, aligned to local norms and GoGlobal standards.

· Source competitive, compliant benefit options for new and existing markets, balancing employee experience with cost-to-serve.

Vendor sourcing, negotiation & management

· Select, appoint and manage brokers, insurers and benefits providers in each market; run RFPs where scale or cost justify it.

· Negotiate pricing, terms and service levels, and consolidate vendors where it strengthens cover or reduces cost.

· Own the vendor relationship end to end — performance, escalations and coverage continuity.

Renewals, renegotiation & the benefits calendar

· Own the global renewal and renegotiation calendar; ensure every policy renews on time, compliantly, and with no gap in cover.

· Lead renewals and renegotiations ahead of expiry, challenging premium increases with data and market benchmarks.

· Track policy terms, anniversaries and claims experience to inform each renewal.

Compliance & governance

· Ensure every benefit programme meets local statutory and regulatory requirements in each jurisdiction it serves.

· Keep enrolments, documentation and provider contracts audit-ready; partner with Legal and Compliance on jurisdiction-specific obligations.

· Maintain data protection and confidentiality across all employee and vendor data.

Compensation benchmarking & total reward

· Maintain competitive compensation and total-reward benchmarks to support EoR offers, pricing and retention.

· Advise Revenue, Sales and country teams on market-competitive packages, and act as the benefits subject-matter expert in client and prospect conversations.

· Model the cost of benefit and reward options and their impact on cost-to-serve.

Cost, data & continuous improvement

· Own the benefits cost base; drive efficiency and value through sourcing, consolidation and renegotiation.

· Standardise and, where possible, automate benefits administration and renewals in partnership with Digital Operations.

· Report on coverage, cost, renewals and compliance, and improve the operating model over time.

Key Performance Indicators

· Renewals completed on time, with no lapse in cover.

· Benefits cost-to-serve, and savings achieved through sourcing and renegotiation.

· Coverage and compliance — zero material compliance breaches.

· Competitiveness of benefits and packages (benchmark position), and employee / client satisfaction.

· Vendor performance and coverage continuity.

· Speed and quality of benefits support to Revenue and country teams.

Requirements

Must have

· 6+ years in benefits and/or compensation, including global or multi-country benefits management.

· Hands-on experience sourcing benefits and negotiating with brokers, insurers and providers, and owning renewals and renegotiations.

· Strong working knowledge of statutory and supplementary benefits and local compliance requirements across multiple jurisdictions.

· Commercial and analytical: comfortable with benchmarking, cost modelling and vendor negotiation.

· Organised and deadline-driven, able to run a global renewal calendar without gaps.

· Fluent English, and able to work across time zones from a Regional Delivery Centre (Malaysia, Romania or Colombia).

Nice to have

· Experience in an EoR, PEO, global payroll or global business-services environment.

· A relevant certification — e.g. GRP or CCP (WorldatWork), CEBS or CBP (IFEBP), or GPHR / SHRM.

· Familiarity with global benefits brokers (Mercer, Aon, WTW, Lockton or regional equivalents) and benefits-administration / HRIS platforms.

· Comfort with AI-assisted tools and automation to scale benefits administration.

Benefits

As a privately owned company, we are free from the pressures of venture capital or private equity investors demanding exponential growth in unreasonable time frames.

Sometimes, things just take time to do well. In our business, delivering great results is a process - and we're committed to doing it right.

We are not for sale. We believe that financial success is a natural outcome of our work, not the primary goal. Unlike many investors who view money as a goal, our focus is on long-term growth and sustainable success.

We are a global team, built for those who want to go further. Here's what your career at GoGlobal looks like:

A company small enough for your voice to be heard meaningfully, yet large enough to make a global impact

Collaborating with a diverse, global and supportive team

Built for the long-haul - no VC or PE pressure, just a focus on sustainable growth

WHY WE ARE DIFFERENT

We Make Growing Your Career Possible

    • We prioritize organic and sustainable growth. Expanding operations quickly by way of mergers and acquisitions might seem appealing, but the reality is integrating diverse cultures can be challenging. We're proud of our own culture and prefer to grow it our way.
    • We're global. We offer career opportunities across the world-whether it's new job roles or international locations
    • English is our official language, but for many, it's our second language. We embrace this and find it rewarding communicating with colleagues from all over the world.
    • We are not a family. We operate more like a high-performing sports team where each individual's contribution is crucial to our collective success.

Unlike big, siloed companies, we work seamlessly to handle international deals without the headaches of territorial ownership.
    • We believe in transparency and trust. Every month, we share our financials with the team so everyone knows where we stand and what's coming next. It's all about open communication, building trust and empowering every individual to be part of our journey. We don't tell you what to think - we provide the information you need to make your own informed decisions.
    • We believe flexibility drives success. Our company is built on trust, and that's why we embrace fully remote work, and hybrid options in some countries. Forget rigid office routines - it's old school! This flexibility fuels productivity, strengthens our workforce, and ensures we remain agile in a fast-changing world.

jobs.description:
A bit about the role and what you’ll deliver...

Trustonic’s SaaS platform helps businesses across the globe make smartphones affordable for the many, enabling global access to devices and digital finance through the world’s most secure smartphone locking technology. As we grow, we’re looking for an SVP, Customer Operations to join our Executive Team and lead the technical side of every customer relationship, from the first conversation to long-term partnership.

You’ll report to our CEO and sit alongside our CRO, COO and SVP, Product and SVP, Engineering as a peer. You’ll lead two experienced VPs, who in turn lead our Sales Engineering, Implementation, Technical Account Management and Technical Support teams.

In this role you will:

  • Shape company strategy and decisions as a member of the Executive Team.
  • Champion a joined-up customer experience, with technical and commercial teams working hand in glove.
  • Sponsor a Technical Account Management model that deepens relationships and opens up new opportunities with customers.
  • Set the direction for fast, high-quality onboarding and support that customers can rely on.
  • Develop your leaders and grow teams in new regions as we expand.

Who you are...

  • A collaborative, people-first leader who builds trust across commercial and technical teams.
  • Someone who cares deeply about customers and turns their needs into great experiences.
  • Calm and clear when things are ambiguous or moving quickly.
  • Comfortable as a peer at Executive Team level, contributing to the whole business and not only your own area.
  • Someone who naturally spots what matters and brings it forward.
  • A clear, warm communicator with colleagues and senior customers alike.

What makes you, you...

We’re interested in what you’ve achieved, not in ticking boxes. You’re likely to have:

  • Senior leadership experience in customer operations, technical support, delivery or customer success, ideally in B2B SaaS.
  • Experience growing teams through periods of change, including across regions and time zones.
  • Experience working with commercial teams to grow customer relationships and revenue.
  • Curiosity about complex technical solutions, and the confidence to shape them.
  • A structured, measured approach to setting goals and tracking progress.
  • An understanding of SaaS customer models and growth measures such as net revenue retention.
  • Experience with partner or OEM relationships would be a bonus.
  • A degree in business or a technical subject, or equivalent experience gained through your career.
  • An MBA is welcome but not required. Your experience matters more than your qualifications.

What we can provide you in return for your investment...

Competitive compensation

  • A base salary that reflects your expertise and impact.
  • Bonus scheme to share in our success.

Financial security & wellbeing

  • Group Benefits Plan for you and your family

Flexibility & work-life balance

  • Remote working arrangements to support your lifestyle.
  • An open holiday policy with no upper limit—take the time you need, when you need it.
  • Support for volunteering and causes that matter to you.

Growth & development

  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression.
  • Exposure and interaction with global teams. International travel will be expected in this role.

Inclusive, supportive culture

  • A commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion.
  • A collaborative environment where your voice is valued and your wellbeing is prioritised.

Impact & purpose

  • The chance to work on technology that drives global economic inclusion and makes a real difference in people’s lives.

Trustonic is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on any grounds. We empower, engage, enable and valuedifferences between people,including; different races, ethnicities, genders, ages, religions, disabilities and sexual orientations, with differences in education, backgrounds, skill sets, experiences and knowledge.

Who we are...

At Trustonic, we make smartphones affordable for the many, enabling global access to devices and digital finance through the world’s most secure smartphone locking technology. We partner with mobile carriers, retailers, and financiers across 30+ countries, powering device financing solutions that drive economic inclusion, profitability, and growth.

We pride ourselves on living by the Trustonic culture code, a blueprint for our journey that recognises that great working environments don’t guarantee success, but bad ones almost always ensure failure.

Working here, you’ll find a company that celebrates its diversity and is looking to do the right thing: for each other, the community and the planet. We believe in equal opportunities and take to heart the old African proverb ’If you only want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together’.

We work flexibly when and where we’re at our best, but regardless of how you choose to work, we’ll make sure you feel like one of the team.

Click here if you would like to find out more about Trustonic's culture code.

If you would like to work in a fast-moving global technology company, with great ambition, then we’d love to hear from you!

Job Title: Finance Manager, Insurance

The Finance Manager will report into the Sr. Director, Insurance FP&A and will join the Insurance Finance team as a versatile finance partner supporting the insurance business. This role supports budgeting, forecasting, and analysis across the insurance division, and takes on special projects spanning M&A, capital, reinsurance, risk management, and strategic initiatives. Because this work informs decisions at the leadership level and is reviewed by auditors and external partners, accuracy, sound judgment, and clear communication are essential.


As the business grows and we take on strategic transactions, the complexity of our capital and reinsurance work continues to increase. Capital and Risk

  • Monitor and report on rating agency and regulatory metrics, including surplus, risk retention levels, net combined ratio, and RBC.
  • Support the corporate risk management insurance program, including policy renewals, coverage analysis, and related cost forecasting.
  • Conduct risk assessments and stress tests to evaluate resilience against potential adverse scenarios.

Planning, Forecasting, and Analysis

  • Support the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and monthly forecast for the insurance division.
  • Conduct financial analysis and variance reporting on performance, profitability, unit economics, and operational efficiency.
  • Take on special projects and ad hoc analysis across the Insurance Finance function as business priorities evolve.

Strategic Support and Continuity

  • Document processes, models, and key assumptions so that work is shared and audit ready.
  • Contribute to cross-training across the team so that critical processes have more than one owner.

Partnership and Reporting

  • Prepare analysis and materials for senior finance leadership, auditors, rating agencies, and reinsurance partners, explaining technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborate with Premium, Losses, Corporate Finance, and Actuarial partners to keep assumptions and outputs aligned.
  • Use AI tools to streamline recurring analysis, catch errors before they reach leadership, and improve the speed and consistency of deliverables.

What You Will Do As A Finance Manager

  • A real opportunity to grow your scope, including leading Reinsurance or sharing a growing Capital and Risk Management portfolio as the function expands.

  • Strong capital modeling and advanced Excel skills.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) for real work such as analysis, modeling, or process automation. Using AI in day-to-day work is an expected part of this role.

Senior Fullstackare till vårt kontor i Östersund

Vilka är vi?

Sedan starten 2006 har vi på Cygni haft visionen att vara den bästa arbetsgivaren för en skicklig och ambitiös IT-konsult. I dagsläget är vi cirka 250 medarbetare utspridda på våra sju kontor i Sverige, ett kontor i Danmark och ett kontor i Finland. Sedan ett par år tillbaka är Cygni en del av Accenture vilket öppnar upp massor av framtida utvecklingsmöjligheter och samarbeten för dig som individ och oss som bolag. Vi är en del av en global organisation med ett nätverk i världsklass samtidigt som vi verkar på vår lokala marknad med vår spetskompetens inom IT.

Vårt mål är att en nyanställd ska känna det som att de fått drömjobbet. Vi har ett mysigt kontor centralt i Östersund, som också är en del av Gomorron Östersunds community. Flera av våra kunder har inte något kontor här i Jämtland, vilket gör att vi då arbetar remote. Några väljer att sitta hemma, och andra på kontoret. Eller lite av varje, det gör man som man vill! Ibland reser konsulterna till kunden för att få träffa teamet IRL.

Utöver att våra konsulter styr över sin egen kompetensutveckling (vilket såklart görs på arbetstid), har du som konsult även stor påverkan på vilka typer av uppdrag och kunder som vi tar oss an.

Vad innebär rollen som Senior Fullstackare hos oss?

Som senior fullstack-konsult på Cygni är du oftast navet ute hos kund. Du har möjlighet att arbeta över hela teknikstacken med alltifrån Serverless, Cloud, REST-tjänster, scripting och NoSQL-databaser till frontnära JavaScript-programmering.

Rollen är varierande och det ges ett stort utrymme att driva egna idéer, påverka och sätta dig in i dina kunders behov för att skapa bästa möjliga lösningar. Hos oss får du bidra och bemästra dina starkaste kompetenser, men även utforska och utveckla nya.

Vem är du?

Som senior fullstack-konsult på Cygni är du oftast navet ute hos kund. Du arbetar vanligtvis över hela teknikstacken med alltifrån frontend och användbarhet till backend och datalager. Ofta med molnet som driftmiljö antingen som serverless eller med hjälp av containers i ett kubernetskluster.

Några vanliga buzzwords som vi ser i våra projekt just nu är open source (såklart), Java, Kotlin, Typescript, C#, Node, Go. Docker, AWS, Azure, GCP, CD, React, React-Native, Flutter, Vue, Angular, microservices och microfrontends.

Vi tror att riktigt skarp systemutveckling skapas av människor som är glada, trygga och får utvecklas i sitt arbete. Hos oss strävar vi alltid efter att  du ska få bidra och bemästra dina starkaste kompetenser, men även utforska och utveckla nya. Rollen är varierande och det ges ett stort utrymme att driva egna idéer, påverka och sätta dig in i dina kunders behov för att skapa bästa möjliga lösningar. Utöver att våra konsulter styr över sin egen kompetensutveckling (vilket såklart görs på arbetstid), har du som konsult även stor påverkan på vilka typer av uppdrag och kunder som vi tar oss an. 

På de flesta av våra uppdrag så är det möjligt med hybrid eller remonte- arbete.

Vad erbjuder vi?

Sedan 2021 är Cygni en del av Accenture som med sina drygt 700 000 anställda gör att vi har ännu större bas av uppdrag, samarbeten och förmåner att hämta. Cygni verkar dock fortsatt som det lilla bolaget i det stora med egna event, kompetensutveckling och kultur. Detta gör att vi får det bästa av båda världar!

Vi erbjuder dig möjligheten till individuell och betald kompetensutveckling på arbetstid och flexibla arbetsvillkor. Hos oss har du fast månadslön och vi månar om dina arbetstider. De få gånger arbetet kräver mer än 40 timmar har vi betald övertid. Vi erbjuder också ett riktigt vasst förmånspaket. Vad sägs om utfyllnad vid både föräldraledighet och VAB? Det är viktigt att livspusslet går ihop. Sjukförsäkring och sjukvårdsförsäkring ingår också i anställningen! Sen har vi naturligtvis de vanliga förmånerna också: friskvård, tjänstepension, förmånscykel och förmånsbil.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Treasure AI:Treasure AI is the agentic experience platform built to acquire, retain, and grow your most valuable customers.
jobs.description:
Treasure AI:

Treasure AI is the agentic experience platform built to acquire, retain, and grow your most valuable customers. Powered by AI, Treasure AI is shaped by human creativity and always-on through continuous, context-driven action.

Furthermore, Treasure AI employees are enthusiastic, data-driven, and customer-obsessed. We are a team of drivers—self-starters who take initiative, anticipate needs, and proactively jump in to solve problems. Our actions reflect our values of honesty, reliability, openness, and humility.

À propos du rôle

Avez-vous le talent pour rendre simple ce qui semble complexe ? Aimez-vous comprendre en profondeur les enjeux d'une entreprise avant de lui proposer une solution ? Nous cherchons un ou une Solutions Engineer pour rejoindre une équipe qui aime aller au fond des problèmes de ses clients, trouver des façons innovantes de leur faire tirer parti de la donnée et de l'IA, et leur simplifier la vie.

Vous serez le partenaire technique et business de nos Account Directors : vous lèverez les obstacles qui se dressent avant une signature, vous porterez la voix du client auprès de nos équipes internes, et vous créerez du contenu qui donne envie d'avancer. Vous saurez échanger aussi bien avec un data engineer curieux des détails qu'avec un décideur qui veut comprendre l'impact business en cinq minutes - et c'est précisément cette capacité à naviguer entre les deux mondes qui fera votre valeur.

En tant que conseiller de confiance pour nos clients, vous les accompagnerez dans leur cycle de vente de bout en bout : de la découverte de leurs besoins jusqu'à la démonstration qui emporte la décision. Vous traduisez des objectifs métier en recommandations concrètes, vous répondrez aux objections avec assurance, et vous donnerez confiance dans la capacité de Treasure AI à résoudre leurs problèmes. Ce poste est fait pour quelqu'un d'intellectuellement curieux, ambitieux et humble, qui aime autant comprendre "pourquoi" que présenter "comment" - sans avoir besoin d'être le développeur le plus pointu de la pièce.

Vos responsabilités

  • Mener des sessions de découverte avec les clients pour comprendre leurs enjeux métier, leur environnement technique et leurs objectifs

  • Construire et animer des démonstrations personnalisées de la plateforme Treasure AI, adaptées au niveau de l'interlocuteur (métier ou technique)

  • Traduire des besoins business en propositions de solution claires, en collaborant avec les Account Directors

  • Répondre aux objections techniques et rassurer les parties prenantes tout au long du cycle de vente

  • Contribuer aux réponses aux appels d'offres (RFP/RFI) sur les volets fonctionnels et techniques

  • Faire le lien entre les retours clients et les équipes produit pour améliorer notre offre

  • Construire du contenu technique et business (études de cas, supports de démo, argumentaires) réutilisable par l'équipe

  • Compréhension du marché, de la concurrence et de nos différenciateurs business et technique pour positionner la solution

  • Participer aux temps forts internes (enablement, partage de bonnes pratiques) et occasionnellement à des événements externes

Profil recherché

Ce que nous considérons comme réellement nécessaire pour réussir dans ce rôle :

  • 4+ ans d'expérience dans un rôle client orienté solution : Solutions/Sales Engineering, avant-vente, consulting, ou un poste technique avec une forte composante relationnelle et business

  • Une aisance naturelle à l'oral avec des interlocuteurs variés - d'un décideur C-Level à un data engineer - et la capacité à adapter son discours à chacun et dans des situations de réunion ou événements

  • Une curiosité réelle pour l'IA et la data : vous avez envie de comprendre comment ils créent de la valeur pour une entreprise et en avez utilisé vous-même - notamment l'IA générative et LLM.

  • Une bonne compréhension des concepts de données (bases de données, API, flux de données) et d’architectures suffisante pour présenter une solution de bout en bout pour des déploiements complexes à l’échelle de l’entreprise

  • Un vrai sens de l'autonomie : vous savez structurer votre propre travail, prioriser, et avancer sans supervision constante

  • D'excellentes compétences de découverte : savoir poser les bonnes questions pour comprendre un problème avant de proposer une solution

  • Français et anglais professionnels, à l'oral comme à l'écrit

  • Expérience dans la mise en œuvre de stratégies de transformation digitale, le conseil stratégique pour les grandes entreprises et la capacité à générer de la valeur concrète pour vos clients.

  • Contrat télétravail avec possibilité de rassembler l’équipe sur Paris

Les plus qui peuvent faire la différence

  • Maîtrise d’une des langues suivantes: Allemand, Espagnol, Italien ou Portugais

  • Expérience dans la vente ou le déploiement de solutions Martech, Data ou Customer Data Platform (CDP)

  • Familiarité avec des environnements cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) ou des data warehouse (Databricks, Snowflake)

  • Une première expérience avec des outils ou frameworks d'IA générative / agents IA

  • Expérience dans la réponse à des appels d'offres complexes

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

Chez Treasure AI, vous rejoignez une équipe qui grandit vite sur un marché en pleine transformation - celui de la donnée et de l'IA appliquée à l'entreprise. Vous aurez un rôle central dans chaque cycle de vente, une vraie autonomie dans la façon dont vous menez vos missions, et l'opportunité de façonner la manière dont on parle d'IA à nos clients en Europe du Sud.

Travel Requirements:

Requires peaks of 25% to visit clients.

Our Dedication to You:

We value and promote diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our business and at all levels. Success comes from acknowledging, welcoming, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

Diverse representation alone is not the desired outcome. We also strive to create an inclusive culture that encourages growth, ownership of your role, and achieving innovation in new and unique ways. Your voice will be heard, and we will help amplify it.

Agencies and Recruiters:

We cannot consider your candidate(s) without a contract in place. Any resumes received without having an active agreement will be considered gratis referrals to us. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation!

jobs.description:
Esta é uma oportunidade exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD)
Vaga 100% remota

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

A Sensedia é uma multinacional brasileira provedora de plataforma de gerenciamento de APIs, governança de agentes e soluções de integração, além de serviços profissionais. Impulsionamos a transformação digital de grandes empresas, habilitando arquiteturas mais ágeis, modernas e escaláveis para que nossos clientes possam oferecer melhores produtos e experiências digitais.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É ter espaço para contribuir com diferentes perspectivas, aprender, experimentar e construir junto.

Acreditamos que times diversos ampliam a forma como pensamos, criamos e entregamos. Por isso, esta oportunidade faz parte do nosso compromisso de ampliar a representatividade de Pessoas com Deficiência na Sensedia e construir experiências cada vez mais inclusivas.

Nos comprometemos com um ambiente acolhedor e respeitoso e, durante o processo seletivo, queremos entender também quais condições podemos oferecer para proporcionar a melhor experiência para cada pessoa.

Conheça mais sobre a Sensedia em: Sensedia Careers

Qual a missão do cargo?

Liderar, com excelência e total autonomia, o processo de pré-venda, sob o ponto de vista técnico, com autoridade no desenho da melhor solução de qualquer complexidade, contemplando as ofertas da Sensedia (incluindo todos os produtos, serviços e parceiros) mais adequadas ao cenário, com autonomia e liderança, cobrindo não somente os requisitos técnicos mas também os requisitos de negócio no qual a solução está inserida. Liderar, com excelência e total autonomia, a implementação de provas de conceitos usando os produtos da Sensedia com apoio do time de soluções; Ser referência para a Sensedia e no mercado nos assuntos técnicos relacionados às ofertas da Sensedia, instigando um olhar crítico e inovador, disseminando conhecimento e visando o aumento de maturidade de qualquer time da Sensedia. Atuar como mobilizador e articulador entre áreas internas e parceiros da Sensedia, com o objetivo de alavancar a solução em andamento. Liderar iniciativas, de ordem técnica ou não, para a melhora contínua do desempenho da equipe, perseguindo a excelência das entregas de todos os participantes e, consequentemente, ampliação de vendas e/ou margens (objetivo final do time de pré-vendas).

Quais serão suas atividades no dia a dia?

  • Atender agendas, em parceria com o time de vendas, para levantamento dos requisitos técnicos e de negócio do cliente.
  • Apresentar e demonstrar, com clareza, completude e notável domínio técnico, as ofertas de produtos e serviços da Sensedia, que estejam diretamente relacionados ao projeto em discussão, permitindo ao cliente a percepção da afinidade da Sensedia com seu desafio.
  • Desenhar a solução, contemplando uma proposta técnica clara, eficiente sob o ponto de vista tecnológico, que esteja alinhada com os requisitos técnicos, funcionais e de negócio, ao mesmo tempo que em linha com eventuais limitadores financeiros.
  • Defender essa proposta junto ao time do cliente, atuando como um consultor especialista, direcionando a solução para a melhor entrega de valor ao cliente, mas tendo a responsabilidade de refinar e reavaliar conforme impedimentos eventualmente apresentados (técnicos, operacionais, financeiros, etc).
  • Apresentar soluções alternativas mesmo que envolvam componentes técnicos fora do escopo padrão da oferta Sensedia.
  • Apresentar, de forma autônoma, os resultados das provas de conceito, APIs e novas funcionalidades para o cliente e para o time de produto;
  • Contribuir ativamente na geração de conteúdos relacionados a oferta da Sensedia, através de artigos, blogposts, webinars, workshops e apresentações em eventos, desta forma disseminando a presença da Sensedia como referência em sua área de atuação;
  • Contribuir com o desenvolvimento técnico do time através da preparação e compartilhamento de material adequado (treinamentos, documentação, workshops) e capacitação da equipe.
  • Atuar como influenciador técnico dentro da Sensedia, trazendo demandas e visões de mercado para melhoria dos produtos existentes e/ou construção de novas ofertas; Liderar a estratégia de respostas para avaliações externas (como Gartner e Forrester) e questionamentos de prospects, tais como RFPs.
  • Formatar e apresentar propostas de produtos/features, para o time de Product Engineering, e de novos serviços para o time de Consultoria.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para este cargo?

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em arquitetura de integração com API Management e iPaaS;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em arquitetura de inteligência artificial
  • Domínio em design de APIs e modelos de segurança.
  • Experiência com soluções utilizando diferentes abordagens: HTTP, REST API, SOAP, JDBC, NoSQL, Event Driven, MCPs, A2A.
  • Conhecimentos nos principais componentes dos mais relevantes serviços cloud existentes (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Conhecimentos em metodologias de desenvolvimento;
  • Experiência com arquiteturas em geral como de sistemas e software - especialmente no paradigma de microsserviços e arquitetura agêntica.

Quais são os diferenciais para este cargo?

  • Conhecimento em Arquitetura Agentica Conhecimento sobre processos de vendas: Sales Engineering, MEDDIC, SPICED, BANT
  • Experiencia anterior com pré-vendas técnicas de SaaS para B2B
  • Conhecimento de plataformas de APIM e/ou iPaaS como Mulesoft, Digibee, Axway, WSO2 ou Kong Conhecimento de plataformas de AI Gateway como Kong AI Gateway, Databrics, etc

Sobre esta oportunidade

Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD).

Sabemos que cada pessoa possui experiências e necessidades diferentes. Por isso, durante a candidatura, teremos algumas perguntas para conhecer melhor você e entender se existe alguma adaptação ou recurso de acessibilidade que possamos oferecer durante o processo seletivo.

Caso precise de alguma adaptação — como recursos de acessibilidade, adequação de uma etapa, apoio de comunicação ou outra necessidade — queremos saber. Nosso time de Talent Acquisition estará disponível para conversar com você.

A necessidade de adaptação não interfere na avaliação das suas competências para a posição.

Aqui você vai encontrar:

  • Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação — Cartão Flash;
  • Plano de Saúde e Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • PPR;
  • TotalPass;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Programa Well-Being, destinado à saúde física e mental;
  • Universidade Corporativa — #SensediaAcademy;
  • Parceiros culturais e educacionais com descontos especiais;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas.

Temos o #WorkWhereYouBelong como nossa proposta de valor para um modelo flexível de trabalho. Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores e queremos que exista uma só Sensedia, independentemente de onde você esteja.

Queremos conhecer você!

Se você se identifica com a oportunidade, candidate-se mesmo que não preencha 100% dos requisitos.

Queremos conhecer sua trajetória, suas experiências e o que você pode construir com a gente.

Durante a candidatura, poderemos solicitar informações relacionadas à deficiência e às necessidades de acessibilidade para viabilizar a participação na oportunidade afirmativa e proporcionar uma experiência adequada durante o processo. Os dados pessoais e dados pessoais sensíveis coletados serão tratados de acordo com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados — Lei nº 13.709/2018.
