jobs.excerpt: Aerospike is the real-time database for mission-critical use cases and workloads, including machine learning, generative, and agentic AI.
jobs.description:
Aerospike is the real-time database for mission-critical use cases and workloads, including machine learning, generative, and agentic AI. Aerospike powers millions of transactions per second with millisecond latency, at a fraction of the total cost of ownership compared to other databases.

Global leaders, including Adobe, Airtel, Barclays, Criteo, DBS Bank, Experian, Grab, HDFC Bank, PayPal, Sony Interactive Entertainment, The Trade Desk, and Wayfair, rely on Aerospike for customer 360, fraud detection, real-time bidding, profile stores, recommendation engines, and other use cases.

At Aerospike, we dream big and deliver even bigger. Our mission is to unleash the power of the world’s real-time data with a database built for infinite scale, speed, and sustainability.

If you're ready to shape the future of data, join us.

We are looking for a Senior Account Executive based in the Nordic region (ideally Stockholm, Copenhagen, Oslo, or Helsinki) to drive enterprise sales efforts across Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland. The Nordics represent a highly sophisticated, cloud-forward market with significant growth potential for Aerospike. We are seeking a strategic sales leader who can establish a strong regional presence, expand existing accounts, and aggressively win new logo business.

This role requires a consultative, culturally attuned salesperson who can engage effectively with flat organizational structures, earning trust across Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and IT leadership. The Senior Account Executive will be responsible for territory development, pipeline generation, and closing high-value sales opportunities for Aerospike products and services. The ideal candidate is an autonomous self-starter with a proven track record selling high-performance database, data platform, or foundational infrastructure solutions into enterprise accounts—ideally with vertical expertise in fintech/banking, gaming, telecom, or retail/e-commerce.

This is a direct, remote field sales role requiring regular travel across the Nordic countries for face-to-face customer engagements, partner meetings, and regional events.

Responsibilities

  • Hunt to exceed target: Build structured territory and account plans for key Nordic markets, generating net-new pipeline and converting enterprise whitespace into qualified, multi-year opportunities.
  • Sell outcomes, not just technology: Translate Aerospike’s technical differentiation—sub-millisecond latency, massive scale, and lower total cost of ownership (TCO)—into measurable business impact for VP-level engineering leaders, architects, and product owners.
  • Navigate consensus-driven buying: Master the Nordic decision-making process by building consensus early, mapping buying committees, developing internal technical champions, and aligning C-level sponsors with developer teams.
  • Partner to win: Co-sell alongside hyperscalers (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure) and regional system integrators/consultancies to accelerate deal cycles and expand market reach.
  • Lead value-based negotiations: Frame strategic enterprise use cases, defend margin through clear ROI models, and manage complex commercial negotiations to close durable software agreements.
  • Navigate European compliance and data governance: Guide deals through procurement, enterprise security, and legal reviews, addressing stringent European standards around GDPR, data sovereignty, cloud security, and financial regulations such as DORA.
  • Execute with rigor: Maintain rigorous qualification standards (MEDDPICC), update pipeline metrics in Salesforce, build mutual close plans, forecast accurately, and ensure active ownership of every deal stage.
  • Serve as a regional brand ambassador: Represent Aerospike at Nordic tech conferences, developer meetups, and executive roundtables to establish community presence and share repeatable playbooks with the wider EMEA team.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Proven track record of quota overachievement: 5–7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise field sales experience, with a consistent history of meeting or exceeding targets in the Nordic region.
  • Deep enterprise data infrastructure acumen: Demonstrated success selling distributed databases, data management platforms, data streaming/analytics software, or modern cloud infrastructure to enterprise architectures.
  • Established Nordic network: Active relationships and credibility with CTOs, VP of Engineering, Chief Architects, and IT leaders across enterprise organizations in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, or Finland.
  • Technical depth and domain literacy: Solid foundational understanding of distributed systems, high-throughput architectures, microservices, and hybrid-cloud deployments, with the ability to speak peer-to-peer with senior technical stakeholders.
  • Structured sales methodology: Expert command of MEDDPICC, Force Management, or equivalent enterprise qualification frameworks to run predictable, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Collaborative, low-ego execution: High cultural intelligence suited to Scandinavian business practices—collaborative, transparent, and direct, paired with the drive and urgency of an enterprise software closer.
  • Location and language skills: Professional working proficiency in English is required; fluency in Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, or Finnish is a strong advantage. Must be based in the Nordic region with the right to work locally and flexibility to travel as needed across the territory.

Aerospike is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to an environment free from discrimination based on race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.

To keep our recruitment pipeline as high-performance as our database, Aerospike uses AI-driven tools to streamline resume reviews, scheduling, and communication. While we love smart tech, we value human connection even more. AI helps us optimize the process, but real people make 100% of the actual hiring decisions.

jobs.description:
Computer World Services, Corp. (CWS) seeks an Active Directory / Identity Engineer to administer, sustain, secure, and recover the Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) environment supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This position manages AD objects, organizational units, Group Policy Objects (GPOs), trusts, replication, schema changes, delegated permissions, domain services, and recovery capabilities.

The engineer also assists with testing of approved Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) capabilities, including potential Okta integrations. These modernization activities complement, not replace, the need for direct, hands-on AD DS engineering expertise. The engineer works closely with cybersecurity, Service Desk, systems, cloud, network, application, COOP, and Government identity stakeholders.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

    • Install, configure, maintain, troubleshoot, and recover AD DS, and create, modify, disable, and delete authorized users, computers, groups, service accounts, and other directory objects.
    • Implement and maintain the OU structure, and manage OU permissions and delegated administration using least-privilege principles, correcting excessive or conflicting access.
    • Develop, test, deploy, and troubleshoot GPOs, including links, inheritance, precedence, security filtering, WMI filters, backups, and recovery; assess changes for security and customer impact before production.
    • Configure, validate, and troubleshoot domain and forest trusts, reviewing direction, transitivity, authentication scope, and name-suffix routing.
    • Maintain AD sites, subnets, site links, and replication topology; troubleshoot replication failures, latency, and lingering objects; and maintain domain-controller health, SYSVOL, DFSR, time sync, AD-integrated DNS, and FSMO roles.
    • Support domain-controller installation, upgrade, demotion, and retirement and transitions to supported AD versions; support controlled schema extensions.
    • Process escalated account, group, and permission changes; troubleshoot authentication, authorization, policy, trust, and replication issues; and improve identity-related Service Desk routing and knowledge content.
    • Provide advanced support during identity and authentication incidents, escalate widespread failures through incident-response procedures, and support root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
    • Maintain and execute AD backup, authoritative and non-authoritative restoration, deleted-object recovery, and forest-recovery procedures, and support COOP and disaster-recovery exercises.
    • Support integration testing between AD and Okta or other approved identity platforms, validating synchronization, authentication flows, attribute and group mappings, provisioning, and SAML, OIDC, OAuth, SCIM, or LDAP protocols, and documenting test results.
    • Automate approved directory administration, health validation, and reporting; review audit information; apply DISA STIGs and security baselines; and support RMF controls, POA&M activities, and remediation.
    • Maintain SOPs, recovery plans, configuration baselines, and directory diagrams, and provide directory-service health, risk, and modernization information for program reporting.

Education & Experience

    Required:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience where permitted by the labor category.
    • Minimum of six (6) years of relevant experience in Active Directory administration, identity engineering, Windows infrastructure, systems engineering, or a related discipline.
    • Direct, hands-on experience administering Microsoft AD DS in an enterprise environment, including objects, OUs, GPOs, trusts, replication, schema, delegated permissions, and directory recovery.
    • Experience troubleshooting authentication, authorization, Group Policy, replication, and trust issues, and supporting AD backup, restoration, and disaster recovery.
    • Experience testing identity integrations or supporting identity-modernization activities, with an understanding of the distinction between core AD DS and external ICAM, federation, or cloud-identity services.
    • Strong written, verbal, analytical, and technical problem-solving skills.

      • Preferred:

      • Experience integrating AD with Okta, and with Microsoft Entra ID or hybrid identity.
      • Experience supporting federal or DoD identity environments, including CAC, PIV, certificate-based authentication, and PKI.
      • Experience with SAML, OIDC, OAuth, SCIM, LDAP, Kerberos, NTLM, AD FS, or comparable federation technologies.
      • Experience with PowerShell for AD administration and automation.
      • Experience applying DISA STIGs to AD and Windows infrastructure and supporting RMF authorization activities.
      • Familiarity with Zero Trust identity principles and privileged-access, identity-governance, or audit tools.

Certifications

    • Required: None.
    • Preferred: Microsoft identity, Windows Server, or Azure certification; Okta Certified Administrator or comparable; CompTIA Security+ or another security certification; ITIL 4 Foundation.

Security Clearance

  • Active Secret clearance or higher is required.

Other (Travel, Work Environment, DoD 8570 Requirements, Administrative Notes, etc.)

    Work Environment / Travel:

    • Remote position; Chicago, IL–area candidates preferred.

Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

As a product-focused Senior Frontend Developer on our AI track, you'll own frontend delivery end-to-end for products that directly affect how patients access mental health care and how our clinicians and staff work day-to-day. Your work sits at the intersection of a large, actively evolving Angular codebase and our AI-first product surface - patient-facing applications, internal tools for doctors and administrators, and the frontend for AI-powered features like our AI clinical assistant and AI receptionist. You'll work in a small cross-functional product team, taking features from requirement refinement through production release.

﻿Why this role:

  • Real product ownership in autonomous cross-functional team, you shape what gets built, not just how.
  • Deep hands-on work on AI-powered clinical and administrative products, with AI-assisted development as a first-class part of the engineering culture (Claude Code, Cursor, and beyond).
  • Modern Angular at scale: an actively evolving monorepo on the latest Angular versions, not a legacy graveyard.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain product features end-to-end within a cross-functional team, from requirement refinement to production release.
  • Take ownership of existing Angular codebase areas after the departing engineer: understand, stabilize, and improve them without slowing down the roadmap.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code: code reviews, unit tests (Vitest), and lightweight design documentation as part of the daily routine.
  • Contribute to frontend architecture decisions and platform health: performance, framework upgrades, NX monorepo structure, CI/CD improvements.
  • Drive AI adoption on both fronts: building frontend for AI-powered product features, and integrating AI tooling into the development workflow itself.
  • Actively contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes and tooling across the community.

﻿This role is not for you if:

  • You're waiting for someone else to define what to build,we expect you to come up with ideas, take them through discovery and development, ship them, and own the results after launch.
  • You need a fully-specced ticket queue and a PM/BA translating everything for you
  • You see AI coding agents as a novelty rather than a core part of how modern frontend work gets done.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of commercial experience with Angular(latest versions preferred).
  • Experience owning a product end-to-end, including analysing the metrics that tell you whether it actually worked.
  • Strong product and UX judgment, you can recognize when an interaction doesn't feel right and propose a better solution.
  • Fluency in modern Angular: standalone components, signals, current change detection and DI patterns, not experience from several years ago followed by a switch to another framework.
  • Advanced RxJS and TypeScript in real production scenarios: confident design and debugging of complex reactive flows (stream composition, cancellation, race conditions, error handling) and fluency in a strictly typed codebase.
  • Proven expertise in designing and implementing complex Angular application architectures at scale, module and component boundaries, decisions that hold up as the codebase grows.
  • Hands-on experience with unit testing (Vitest preferred, Jest acceptable) as a regular part of the daily routine, not an afterthought.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI development. For us this is a must, not a bonus: active daily use of coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar), the ability to write effective skills, prompts, and instructions for them, understanding of the principles behind how agents operate (context, tools, feedback loops), and structuring code and documentation so agents can work with the codebase effectively.
  • Comfort working across the backend boundary: writing or fixing a SQL query, adjusting endpoint validation, or tracing an issue through the API layer. You don't need to be a backend engineer, but stopping at the frontend border isn't an option.
  • Intermediate English (B1+) and fluent Russian.
  • Full overlap with CET working hours.

Would be a plus:

  • Experience building UI for AI/LLM-powered features.
  • Deep understanding of responsive design, our patients access the platform primarily from mobile devices, and interfaces must be flawless across screen sizes.
  • Proficiency in optimizing web application performance across different surfaces: patient-facing product and internal tools for doctors, managers, and admins (data-heavy interfaces, large tables and lists, real-time updates).

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.

  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.

jobs.description:
About Staffbase

We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.

We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.

Senior Solutions Architect

Our biggest deals rarely end with the standard product. Prospects want Staffbase to fit into their system landscape, their processes, and their way of working, and that is where deals are won or lost. As a Senior Solutions Architect, you are the technical authority behind these deals in Europe. You validate what is feasible, design the architecture, and prove it with a working showcase. Then you hand it over to our Build team so it becomes a production solution. You'll work closely with Solutions Engineers, Account Executives, and Build, and you'll have a direct impact on how we win our most complex opportunities.

What you'll be doing

  • Joining strategic and technically complex opportunities in Europe early in the sales cycle, and support Solutions Engineers and Account Executives with solutioning, positioning, and technical credibility at executive and IT level
  • Analyzing and validating integration and customization requirements of prospects, from custom widgets and plugins to scripts, API integrations, SSO setups, and AI/agent use cases
  • Translating customer requirements into a clear solution architecture and a realistic scope, including effort, risks, and dependencies, so we only commit to what we can deliver
  • Building proofs of concept and demo mock-ups, including through vibe-coding, that show prospects what their customized Staffbase experience will look like
  • Working with our APIs, webhooks, extension points, and AI capabilities (including MCP and A2A) to show what's possible on the platform and where its boundaries are
  • Acting as the link between the field and our Staffbase Build team (our Forward Deployed Engineers and developers): prepare clean handovers with documented requirements, architecture, and working prototypes, and give early feedback on feasibility and effort
  • Advising on the technical parts of RFPs and security or architecture questionnaires for complex deals
  • Building and maintaining reusable assets, reference architectures, and best practices for customizations that make the European Solutions Engineering team faster, and coach Solutions Engineers on deeper technical topics
  • Bringing field learnings to Product and Build in a structured way, especially on recurring gaps in APIs, webhooks, and the plugin/widget framework, and help prioritize the improvements that directly win deals
  • Sharing successful solution patterns with Solutions Engineering colleagues in other regions and pick up proven approaches from them

What you need to be successful

  • Degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5-8 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, forward deployed engineering, or technical consulting, ideally in a SaaS or enterprise software environment
  • Proven track record of supporting complex, high-value enterprise deals, from requirements validation and architecture to scoping and handover
  • Strong developer background: you can build working prototypes in JavaScript/TypeScript (React or similar), Node.js, or comparable languages, and you know HTML/CSS well
  • Deep understanding of integration architecture: REST APIs, webhooks, authentication and identity concepts (OAuth, SAML, SSO, SCIM), and designing and debugging integrations in enterprise landscapes
  • Solid knowledge of cloud technologies and SaaS architecture, including security and data protection requirements of large European enterprises
  • Experience with AI-assisted development and vibe-coding tools, and the judgment to know when a prototype is good enough to show and what it takes to make it production-ready
  • Ability to turn vague customer asks into a concrete, scoped solution, and to explain trade-offs to developers, IT leaders, and business stakeholders alike
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the confidence to lead technical conversations with CIOs, enterprise architects, and communications leaders
  • Fluent German and English (C1 or higher), with the ability to hold customer conversations in both languages

Nice to have

  • Collaborative, proactive mindset: you work well with sales and engineering teams, take pride in a clean handover, and are comfortable traveling within Europe when needed
  • Experience with enterprise systems and integration landscapes is a plus: Microsoft 365, SharePoint, SAP, Workday, ServiceNow, Jira, Entra ID/Active Directory, etc.
  • Experience with AI agent architectures (MCP, A2A)
  • Experience with employee communications, intranet platforms, or low-code/no-code platforms
  • Additional European languages, especially French or Spanish

What you'll get

  • Competitive Compensation - we offer attractive salary packages including LTIP (unit-based Long Term Incentive Plan)
  • Flexibility - we offer flexible working time models and the option of hybrid work, and support this with a yearly flex work allowance of €1560
  • Recharge - with 31 vacation days annually (incl. one floating holiday), plus pro rata fully paid Fridays off during August
  • Support-we offer offering a company pension scheme
  • Volunteers Day- you’ll get one day off per year for supporting a social project

jobs.excerpt: Our StoryTopDog Law is a nationally scaling personal injury firm that owns the client experience end to end, from marketing and intake through litigation.
jobs.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is a nationally scaling personal injury firm that owns the client experience end to end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We've grown 2-3x year over year for three years running, and we're now building the operations, systems, and teams to scale without sacrificing quality or culture. We're fully remote, and we value ownership, open communication, and speed. If you want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel at home here.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior DataOps Engineer to own the operations, security, and cost of our data platform. We're migrating from BigQuery to Snowflake, and you'll be the hands-on Snowflake expert who runs the platform and makes sure it stays secure, observable, and well managed as our data footprint grows with machine learning, AI, and structured and semi-structured data from AWS S3 and external vendor files.

This is a tactical, hands-on role supporting the data team and application teams across multiple business verticals. You'll bring data operations practices together in one place, and over time that scope will grow to include the Postgres and NoSQL databases our application teams use. We need deep Snowflake expertise combined with the breadth to look beyond it: how all of our data tools, vendors, access, and costs fit together, and opportunities to improve platform practices. You bring demonstrated experience managing complex data platforms and improving their operations.

What You Will Own

Data Platform & Operations

  • Run the platform. Own administration and day-to-day operations of Snowflake, including environments, warehouses, performance, and the operational side of our migration from BigQuery.
  • Standardize data operations. Define consistent operating practices for data ingestion from S3 and vendor files, structured and semi-structured data, and ML and AI workloads, using infrastructure as code and CI/CD for data.
  • Extend platform practices to operational databases. Extend consistent operational practices to the Postgres and NoSQL databases used by application teams, including backups, performance, and access.

Security & Access

  • Secure the data. Apply least-privilege permissions, design appropriate data access roles, and integrate our data tools with SSO, with encryption and auditing for sensitive data.
  • Manage data vendors and tools. Manage the external vendors and tools used by our data team, covering access, SSO integration, configuration, and licensing.

Reliability & Cost

  • Keep it observable and reliable. Build monitoring and observability across our data pipelines and platform, and define and run the incident management process, from response through root cause and follow-up.
  • Improve cost transparency. Track and attribute spend across Snowflake and data tooling, provide teams with clear cost visibility, and drive optimization.

Support Across Teams

  • Support multiple teams. Serve as the data operations point of contact for teams across business verticals, helping resolve operational challenges and establishing reusable practices and documentation.

What You Bring

Required:

  • 7+ years of professional experience in data platform engineering, DataOps, or DevOps, with a track record of operating production data platforms.
  • Deep Snowflake expertise, including administration, role-based access control, warehouse management, performance, and cost.
  • Strong security and access management skills, including least-privilege role design, SSO integration, encryption, and audit logging.
  • Experience with AWS data storage and access, including S3, IAM, and the networking that governs data access.
  • Experience building monitoring, observability, and incident management for data pipelines and platforms.
  • Experience with cloud data cost visibility and management, including reporting spend clearly to technical and non-technical teams.
  • Experience administering data vendor tools, such as ingestion, orchestration, BI, and data quality platforms.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD for data workloads (e.g., Terraform, dbt deployments).
  • Working experience operating relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres).
  • Broad understanding of the data ecosystem, including how platforms, tools, and processes integrate and where improvements are needed.
  • Strong communication skills and a track record of supporting multiple teams and helping teams adopt shared practices.

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Experience migrating a data warehouse to Snowflake, or working knowledge of BigQuery.
  • Snowflake certifications.
  • Experience supporting data infrastructure for machine learning and AI workloads.
  • Experience with orchestration and transformation tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt).
  • Experience with data governance, catalog, or compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, or in a regulated or document-heavy industry such as legal or financial services.

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

  • Base Salary: $130,000 - $160,000 commensurate with experience
  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.
  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Employment selection and related decisions are made without regard to age, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, gender identification, or being a qualified disabled veteran or qualified veteran of the Vietnam era or any other category protected by Federal or State law.

jobs.excerpt: Inspired at TechTides?  Curious about what we're building at Phorest?
jobs.description:
Inspired at TechTides? Curious about what we're building at Phorest? We'd love to connect!

Whether we had the chance to meet you at TechTides or you simply want to learn more about Phorest, we're always keen to connect with talented people who are passionate about technology, solving real-world problems and making an impact.

We might not have the perfect role for you right now, but that doesn't mean we can't start a conversation.

By joining our Phorest Talent Community, you can stay connected with us and be considered for future opportunities as our teams continue to grow.

A Little About Phorest 🌱

Phorest started in 2002 on a busy salon reception desk as a simple text-reminder tool.

Today, we're a product-led SaaS company building software and AI-powered tools used by more than 155,000 hair, beauty and medspa professionals worldwide.

From bookings and payments to marketing and business management, we're solving real problems for the businesses we serve and the people who use our products. Everything we build helps the salon and medspa industry thrive.

We're also a Certified B Corp, and 25% of Phorest is owned by Phoresters. When the company grows, everyone has a stake in that success.

Growing Our Team in NI

It's an exciting time for Phorest! We've recently announced plans to grow our presence across NI, creating 25 new fully remote roles over the next three years.

We're passionate about connecting with the incredible talent across NI and building a community of people who might want to be part of our journey, whether that's now or further down the line.

Want to hear more about our plans? Check outour CEO Ronan's LinkedIn post about Phorest's NI expansion.

Where Could You Make an Impact?

We're always interested in meeting people from different backgrounds, experiences and disciplines, including:

  • Software Engineering & Technology – Backend, frontend, full-stack, infrastructure, platform, DevOps, QA, security and data engineering.

  • Product Management – Understanding customer problems, shaping product strategy and building solutions that make a difference.

  • Product Design & Research – Creating intuitive experiences and using customer insights to inform what we build.

  • Data & AI – Exploring how data, insights and emerging technologies can help us build smarter products and experiences.

  • Product Marketing & Enablement – Bringing products to life, communicating their value and helping teams and customers get the most from them.

  • Customer Success & Experience – Helping our customers thrive and get real value from Phorest.

  • Payments & Fintech – Building reliable, scalable payment experiences and infrastructure.

  • Commercial, Operations & Business Support – Supporting our global growth across Sales, Marketing, People, Finance and Operations.

And if your experience doesn't fit neatly into one of these areas, that's absolutely fine too. We're interested in people who are curious, collaborative and excited by what we're building.

Why Join Our Talent Community?

Stay on our radar: When new opportunities come up, our Talent Team can revisit the community to identify people whose experience and interests might be a great match.

Hear about our growth: We'd love to keep you connected to what's happening at Phorest, including news, insights and potential opportunities.

Get to know us: Learn more about our people, culture and the problems we're solving before deciding whether Phorest could be the right next step for you.

Keep your options open: You don't need to be actively looking for a new role. If Phorest sounds interesting, we'd love to stay connected for the future.

Curious to Learn More About Life at Phorest?

Here's a little more about us and what makes us tick:

  • 🎙️Meet our CEO, Ronan Perceval– Hear about Phorest's journey, how we've grown and the thinking behind the business.

  • 💡Nothing Ventured– Our blog, where Phoresters share insights on engineering, product, strategy, culture and everything in between.

  • 🎧Phorest FM– Get to know the industry we're passionate about and the people who make it special.

Let's Stay Connected!

Joining is simple. Just hit "Connect with Phorest" to share a little about yourself, your experience and the areas you're most interested in. You can also upload your CV or share your LinkedIn profile.

Our Talent Team will be able to revisit your profile as future opportunities arise and reach out if something looks like a potential match.

One Last Thing…

This isn't an advertised job vacancy or an active recruitment process. It's an opportunity to introduce yourself and stay connected with Phorest for the future. Joining our Talent Community doesn't guarantee that we'll have a suitable role or be in touch about an opportunity, but it gives us a way to find you when relevant roles open up.

Whether you're actively exploring your next move or simply curious about what the future could hold, we'd love to hear from you.

Great things start with a conversation. Join the Phorest Talent Community today! 💚

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!
